jobs.title: AI Driven Software Developer & IT Coordinator
jobs.description: ### **Job Information** * Date Opened 09/16/2026 * Job Type Full time * Industry Legal * Salary $70,000\-$75,000 * Work Experience 0\-1 year * City Chicago * State/Province Illinois * Country United States * Zip/Postal Code 60606 ### **About Us** We are a boutique firm located in the heart of Chicago, specializing in United States and foreign patent prosecution and patent counseling. Our team of practitioners includes many individuals having years of industry experience as engineers and inventors prior to becoming patent attorneys. A combination of significant real world engineering experience and legal experience results in a highly focused and skilled team of practitioners who provide services to numerous Fortune 500 technology companies. ### **Job Description** **AI\-Driven Software Developer and IT Coordinator** **About the Role** Hanley, Flight \& Zimmerman, LLC (HFZ), a Chicago patent law firm, is looking for an AI Driven Software Developer and IT Coordinator. HFZ builds much of its own software to support how our attorneys and staff work. We are looking for someone who is great at two things: understanding what people need and figuring out how to build it. AI coding tools have reshaped this role. We care less about years of experience with a particular programming language and more about whether you can listen to a problem, ask good questions, and turn the answer into working software quickly. If you are curious, communicate well, and have a knack for figuring things out, we want to hear from you. Recent graduates and early\-career software developers are encouraged to apply. **What You'll Do** * Meet with attorneys, staff, and firm leadership to pinpoint issues and create clear, practical, and actionable plans. * Build, test, and deploy internal applications and tools, using AI coding assistants to move quickly. * Keep stakeholders informed by explaining what you are building, what the key trade\-offs are, and expected completion timelines, all in plain language. * Maintain and improve our existing applications, track down bugs, and fix their root causes. * Work alongside our IT support vendor on issues involving networks, servers, and databases. * Troubleshoot on\-site technical issues and provide light IT support. * Document your work so others can understand and maintain it. * Recognize when a decision needs input or approval from management and bring it forward. ### **Requirements** **What We're Looking For** * Consistent and proactive communication in writing and conversation with key stakeholders is essential to this role. * A track record of figuring things out on your own, whether through school, internships, work, or personal projects. * Hands\-on experience building software of any kind. * Regular use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or ChatGPT, along with the judgment to review, test, and understand the code they produce. * Some familiarity with SQL databases and Git, or confidence that you can learn them quickly. * Discretion with confidential information. You will be required to follow firm policies on client confidentiality and how data may be used with AI tools. * 5 days/week in\-office with potential hybrid flexibility. **Helpful but Not Required** * Experience with elements we currently use: C\#/.NET, JavaScript and React, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure, and REST APIs. * Experience with front end, back end, and database integration (full stack development) * A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience connecting third\-party systems or APIs. * Exposure to a law firm or other professional services setting. **How to Apply** Submit your resume and a short cover letter through https://hfzlaw.com/recruit and select the AI Driven Software Developer and IT Coordinator position. Attention: Bill O’Connor, Recruitment Manager In your cover letter, tell us about a time you had to build or fix something you didn't initially know how to do. How did you approach it, what tools did you use, and how did you explain the result to others? Transcripts are welcome but optional. **About the Firm** HFZ is a two\-decade\-old patent firm that delivers top\-quality patent prosecution and counseling services to numerous Fortune 500 companies and global technology leaders. Our team of excellent patent attorneys and dedicated professional staff provides exceptional patent prosecution and portfolio management services to a diverse clientele. We thrive in an inclusive environment that offers ongoing mentorship for the career development of every team member, along with a dynamic team\-focused culture, excellent work/life balance, and a competitive benefits package. ### **Benefits** **Compensation and Benefits** * The salary range for this position is $70,000\-$75,000\. Actual salary may vary based on qualifications. * Health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance * 401K plan * Ongoing mentorship and direct access to senior attorneys\&

jobs.title: Associate Forward Deployed Engineer — Workflow Evaluation
jobs.description: Associate Forward Deployed Engineer — Workflow Evaluation is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap. **Why this role matters** ------------------------- Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Run and reproduce candidate code outputs in a sandboxed environment for Associate Forward Deployed Engineer — Workflow Evaluation assignments. * Grade forward deployed engineer engineering review solutions for correctness, style, and edge\-case handling. * Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed. * Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off\-by\-one, security issue) with severity scores. * Document recurring code\-generation failures so the modeling team can target them. * Calibrate against gold\-standard reviews to keep inter\-rater agreement above target. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Strong day\-job engineering experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for Associate Forward Deployed Engineer — Workflow Evaluation work. * Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode. * Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. Go test, RSpec, or whatever you use. * Clear written reasoning — your review note has to convince another senior engineer. * Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week. * Prior code\-review or technical\-interview\-grading experience is a plus. **Example tasks** ----------------- * Reproduce a generated engineering solution to a coding task, run the test suite, and grade it. * Write the smallest failing test that demonstrates a model's edge\-case bug. * Compare two paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Triage a security issue surfaced by a model and document the patch the model should have produced. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio that demonstrates production\-quality code. * Experience with the target language's standard tooling, linters, and idiomatic style guides. * Familiarity with security\-review checklists (OWASP, CWE) and AppSec patterns. **Skills** ---------- * Code review * Debugging * Unit testing * Software engineering judgment * Forward Deployed Engineer engineering review **Work model** -------------- Remote — US\-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US. **Compensation** ---------------- Hourly rate confirmed after the interview process. **Application process** ----------------------- Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role\-specific routing and review. Final project scope, schedule, and contractor terms are confirmed before placement.

jobs.title: Clinical Product & Compliance Manager – RN Preferred / Nursing Student Considered
jobs.description: Clinical Product \& Compliance Manager – RN Preferred / Nursing Student Considered **Company:** M Systems **Location:** McKinney, Texas / Hybrid **Employment Type:** Full\-Time or Part\-Time, depending on candidate experience and availability **Industry:** Healthcare Information Technology / Electronic Health Records (EHR) About M Systems M Systems develops healthcare information technology solutions for small and medium\-sized hospitals, including rural hospitals, emergency hospitals, and other healthcare organizations. Our platform supports a broad range of hospital functions, including clinical documentation, patient care workflows, behavioral health, operating room workflows, billing, accounting, and other healthcare management capabilities. We are seeking a nursing professional who can serve as the **clinical voice of the product** and work closely with our software engineering, product, implementation, compliance, management, and customer teams. Position Summary M Systems is seeking a **Clinical Product \& Compliance Manager** to provide clinical domain expertise for our healthcare software products. **Registered Nurse (RN) preferred; qualified nursing students will also be considered.** We welcome candidates who are actively pursuing an ADN, BSN, or equivalent nursing qualification and who have strong clinical knowledge, technical aptitude, attention to detail, and an interest in healthcare technology. The successful candidate will help ensure that M Systems' EHR and clinical applications accurately support real\-world hospital workflows and meet applicable healthcare regulatory, compliance, usability, and product\-quality expectations. The individual will serve as a bridge between: * Nurses and physicians * Hospital administrators * Customers * Product management * Software developers * Quality assurance teams * Implementation teams * Compliance and certification organizations This is an excellent opportunity for a nurse or nursing student interested in combining **clinical knowledge, healthcare technology, software product management, compliance, and clinical informatics**. Key ResponsibilitiesClinical Product Management Serve as an internal clinical subject\-matter resource for M Systems' EHR and healthcare applications. Review product functionality from the perspective of nurses, physicians, and other hospital users. Help engineering and product teams understand real\-world clinical workflows and identify gaps between software functionality and actual clinical practice. Provide clinical input for new product features and product improvements. Participate in product planning and prioritization discussions. Translate clinical needs into clear software requirements, workflows, and acceptance criteria. Evaluate whether proposed product functionality is clinically practical, safe, and easy for hospital staff to use. Clinical Workflow Expertise Provide domain expertise for workflows such as: * Patient registration * Admission * Transfer * Discharge * Nursing assessment * Vital signs * Clinical documentation * Nursing notes * Physician notes * Medication workflows * Medication administration * Physician orders * Nursing orders * Allergies * Problem lists * Patient history * Care plans * Laboratory results * Diagnostic results * Clinical alerts * Behavioral health workflows * Operating room workflows * Emergency department workflows * Clinical handoffs * Patient discharge instructions * Follow\-up care * Patient\-safety workflows Work with customers and internal teams to understand variations in workflow between different hospitals and care environments. Product Testing \& Clinical Validation Develop and execute realistic clinical test scenarios for M Systems applications. Test software using patient\-care scenarios similar to those encountered in hospitals. Perform: * Functional testing * Clinical workflow testing * User acceptance testing * Regression testing * End\-to\-end workflow testing * Usability testing * Patient\-safety\-related testing * Release validation Create detailed clinical test cases and expected results. Document software defects, workflow issues, usability problems, and clinical concerns. Work directly with software engineers to reproduce problems. Verify fixes after engineering changes are completed. Participate in software release reviews and confirm that major clinical workflows have been appropriately tested before release. Develop regression test suites for critical clinical functions. Clinical Quality Assurance Help establish a structured clinical quality assurance process for M Systems products. Create repeatable testing procedures for clinical modules. Maintain traceability between: * Clinical requirements * Product requirements * Regulatory requirements * Software functionality * Test cases * Test results * Defects * Corrective actions Identify high\-risk clinical workflows that require additional testing. Help establish release\-readiness criteria for clinical functionality owledge or willingness to learn the following is desirable: * Electronic Health Records * Microsoft Office * Microsoft Excel * Software testing * Defect tracking * JIRA or similar tools * Clinical workflow documentation * HL7 * FHIR * USCDI * Healthcare interoperability * Healthcare terminology * Clinical coding concepts * Healthcare privacy and security Key Personal Attributes The ideal candidate should be: * Clinically knowledgeable * Detail\-oriented * Analytical * Organized * Patient\-safety focused * Comfortable using technology * Curious about how healthcare software works * Able to identify workflow problems * Comfortable communicating with software developers * Comfortable working with nurses and physicians * Able to communicate with hospital administrators * Willing to research healthcare regulations * Able to maintain detailed compliance documentation * Interested in healthcare technology and clinical informatics * Comfortable working in a growing organization The candidate should also be comfortable questioning workflows that do not make clinical sense and clearly explaining why a workflow should be changed. Initial Priorities During the initial phase of the role, the Clinical Product \& Compliance Manager will focus on: * Learning the complete M Systems clinical product suite. * Documenting major clinical workflows. * Creating standardized clinical test scenarios. * Performing end\-to\-end testing of key EHR workflows. * Identifying functional and clinical usability gaps. * Establishing a structured clinical QA process. * Building a compliance and certification requirements matrix. * Identifying certification\-readiness gaps. * Creating clinical product documentation. * Supporting customer workflow discussions and demonstrations. Key Performance Objectives Success in this role will include: * Establishing a structured clinical product testing process * Developing comprehensive clinical test scenarios * Improving product usability for clinicians * Identifying workflow issues before customers encounter them * Reducing clinical defects found after software releases * Maintaining clear product and clinical documentation * Establishing a compliance and certification roadmap * Improving traceability between requirements and testing * Providing clear clinical requirements to engineering * Improving communication between clinicians and engineering * Supporting successful hospital implementations * Improving clinical product demonstrations * Supporting certification\-readiness activities Career Growth This role can provide significant career growth for a nursing professional interested in healthcare technology. Possible career progression may include: **Clinical Product \& Compliance Manager → Senior Clinical Product Manager → Director of Clinical Informatics / Clinical Product \& Compliance → Clinical Informatics Leadership** The position provides hands\-on exposure to healthcare software design, engineering, compliance, interoperability, customer implementation, and product strategy. Why Join M Systems? This is an opportunity for an RN or nursing student interested in building a career at the intersection of **healthcare and technology**. Instead of only using an EHR system, you will have an opportunity to help **design, test, validate, improve, and shape the EHR itself**. You will work directly with software engineers, healthcare professionals, customers, and company leadership. Your clinical knowledge will influence how M Systems products are designed and how nurses, physicians, and other healthcare professionals interact with the system. For a nursing student interested in healthcare technology, clinical informatics, product management, or healthcare IT, this role can provide practical experience that is difficult to obtain through a traditional nursing position alone. Pay: Up to $40,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Paid time off * Tuition reimbursement Work Location: Hybrid remote in McKinney, TX 75070

jobs.title: Controls Engineer Co-op (Spring 2027)
jobs.description: Powerex\-Iwata Air Technology Inc. As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best. Come join a team where People make the difference! As a part of Marmon Holdings, Inc., a highly decentralized organization, we rely heavily on people with the aptitude, attitude, and entrepreneurial spirit to drive our success, and we're committed to attracting and retaining top talent. Position Description: As the Controls Engineering Co\-op at Powerex, Inc. you will have the opportunity to support the engineering group. You will work with mechanical and electrical engineers of diverse backgrounds to develop solutions to manufacturing issues and design new products. Engineers with experience levels ranging from recent graduates to 30\+ years of experience will support you as you develop design skills including PLC, Human Machine Interfaces (HMI) and Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) programming, problem\-solving ability, insight into different types of engineering roles, and gain experience with the design process. The project\-based approach to this co\-op will allow you to contribute to ongoing development projects and perform product line maintenance. As a co\-op onsite at Powerex you will work in an office, engineering lab, and assembly line/manufacturing environments. To be successful in this co\-op you will need to be open to a variety of activities that support the engineering team and embrace new challenges that will come as you gain experience. Example tasks based on co\-op experience level are below. * First Term Assignments: + Supporting team members in creating job packets for Production to build orders. + Assisting team members in the creation and maintenance of engineering drawings. + Assisting team members in resolving issues on the Production floor. + Programming HMI’s to add new functionality. * Second Term Assignments: + Design and implementation of small projects intended to improve the existing line of products. Various projects are available for assignment progressing in difficulty. + Executing and implementing Engineering Change Notices. + Learn start\-of\-the\-art ePlan design software. * Third Term Assignments: + Participation in New Product Development projects. This includes concept ideation, design, prototyping, and testing along with production implementation. + Design and implementation of more complex sustaining projects intended to improve the existing line of products. These may include significant product enhancements and quality improvements with a higher level of difficulty required for successful completion. **Qualifications** * Minimum of 1\-year engineering focused higher education completed at start of co\-op. * Minimum 3\.0 GPA * Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite * Ability to work independently and in teams. * Electrical aptitude with a passion for designing systems with HMI’s and PLC’s. * Experience with basic laboratory electronic equipment (oscilloscopes, signal generators, power supplies, multimeters, etc.) preferred **Company Description:** Hospital breathing air, laboratory nitrogen generators, bus kneeling capability, and many other applications require clean, dry, compressed air. Since 1988, Powerex has focused on designing and manufacturing reliable systems that supply compressed air and vacuum for these markets at the best value. Powerex has a full in\-house engineering staff, which allows for the customization of systems and the development innovative new products to meet the needs of customers and changing markets. Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job\-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to careers@marmon.com, and please be sure to include the title and the location of the position for which you are applying.

jobs.title: Database Developer, AWS Data Platforms
jobs.description: At Peregrine Advisors, you will own the queries, stored procedures, views, and logical data models for your assigned part of a federal agency's enterprise data platform. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will learn new systems and tools, take on greater responsibility, and help develop the firm's capabilities, tools, and lines of business. We move our best to where the hardest problems are. This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $140,000 per year. It is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. We are a data and technology innovation hub and a Benefit Corporation working at the center of the federal government's mission to deliver for client stakeholders and the US public. **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you taking responsibility for the accuracy and performance of your assigned components. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Build Structured Query Language (SQL) queries, stored procedures, and views in Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible). * Work across DynamoDB, Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\), and Apache Iceberg tables. * Design logical data models and database schemas for your assigned components. * Tune queries and build S3 data loads and connectivity under governed access. You deliver database components accurate and fast enough that analysts and systems trust them. You automate the loads and checks that used to be run by hand, and you build models that keep the relational and platform stores working together. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * At least four years of database development experience * Bachelor's degree * SQL on Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible), working with DynamoDB, S3, and Apache Iceberg tables * Stored procedures, views, and query tuning * Data loading from S3 into the platform stores, plus Open Database Connectivity (ODBC) and Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) * Logical data modeling and database\-design decisions for assigned components within an established platform architecture * Basic proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * Physical\-design ownership of Aurora and Iceberg stores, or the drive to grow into it * Access governed by Apache Ranger * Federal information technology or high\-volume transaction experience * Familiarity with artificial intelligence (AI)\-assisted developer tooling **Who you are** You enjoy building with SQL and take responsibility for getting data right. You can take a database problem from design through delivery and stand behind how your work performs. You experiment, learn from failure, and try again quickly. You would rather own an outcome than simply be given a task. **What you bring** * Solid SQL on a modern relational platform, Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible), with stored procedures and views that hold up in use. * Practical skill in query tuning, data loading, and connectivity, with version control and clean delivery. * Practical experience developing logical data models and database schemas, and making physical\-design decisions for assigned components within the established platform architecture. * The ability to own assigned database work from design through maintenance, with sound judgment where accuracy and auditability are not optional. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.*

identify root causes, and implement corrective actions to minimize downtime and improve system reliability * Support emergency response for critical automation issues affecting production continuity * Work cross\-functionally with Factory Automation, IT, Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, and Controls teams to troubleshoot and resolve equipment, system, and communication issues * Support jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer - Austin, TX (WFH)
jobs.description: Full\-Stack Engineer Build. Solve. Own It. At **Vironix**, we're working to make the world a healthier place by changing how healthcare providers monitor and respond to patients. Vironix Health uses advanced AI and remote monitoring to help detect deterioration from viral and chronic illness — giving clinicians better information and patients a better chance to get the right care at the right time. We're a very small team of scientists, technologists, and builders working on a big problem. That means we're not looking for someone who needs a detailed job description telling them exactly where their responsibilities begin and end. We're looking for a **Full\-Stack Engineer who likes to build things.** You'll work directly with our CTO and engineering team to develop and improve the web and mobile applications used by patients and clinicians. You'll write code across the stack, work with APIs and backend services, troubleshoot problems, and take an idea from concept to production. We're much more interested in **how you think and what you've built** than whether your resume lists a particular collection of technologies. What You'll Do * Build and improve web and mobile applications using React, React Native, and other technologies as appropriate. * Work across the stack — including frontend, backend APIs, databases, and application logic. * Write, read, and debug code in Python and other languages. * Work with relational databases, including PostgreSQL. * Take ownership of features and problems from beginning to end rather than waiting for someone else to handle the other half. * Work closely with our CTO and engineering team to turn ideas and requirements into working products. * Help determine **how** something should be built, not just execute someone else's instructions. * Explore and incorporate AI and emerging technologies when they can make the product, development process, or user experience better. * Troubleshoot, experiment, learn, and figure things out when the answer isn't obvious. * Contribute to a product that is being used in real healthcare environments and has real consequences for patients and clinicians. **Requirements** What We're Looking For We're looking for someone who is comfortable wearing a lot of hats. You should be someone who: * Has professional coding experience in at least one language and can learn new technologies when necessary. * Has experience developing applications, preferably including mobile applications. * Is comfortable working across the stack rather than staying inside a narrow specialty. * Can work independently without needing every task broken down into detailed instructions. * Enjoys solving problems where there may not be an established process or obvious answer. * Is excited about AI and interested in finding practical ways to use it — not someone who sees it as a threat to the way they've always worked. * Has experience working with small teams where individual contributions matter and ownership is high. * Doesn't need a lot of structure, bureaucracy, or handoffs to get things done. * Is willing to challenge assumptions and ask, **"Is there a better way to do this?"** * Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks. * Has a genuine interest in building technology that can make a difference in healthcare. Experience That Gets Our Attention We're especially interested in people who have: * Recent startup experience * Built and launched applications rather than simply maintaining someone else's code * Worked on small engineering teams with significant individual ownership * Experience with React, React Native, Python, PostgreSQL, or cloud infrastructure * Experience incorporating AI into products or development workflows * A history of learning new technologies quickly to solve a problem **The specific tools you have used matter less to us than your ability to learn, build, and solve problems.** Why Vironix? This isn't a role where you'll spend six months waiting for a committee to approve a change. We're a small team. Your work will have visibility. Your decisions will matter. And what you build can make its way into the hands of clinicians and patients. You'll work directly with our CTO, have a meaningful voice in how products are built, and have the opportunity to help shape both the technology and the way we work. * Competitive salary based on experience * Equity participation in a high\-growth health\-tech company * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage * Hybrid schedule with intentional in\-person collaboration * Direct impact on technology being used in real clinical care * Small team with high ownership and little bureaucracy * An environment that values **results, initiative, and good ideas over hours logged** Location Our core team is based in **Austin, Texas**. We work primarily remotely with a few intentional days of in\-person collaboration each month.

jobs.title: Propulsion & Effects Engineer — Technical AI Review (Remote)
jobs.description: Propulsion \& Effects Engineer — Technical AI Review (Remote) is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap. **Why this role matters** ------------------------- Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Run and reproduce candidate code outputs in a sandboxed environment for Propulsion \& Effects Engineer — Technical AI Review (Remote) assignments. * Grade propulsion effects engineer engineering review solutions for correctness, style, and edge\-case handling. * Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed. * Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off\-by\-one, security issue) with severity scores. * Document recurring code\-generation failures so the modeling team can target them. * Calibrate against gold\-standard reviews to keep inter\-rater agreement above target. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Strong day\-job engineering experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for Propulsion \& Effects Engineer — Technical AI Review (Remote) work. * Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode. * Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. Go test, RSpec, or whatever you use. * Clear written reasoning — your review note has to convince another senior engineer. * Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week. * Prior code\-review or technical\-interview\-grading experience is a plus. **Example tasks** ----------------- * Reproduce a generated engineering solution to a coding task, run the test suite, and grade it. * Write the smallest failing test that demonstrates a model's edge\-case bug. * Compare two paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Triage a security issue surfaced by a model and document the patch the model should have produced. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio that demonstrates production\-quality code. * Experience with the target language's standard tooling, linters, and idiomatic style guides. * Familiarity with security\-review checklists (OWASP, CWE) and AppSec patterns. **Skills** ---------- * Code review * Debugging * Unit testing * Software engineering judgment * Propulsion Effects Engineer engineering review **Work model** -------------- Remote — US\-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US. **Compensation** ---------------- $65–$75 / hr **Application process** ----------------------- Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role\-specific routing and review. Final project scope, schedule, and contractor terms are confirmed before placement.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description: The Quality Assurance Engineer will partner closely with IT, Operations, Configuration, EDI, Reporting, Business Analysts, and other cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure system changes are thoroughly tested prior to deployment. This position plays a critical role in validating system functionality, configuration changes, integrations, data flows, operational workflows, and enhancements that support HN1's managed care operations and transformation initiatives. **Key Responsibilities** **Testing Environment Management** * Design, build, and maintain non\-production testing environments that accurately replicate end\-to\-end managed care workflows and system interactions. * Develop and maintain test data libraries representing a broad range of managed care scenarios, including provider, member, eligibility, authorization, referral, claims, pricing, payment, reporting, and data exchange workflows. * Establish processes for refreshing, validating, and governing test data while maintaining regulatory and privacy compliance. * Coordinate environment readiness and testing schedules across multiple projects and releases. * Monitor testing environments to ensure availability, stability, and data integrity. **Test Planning and Execution** * Develop comprehensive test strategies, test plans, test scripts, and test cases for system enhancements, APIs, interfaces, system integrations, regulatory workflows, and production fixes. * Execute functional, regression, integration, user acceptance, and end\-to\-end testing. * Validate system logic, master data, configuration, benefit rules, provider data, authorization and referral workflows, claims adjudication, payment processes, reporting outputs, and downstream integrations. * Verify system behavior against documented business requirements and operational specifications. * Develop and execute test cases for APIs, interfaces, and system integrations to validate data exchange, system connectivity, and end\-to\-end processing accuracy. * Apply risk\-based testing methodologies to prioritize testing activities based on business impact, operational risk, and regulatory requirements. * Validate compliance\-related functionality associated with HIPAA, CMS requirements, interoperability mandates, delegated services, and other regulatory requirements as applicable. **Defect Management** * Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects through resolution. * Collaborate with developers, analysts, and operational stakeholders to investigate root causes and validate fixes. * Retest defects and verify successful remediation prior to production deployment. **Collaboration and Process Improvement** * Serve as a primary liaison between IT and operational teams during testing activities, ensuring business processes are accurately reflected in test scenarios. * Partner with business stakeholders to understand operational workflows and translate requirements into testing scenarios. * Recommend improvements to QA methodologies, testing tools, test automation opportunities, and release management processes. * Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts to improve testing efficiency, Provide regular testing status updates, risk assessments, and defect summaries to project teams and leadership. * Maintain testing standards, procedures, and documentation repositories. * Develop QA metrics and dashboards to measure testing effectiveness and release quality. **Required Qualifications** **Education** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer - Field Deployment & Support
jobs.description: **About Destro AI** Destro AI is building the intelligence layer for robotics — the system that coordinates robots, humans, and workflows across complex real\-world operations. Founded by former leaders from HAI Robotics, Dexterity, and Matic, Destro is built on a simple thesis: robotics has solved movement, but not decision\-making. Destro is backed by investors who have previously invested in and built companies like Brex, Figma, Notion, and Instacart. Destro's MothershipOS is a shared brain across all robots, unlocking complex factory and warehouse workflows. Unlike traditional systems that rely on local intelligence on each robot, Destro brings global intelligence across the entire operation. Destro recently closed its Seed round at one of the highest valuations for a robotics company at this stage, and is already deploying in production with large enterprise operators. **About The Role** We're hiring a Robotics Software Engineer, Field Deployment and Support, to own the software that runs MothershipOS in live customer warehouses. This role is responsible for writing and maintaining production code, not solely for troubleshooting it, and will serve as the engineering presence on\-site when systems need to be brought up, stabilized, or restored to full function. **Schedule Expectations** This is a field deployment role, not a standard office\-hours position. Warehouse operations run multiple shifts, and go\-lives, incidents, and integrations are not confined to business hours. * Regular work outside standard business hours should be expected, including nights and weekends. Go\-lives are frequently scheduled during off\-hours or weekend downtime windows to avoid disrupting customer operations. * This role may be paged for production issues, including robot faults, network outages, and server failures, outside normal hours, and is expected to respond promptly, either remotely or on\-site. * Extensive travel to customer sites is required, at times on short notice. * Candidates seeking a fixed 9\-to\-5, Monday\-through\-Friday schedule are unlikely to find this role a fit. **What You'll Do** *Software* * Write, test, and maintain the software services that run MothershipOS at customer sites, including deployment tooling and diagnostic utilities. * Design and build internal tools that make field deployments faster and more repeatable. * Translate field learnings into production\-hardening fixes and improvements in the core codebase. * Maintain clear technical documentation and runbooks so issues can be diagnosed consistently across sites. *Field Deployment* * Deploy and validate Destro's software stack in live warehouses, working directly with customer operations, IT, and engineering teams. * Own production issues end\-to\-end during launch and stabilization, including off\-hours incidents. * Improve uptime, throughput, and reliability of deployed systems through both code and infrastructure changes. *Systems and Infrastructure* * Build and maintain containerized services (Docker Compose) running on Destro\-managed servers and edge devices. * Work with cloud infrastructure (GCP) for image management, versioning, and deployment tooling. * Configure and troubleshoot networking, including VLANs, DHCP, internal DNS, and certificate\-based service security. * Debug across the full stack: robot state faults, sensor issues, API failures, container networking, database queries, and monitoring dashboards. **Who You Are** * 2 to 6 years of experience in systems engineering, robotics software, backend engineering, infrastructure, or field engineering, with genuine software development experience rather than field support alone. * Comfortable being paged off\-hours and traveling on short notice. * Able to operate independently in ambiguous, high\-pressure environments without a fully specified solution. * Calm under pressure, direct with customers, and demonstrates strong ownership. **Technical Skills** *Required* * Strong Python or C\+\+, with the ability to write maintainable, production\-grade code. * Hands\-on Docker/Docker Compose experience, including building, deploying, debugging, and versioning images. * Linux/server administration: command line, logs, processes, systemd, firewalls. * Networking fundamentals: DHCP, DNS, VLANs, static IP reservations, TLS/certificates. * Experience with APIs and communication protocols (REST, WebSockets, MQTT). * Proficiency with Git and standard software development workflows. *Strongly Preferred* * Experience with AMRs, warehouse automation, or fleet management. * Cloud deployment experience, ideally GCP. * Familiarity with observability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, or time\-series databases. * WMS/WES/ERP integration experience. *Nice to Have* * Experience with robot task allocation, scheduling, or routing. * Experience with wearables, scanners, or other warehouse hardware.

jobs.title: Senior Database Developer, AWS Data Platforms
jobs.description: At Peregrine Advisors, you will own the database layer of a federal agency's enterprise data platform. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will learn new systems and tools, take on greater responsibility, and help develop the firm's capabilities, tools, and lines of business. We move our best to where the hardest problems are. This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $150,000 to $170,000 per year. It is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. We are a data and technology innovation hub and a Benefit Corporation working at the center of the federal government's mission to deliver for client stakeholders and the US public. **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you owning the physical design, the data models, and the performance of that layer under real query volume. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Design the physical layer, including partitioning, indexing, and storage layout for large datasets. * Tune queries and execution plans against high volumes. * Build logical and physical data models that hold up within the wider platform architecture. * Run schema migrations and Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\) load patterns, and set Apache Ranger access controls. You deliver a database layer analysts and systems can trust at scale. You automate migration and load patterns that would otherwise be hand\-run, and you build the access controls that keep a governed platform governed. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * At least seven years of database development and administration experience * Bachelor's degree * Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible), DynamoDB, and Apache Iceberg tables on S3 * Physical design for large datasets, including partitioning, indexing, and storage layout * Query and EXPLAIN\-plan tuning on large datasets * Logical and physical data modeling * Database\-architecture design within an established enterprise data platform * PL/pgSQL stored procedures and S3 load patterns into the relational and Iceberg stores * Basic proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * Schema migration tooling, including Amazon Web Services (AWS) Schema Conversion Tool * Access controls using Apache Ranger * Neptune or Neo4j * Federal information technology or high\-volume transaction experience * Familiarity with artificial intelligence (AI)\-assisted developer tooling **Who you are** You make databases fast and keep their data trustworthy. You have designed and tuned large data platforms and understand why the physical model matters. You experiment, learn from failure, and try again quickly. You would rather own an outcome than simply be given a task. **What you bring** * Deep, hands\-on ownership of a database layer spanning Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible), DynamoDB, and Apache Iceberg tables on S3, including physical design, tuning, data modeling, and database\-architecture decisions within the broader platform. * The practical craft of stored procedures, schema migration, S3 load patterns into the platform stores, and governed access. * Sound judgment in a regulated environment where accuracy and auditability are not optional. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.*

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager | Environmental - AVL
jobs.description: **Location:** Asheville, North Carolina **Reports To:** Environmental Department Manager / Group Leader **Status:** Full\-Time, Exempt **Overview of Bunnell\-Lammons Engineering, Inc.** At Bunnell\-Lammons Engineering (BLE), our core principles shape everything we do. We put people first, prioritizing our clients, employees, and community in every decision. We believe trust is earned through honesty, dependability, and delivering on our promises. Clear, timely communication keeps our clients and partners informed, while a commitment to excellence drives us to produce work that consistently sets the standard in our industry. Most importantly, we honor every commitment we make and believe that no challenge is too complex when the right people work together. These values define who we are, how we operate, and the kind of team we continue to build. **Position Overview** We are seeking an experienced Senior Environmental Project Manager to lead complex environmental consulting projects and serve as a trusted technical advisor to clients across the private and public sectors. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Phase I and Phase II Environmental Site Assessments, environmental due diligence, site investigation, Brownfields redevelopment, soil, groundwater, and soil gas assessments, regulatory compliance, risk\-based environmental management, and remediation strategies, including soil excavation and vapor intrusion mitigation systems. This individual will manage projects from initial scope development through investigation, regulatory coordination, reporting, closure, and, when necessary, remediation. The Senior Environmental Project Manager will work closely with developers, property owners, commercial and industrial clients, attorneys, lenders, regulators, and other project stakeholders to identify and manage environmental liabilities associated with property acquisition, development, redevelopment, and ongoing operations. A key component of this position is the ability to evaluate environmental conditions and regulatory requirements and develop practical, technically defensible strategies that achieve project objectives while minimizing unnecessary investigation, regulatory exposure, and remedial expenditures were supported by site conditions, risk assessment, and applicable regulations. This position requires a combination of technical expertise, project management, regulatory knowledge, client relationship skills, and business development capability. The Senior Environmental Project Manager will also provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior environmental professionals and support the growth of BLE's environmental services. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Geology, Biology, Chemistry, or a related technical discipline; Master's degree preferred. * Minimum 5–10 years of progressive experience in environmental consulting, environmental investigation, environmental due diligence, remediation, regulatory compliance, or a related field. * Demonstrated experience managing complex environmental projects from proposal and scope development through project completion and regulatory closure. * Professional registration or certification such as PG, PE, CHMM, or similar preferred. * 40\-hour HAZWOPER certification preferred or required where applicable to project responsibilities. * 8\-hour HAZWOPER Supervisor Training certification preferred or required where applicable to project responsibilities. * Demonstrated experience with Phase I and Phase II Environmental Site Assessments. * Experience with environmental due diligence associated with property acquisition, disposition, financing, redevelopment, or development. * Experience with Brownfields, voluntary cleanup programs, LUST programs, or other state and federal environmental regulatory programs. * Strong understanding of soil, groundwater, surface water, soil gas, hydrogeology, and environmental risk assessment. * Experience with environmental field investigation techniques including drilling oversight, sampling, logging, monitoring well installation, and field data collection. * Demonstrated ability to interpret analytical data and develop technically sound conclusions and recommendations. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Proven ability to manage project budgets, schedules, scopes, subcontractors, and deliverables. * Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain client relationships. * Ability to mentor and provide technical guidance to junior staff. **Skills \& Competencies** * Strong knowledge of federal, state, and local environmental regulations. * Strong understanding of ASTM environmental site assessment standards and practices. * Demonstrated knowledge of Phase I and Phase II ESAs and environmental due diligence. * Strong understanding of site characterization, conceptual site models, data\-gap analysis, and risk assessment. * Knowledge of risk\-b requirements, applicable regulations, BLE procedures, and QA/QC standards. **Technical Leadership \& Mentorship** * Serve as a senior technical resource for environmental investigations, assessments, due diligence, remediation, and regulatory matters. * Review technical reports, work plans, sampling plans, data evaluations, and other project deliverables. * Mentor and develop junior scientists, engineers, geologists, and field personnel. * Provide technical guidance on field methods, data interpretation, regulatory requirements, and project execution. * Assist staff in developing technical skills and obtaining professional certifications and licenses. * Promote consistent application of technical standards, QA/QC procedures, and best practices. **Client Development \& Business Development** * Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients. * Identify opportunities for additional environmental services within existing client relationships. * Develop proposals, scopes of work, fee estimates, and presentations. * Participate in client interviews, presentations, conferences, and networking activities. * Develop relationships within the commercial real estate, development, industrial, financial, legal, and public sectors. * Support growth of BLE's environmental due diligence, LUST, LAST, Brownfields, investigation, regulatory, and remediation services. * Identify opportunities for cross\-selling BLE's multidisciplinary services. * Contribute to strategic initiatives designed to expand BLE's environmental market presence. **Regulatory \& Quality Compliance** * Ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local environmental regulations. * Maintain and enforce BLE QA/QC standards for technical deliverables. * Ensure field activities are conducted in accordance with approved work plans, safety requirements, and regulatory requirements. * Stay current with regulatory developments, environmental standards, investigation technologies, and industry best practices. * Serve as a technical resource for regulatory interpretation and environmental compliance matters. **Financial \& Operational Accountability** * Monitor project financial performance and profitability. * Maintain accurate project budgets and forecasts. * Review project financial reports and identify potential budget or schedule issues. * Assist Department Manager with workload forecasting and resource planning. * Support development of departmental goals related to revenue, utilization, profitability, client development, and project delivery. * Identify opportunities to improve project execution, efficiency, and profitability. **Why Join Us?** * Industry\-leading reputation with a diverse and growing project portfolio. * Opportunity to work on complex environmental investigation, due diligence, Brownfields, redevelopment, and remediation projects. * Opportunity to work directly with developers, property owners, commercial and industrial clients, regulators, and other key stakeholders. * Collaborative, supportive work environment where technical leadership and client service make a visible impact. * Opportunities for professional growth and advancement within a dynamic, expanding organization. * Opportunity to contribute to the continued growth and development of BLE's environmental practice. **Benefits** * Medical/Vision/Dental * 401(K) with partial company matching * Life Insurance * Short/long\-term disability * Paid vacation * Paid sick leave * Eight (8\) paid holidays * Educational reimbursement programs (conditions apply) * Vehicle allowance (conditions apply) * Employee Stock Ownership (conditions apply) *This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the position and is not a comprehensive list of all duties, functions, or procedures that may be required. The organization reserves the right to modify this description and may, from time to time, reassign employees to alternate positions based on business needs.*

jobs.title: Senior Python Developer, AWS Serverless
jobs.description: At Peregrine Advisors, you will own the technical design and delivery of a defined application or solution area. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will learn new systems and tools, take on greater responsibility, and help develop the firm's capabilities, tools, and lines of business. We move our best to where the hardest problems are. This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $150,000 to $170,000 per year. It is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. We are a data and technology innovation hub and a Benefit Corporation working at the center of the federal government's mission to deliver for client stakeholders and the US public. **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you making the design decisions that connect a solution's components and carrying the result through production. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Design how the components of an application or solution area fit together, then guide their implementation. * Build cloud\-native systems whose automated operation replaces manual process. * Build and maintain the delivery path itself, the pipelines and automated tests, rather than merely using them. * Set the pattern for development assisted by artificial intelligence (AI), including tools such as Amazon Q Developer. You deliver an integrated solution whose parts work together and hold one quality bar. You automate the validations and workflows that used to live in a spreadsheet, and you build the developers around you through the way you work. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Open Source Code Review for AI Evaluation
jobs.description: Software Engineer \- Open Source Code Review for AI Evaluation is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap. **Why this role matters** ------------------------- Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Run and reproduce candidate code outputs in a sandboxed environment for Software Engineer \- Open Source Code Review for AI Evaluation assignments. * Grade software engineer open source contributions engineering review solutions for correctness, style, and edge\-case handling. * Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed. * Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off\-by\-one, security issue) with severity scores. * Document recurring code\-generation failures so the modeling team can target them. * Calibrate against gold\-standard reviews to keep inter\-rater agreement above target. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Strong day\-job engineering experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for Software Engineer \- Open Source Code Review for AI Evaluation work. * Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode. * Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. Go test, RSpec, or whatever you use. * Clear written reasoning — your review note has to convince another senior engineer. * Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week. * Prior code\-review or technical\-interview\-grading experience is a plus. **Example tasks** ----------------- * Reproduce a generated engineering solution to a coding task, run the test suite, and grade it. * Write the smallest failing test that demonstrates a model's edge\-case bug. * Compare two paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Triage a security issue surfaced by a model and document the patch the model should have produced. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio that demonstrates production\-quality code. * Experience with the target language's standard tooling, linters, and idiomatic style guides. * Familiarity with security\-review checklists (OWASP, CWE) and AppSec patterns. **Skills** ---------- * Code review * Debugging * Unit testing * Software engineering judgment * Software Engineer Open Source Contributions engineering review * Software engineering **Work model** -------------- Remote — US\-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US. **Compensation** ---------------- Hourly rate confirmed after the interview process. **Application process** ----------------------- Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role\-specific routing and review. Final project scope, schedule, and contractor terms are confirmed before placement.

jobs.title: Staff Associate | Construction Materials Testing (CMT)
jobs.description: **Location:** Asheville, North Carolina **Reports to:** Group Leader / Department Manager for CMT **Status:** Full\- Time, Exempt **Overview of Bunnell\-Lammons Engineering, Inc.** At Bunnell\-Lammons Engineering (BLE), our core principles shape everything we do. We put people first, prioritizing our clients, employees, and community in every decision. We believe trust is earned through honesty, dependability, and delivering on our promises. Clear, timely communication keeps our clients and partners informed, while a commitment to excellence drives us to produce work that consistently sets the standard in our industry. Most importantly, we honor every commitment we make and believe that no challenge is too complex when the right people work together. These values define who we are, how we operate, and the kind of team we continue to build. **Notice to applicants:** Background checks are carried out as part of any conditional offer made, including (but not limited to \& role dependent) education, professional registration, employment, references and global watchlist screening. **To be a considered applicant:** Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship and able to interview on site where the position is located. **Position Overview** Are you an ambitious and driven individual with a foundational understanding of environmental, civil, or geotechnical principles, eager to launch your career in a dynamic consulting environment? We are seeking a Engineering Staff Associate to join our growing team, contributing to diverse projects across environmental, civil, geotechnical, Geostructural, and construction material testing disciplines. This role is ideal for individuals looking to develop their skills, gain hands\-on experience, and progress towards professional licensure. You will be a vital part of our project teams, supporting senior staff and learning the ins and outs of engineering consulting from the ground up. Our Geotechnical Group focuses on serving projects for our local municipal, industrial, residential, and commercial clients. These projects span a multitude of geotechnical support roles, from geotechnical exploration to geotechnical support during construction. **Minimum Job Requirements** * Associate’s degree in Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Environmental Science, or a closely related field of study from an ABET\-accredited institution. * 0\-2 years of progressively responsible professional experience in relevant fields * Currently in progress towards obtaining Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) or Geologist\-in\-Training (GIT) certification. * Required to travel regularly to local and regional project sites (typically within South Carolina and surrounding states) , potentially including overnight stays and perform extensive fieldwork under varying environmental conditions, including adverse weather, uneven terrain, and potentially hazardous environments, while adhering strictly to health and safety protocols. **Key Responsibilities** * Perform technical analyses, calculations, and design for various engineering projects, including but not limited to site development, foundation design, retaining walls, earthwork, and pavements. * Utilize engineering software and tools for design, modeling, and data analysis (e.g., AutoCAD, Civil 3D, GeoStudio, gINT, Tablogs). * Perform site investigations, field inspections, and data collection to support project objectives. * Draft exploration reports for review by senior professionals. **Skills \& Components** * **Technical Expertise:** Develop and apply foundational knowledge in environmental regulations, civil design principles, geotechnical investigations, and construction material testing. Assist in data collection, analysis, and basic report preparation under direct supervision. * **Client Relationship Management:** Begin to understand the importance of client satisfaction. Assist in clear and concise communication with clients regarding project updates and data, always under the guidance of senior staff. Learn how to maintain professional demeanor and build rapport. * **Quality Control and Assurance:** Adhere strictly to company and project\-specific quality control procedures. Assist in reviewing data and reports for accuracy and completeness, learning the principles of quality assurance in a consulting environment. * **Project Planning and Scheduling:** Contribute to the development of project work plans and schedules by assisting with task breakdown and resource allocation. Learn to track personal progress against project timelines and communicate potential delays to project managers. * **Risk Management and Compliance:** Develop an understanding of project\-specific risks and assist in identifying potential hazards. Learn to follow all safety protocols and regulatory compliance requirements on project sites and in the office. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work effectively as a supportive team member, collaborating with engineers, scientists, geologists, and technicians from various disciplines. Learn to contribute to a positive and productive team environment. * **Contracts and Vendor Management:** Gain exposure to project contracts and assist with the initial stages of vendor coordination under senior guidance. Understand the importance of adherence to contractual obligations. * **Business Development:** Support business development efforts by assisting with proposal preparation, data compilation for marketing materials, and understanding the firm's service offerings. Learn to recognize potential opportunities for new work. * **Performance Analytics:** Learn to track and report on individual project progress and time utilization. Begin to understand key performance indicators relevant to project efficiency and profitability. **Building Your Skills Further** At our firm, we are committed to fostering the growth of our Staff Professionals. This role provides an excellent platform to expand your technical knowledge, refine your project management abilities, and develop essential client\-facing skills. You will receive mentorship from experienced professionals, have opportunities for professional development and training, and gain exposure to a wide range of challenging and rewarding projects. We are invested in helping you achieve your EIT/GIT certification and beyond, laying the groundwork for a successful and fulfilling career in consulting. *This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the position and is not a comprehensive list of all duties, functions, or procedures that may be required. The organization reserves the right to modify this description and may, from time to time, reassign employees to alternate positions based on business needs. Such changes may occur without prior notice and are aimed at ensuring operational efficiency.* **Why Join Us?** * Industry\-leading reputation with a diverse and growing project portfolio. * Collaborative, supportive work environment where your leadership makes a visible impact. * Opportunities for professional growth and advancement within a dynamic, expanding organization. **Benefits** * Medical/Vision/Dental * 401(K) with partial company matching * Life Insurance * Short/long term disability * Paid vacation * Paid sick leave * Eight (8\) paid holidays * Educational re\-imbursement programs (conditions apply) * Vehicle allowance (conditions apply)

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Agentic Platform
jobs.description: **Our Mission:** 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. **Our People:** People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry\-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference\-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. **Staff Product Manager, Agentic Platform** =========================================== **Are you passionate about building the infrastructure that powers next\-generation AI agents?** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ At 6sense, we're building an AI Operating System that enables intelligent agents to reason, take action, and execute complex workflows across the Revenue AI platform. We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own critical components of our Agent Platform, including orchestration, agent execution frameworks, tool integration patterns, and developer enablement. This is a highly technical individual contributor role reporting to the Product Lead, AI Platform. You will partner closely with engineering, applied AI teams, and platform leaders to define the systems that enable every product team at 6sense to build reliable, scalable, and enterprise\-ready agentic experiences. **Your Impact** --------------- As Staff Product Manager, Agent Platform, you will: ### **Own Agent Runtime Capabilities** Define the roadmap for the core systems that power agent execution, workflow orchestration, state management, and task coordination across the platform. ### **Build Agent Development Frameworks** Define the standards, APIs, and tooling that enable engineering teams to build, deploy, and scale agentic applications consistently. Empower other teams to build agentic experiences powered by AI OS. ### **Design Capability Registration Systems** Partner with engineering to create self\-service mechanisms that allow teams to register tools, actions, workflows, and services within the AI OS. ### **Improve Developer Experience** Create SDKs, platform abstractions, and operational tooling that reduce complexity and accelerate adoption across product teams. ### **Drive Agent Reliability** Define platform requirements for observability, evals, debugging, resiliency, failure handling, and operational excellence. ### **Enable Multi\-Agent Workflows** Develop foundational capabilities that support planning, delegation, task execution, and coordination across complex agentic systems. ### **Partner Across Product and Engineering** Work closely with AI Platform, Infrastructure, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure platform investments unlock customer\-facing innovation. **Strategic Themes You'll Drive** --------------------------------- ### **Agent Infrastructure at Scale** Build the foundational systems that support intelligent workflows across all 6sense products. ### **Platform Self\-Service** Enable product teams to build agentic experiences without reinventing core infrastructure. ### **Enterprise Reliability** Create the operational standards required for secure, scalable, enterprise\-grade AI systems. ### **Developer Velocity** Reduce friction and accelerate the development of AI\-powered applications across the organization. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- ### **AI Platform Experience** Experience building products related to: * Agent platforms * AI orchestration systems * Workflow engines * Distributed systems * Developer platforms * Infrastructure products ### **Technical Depth** Strong understanding of concepts such as: * Agent architectures * Function calling * Tool orchestration * Workflow execution * State management * Memory systems * Multi\-agent systems * AI observability * Evaluation frameworks ### **Platform Thinking** A track record of building products used by multiple teams and supporting a broad ecosystem of internal and external stakeholders. ### **Cross Functional Leadership** Ability to influence engineers, architects, researchers, and senior executives on highly technical topics. ### **Experience** * 8\+ years in Product Management * Platform, Infrastructure, AI Platform, or Developer Platform experience * Experience owning highly technical products with significant architectural complexity * Experience working closely with engineering teams to deliver platform capabilities at scale Base Salary Range: $191,833\.50 \- $262,355\.80\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense's total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense's board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self\-care days, and paid time off (PTO). \#Li\-remote Notice of Collection and Use of Personal Information for California Residents: California Recruitment Privacy Notice and Policy **Our Benefits:** Full\-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time\-off and holidays, quarterly self\-care days off, and stock options. We'll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces. We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well\-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG\-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds. **Equal Opportunity Employer:** 6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.
