jobs.title: Robot Service Operations Specialist / Coordinator, North America
jobs.description: Agile Robots is a global leader in industrial and humanoid robotics and physical AI, integrating advanced machine learning and robotic vision to redefine the future of work. Headquartered in Munich with a global workforce of 3,000\+, we are expanding our North American team. We create fast time\-to\-market solutions for the automotive, consumer electronics, healthcare, and service industries, and our products are known for their precision, reliability, and ease of integration. **Role Overview** As we scale our North American operations, we are looking for an Operations Specialist and Coordinator to own and continuously improve the operational, logistics, inventory, ERP, and vendor\-management backbone of our service center. This is a high\-ownership role centered on planning, analysis, and decision\-making: you will help to define how the service center runs, select and manage the vendors and carriers we depend on, own our inventory and demand strategy, and serve as the North American operations point of contact with our Munich headquarters and worldwide sites. You will exercise independent judgment daily on matters that directly a ect service levels, cost, and compliance, partnering closely with our Robot Service and Support Engineers to keep parts, systems, and payments flowing. You are joining a small and growing team with a start\-up mentality, where everyone roll’s up their sleeves and takes on any task required to keep operations running smoothly. Therefore, this role directly encompasses all warehouse operations, including hands\-on management and processing of incoming and outgoing deliveries. **Requirements** **Key Responsibilities** * Process and systems ownership. Own and continuously improve the service center’s logistics, inventory, ERP, and finance\-support workflows; design, document, and maintain the standard operating procedures for North American operations. * Vendor and carrier management. Select, evaluate, and negotiate terms with carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, calibration vendors, and parts suppliers; make sourcing and vendor decisions and manage those relationships end to end. * Demand and inventory planning. In partnership with Operations, manage the demand forecasting and inventory strategy: set reorder points and safety\-stock levels and make stocking, allocation, and disposition decisions that balance cost against service commitments. * Customs and trade compliance. Serve as the service center’s decision\-maker on import and export compliance, interpreting requirements and resolving complex shipment and documentation issues using independent judgment. * Spend analysis and cost control. Capture \& analyze operational spend and expense data; identifying cost\-reduction opportunities and make budget and process recommendations to leadership. * ERP ownership. Own SAP/ERP operations and data governance for the service center (purchase orders, sales orders, inventory movements, payments and vendor records), ensuring accuracy and driving process improvements across the system. * Performance and reporting. Help to define, track, and create efficiencies, analyzing performance and lead continuous\-improvement initiatives. * Cross\-functional coordination. Act as the North American operations point of contact with home\-o ice teams (Sales, SCM) in Munich, coordinating across time zones and representing the service center’s operational interests. * Oversight and exceptions. Oversee shipping, receiving, and inventory transactions, reviewing accuracy and resolving exceptions; direct the work of the warehouse and logistics with Customer Support and carriers. * Tools and calibration. Oversee tool inventory, calibration schedules, and certification tracking, managing the associated vendor relationships and ensuring compliance. * Occasional coverage. Provide hands\-on support during peak periods or coverage gaps as needed. **Experience \& Attributes** * Education. Bachelor’s degree in business administration, supply chain management, logistics, or accounting preferred; an associate degree with substantial relevant experience will be considered. * Experience. 4\+ years in operations, logistics, supply chain, or inventory management, ideally in a technical, manufacturing, or hardware environment, including demonstrated ownership of vendor relationships, planning, or process design. Exposure to accounts payable or expense analysis is strongly preferred. * Judgment and autonomy. A track record of making independent operational decisions on matters of significance (vendor selection, planning, compliance, spend) with limited day\-to\-day supervision. * Systems. Hands\-on experience with SAP or a comparable ERP (inventory movements, POs, sales orders, invoice processing) and strong spreadsheet and analysis skills for reconciliation, reporting, and forecasting. * Logistics and trade. Experience coordinating domestic and international shipments, including customs documentation and working with freight forwarders, carriers, and import agents. * Communication. Clear, professional written and verbal communication for coordinating across customers, vendors, carriers, customs agents, and home\-o ice teams in Munich; comfortable working across time zones. * Physical requirements. Ability to repeatedly lift and move packages and equipment weighing up to 50 lbs, and use team lifts or material handling equipment for heavier items. **Classification and Compensation** * Employment type. Full\-time, exempt (salaried). Salary range. $95,000 to $135,000 USD per year, depending on experience and location within the North Bay and San Francisco Bay Area. * **Benefits** * Performance\-based bonuses. * Comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, vision insurance, and Safe Harbor 401k. * Generous paid time off and paid holidays. * Opportunities for professional development and continuous learning in cutting\-edge robotics technology. Agile Robots is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Accommodations: If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact USA@agile\-robots.com

jobs.title: Senior Application Mechanical Engineer / Designer
jobs.description: Agility's commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and distribution centers—tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher\-value work. With industry\-leading safety standards and years of proven deployment data, we're pioneering a new era of automation that enhances human potential. **About the Role** Agility Robotics deploys Digit — a humanoid robot — into customer warehouses, distribution centers, and manufacturing environments. Every customer deployment needs mechanical design work related to workcell layouts, custom fixtures and jigs and possibly additional safety guarding along with integration of off\-the\-shelf hardware components like barcode scanners and sensors. This role will be a hands\-on **Applications Mechanical Engineer/Designer** who can take a customer use case concept and turn it into a physical reality captured in CAD with a detailed BOM and documentation. This person will help deploy the design in our test cells and possibly in a customer facility if needed. This is a "do" role. The person will design cell layouts, integrate an off\-the\-shelf scanner, and help the team troubleshoot fixtures as needed. The range matters more than depth in any single specialty. **About the Work** * Design customer workcell layouts — robot placement, material flow, operator access, safety zones, and integration with existing customer infrastructure. * Design and detail custom fixtures, carts, jigs, staging equipment, and material handling interfaces specific to each customer deployment. * Test and integrate off\-the\-shelf hardware components that have been vetted by the product design engineering team — barcode scanners, 2D code readers, sensors, light curtains, mounting hardware — into deployment configurations. * Produce production\-quality CAD models, detailed drawings, and BOMs suitable for fabrication, procurement, and field assembly. * Assist with customer site surveys to capture physical constraints: floor conditions, ceiling heights, dock configurations, utility access, material flow paths, and existing equipment interfaces. * Support cell setup and commissioning on\-site — hands\-on troubleshooting of mechanical fit, fixture alignment, and hardware integration issues. * Adopt and adapt end\-of\-arm tooling and gripper interfaces for customer\-specific manipulation requirements — totes, cases, cartons, and structured items. * Collaborate with other team members on deployment configurations — translating mechanical design into robot programming parameters. * Build a library of reusable designs — standard cell layouts, common fixture patterns, proven hardware integration approaches — that accelerate future deployments. * Other duties as assigned. **About You** * 5\+ years in mechanical design, applications engineering, or a designer/drafter role with increasing responsibility demonstrated by a portfolio of *deployed* designs. * Proficiency producing detailed drawings and BOMs in 3D CAD (SolidWorks, Creo, or equivalent). * Practical experience integrating off\-the\-shelf hardware components into mechanical assemblies — scanners, sensors, actuators, mounting systems.. * Familiarity with standard fabrication methods: sheet metal, machining, weldments, 3D printing and the cost and lead time tradeoffs. * Hands\-on capability to pick up tools, help assemble a fixture, troubleshoot a fit issue, and work alongside field technicians as/if needed. * Comfort operating in ambiguity: incomplete data, evolving requirements, concurrent crises across multiple customer programs. * Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time for customer site surveys, deployment support, and commissioning. **Bonus Points** * Experience running simulation of warehouse automation or material handling equipment. * Background in applications engineering at a robotics or automation company — designing solutions for customer environments – ideally environments where robots work alongside people. * Experience with gripper design, end\-of\-arm tooling, or manipulation system interfaces. * Familiarity with industrial integration hardware — barcode/2D scanners, safety\-rated devices, industrial networking components. * A jack\-of\-all\-trades mindset — you're the person who figures out how to make things work with what's available, not the person who waits for perfect conditions. * The aptitude and willingness to learn safety standards relevant to robotic workcells **Location** * This is a hybrid position based out of our Salem, OR or Pittsburgh, PA offices with travel to customer sites up to 20% (site surveys, deployments) \| Reports to: Lead, Solution Architecture *The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to: market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This range may change based on geographical location and may be modified in the future.* ***In addition to base pay, our competitive total rewards package consists of the following for full\-time employees:*** * **401(k) Plan:** Includes a 6% company match. * **Equity:** Company stock options. * **Insurance Coverage:** 100% company\-paid medical, dental, vision, and short/long\-term disability insurance for employees. * **Benefit Start Date:** Eligible for benefits on your first day of employment. * **Well\-Being Support:** Employee Assistance Program (EAP). * **Time Off:** + **Exempt Employees:** Flexible, unlimited PTO and 12 company holidays, including a winter shutdown. + **Non\-Exempt Employees:** 10 vacation days, paid sick leave, and 12 company holidays, including a winter shutdown, annually. * **On\-Site Perks:** Catered lunches four times a week and a variety of healthy snacks and refreshments at our Salem and Pittsburgh locations. * **Parental Leave:** Generous paid parental leave programs. * **Work Environment:** A culture that supports flexible work arrangements. * **Growth Opportunities:** Professional development and tuition reimbursement programs. * **Relocation Assistance:** Provided for eligible roles. * **Annual Discretionary Bonus:** Provided for eligible roles. All of our roles are U.S.\-based. Applicants must have current authorization to work in the United States. Agility Robotics is committed to a work environment in which all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. Each individual has the right to work in a professional atmosphere that promotes equal employment opportunities and prohibits unlawful discriminatory practices, including harassment. Therefore, it is the policy of Agility Robotics to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital status, citizenship, national origin, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. Agility Robotics prohibits any such discrimination or harassment. **Agility Robotics does not accept unsolicited referrals from third\-party recruiting agencies. We prioritize direct applicants and encourage all qualified candidates to apply directly through our careers page. If you are represented by a third party, your application may not be considered. To ensure full consideration, please apply directly.**

jobs.title: Managed Services Operations Lead - FinOps
jobs.description: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation. At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD. We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived. ***We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.*** The Managed Services Operations Lead, FinOps is the senior technical authority for AHEAD’s Cloud FinOps service, serving as thought leader and subject matter expert for clients, partners, and internal delivery teams. The role leads the development, design, and implementation of FinOps solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and is accountable for the technical quality, consistency, and maturity of FinOps delivery across the managed services client portfolio. Operating as a principal\-level practitioner, this role owns the most complex client scenarios, serves as the primary technical escalation point for Cloud FinOps Engineers, and sets the standards, data models, automation, and reusable assets that the practice delivers against. The role also defines and drives the AI and automation roadmap for the FinOps practice, translating advanced analytics and machine learning capabilities into productized, explainable, and trusted service offerings. This is an individual contributor role that provides technical leadership, mentorship, and coordination across delivery resources without direct personnel\-management responsibility. The role requires a strategic mindset, mature executive communication skills, and commercial awareness, engaging client senior leadership, finance and procurement stakeholders, service and process owners, AHEAD service leadership, and sales teams directly. The role is performed remotely within the United States and includes up to 15 percent domestic travel, along with occasional after\-hours or weekend support during major incidents, reporting deadlines, approved change windows, or other activities required by contracted service commitments. ### **Duties / Responsibilities** Technical Leadership and Solution Design * Serve as the primary technical escalation point for Cloud FinOps Engineers supporting client engagements, resolving the most complex technical and financial analysis scenarios. * Act as principal engineer for high\-complexity client situations requiring advanced cloud engineering, financial modeling, and cross\-domain judgment. * Lead the development, design, and implementation of complex, mission\-critical, enterprise\-grade FinOps solutions, including AI\-enabled capabilities where they deliver measurable client value. * Ensure FinOps services and deliverables are provided on time and at the highest quality standards while meeting or exceeding client expectations and contracted service commitments. * Develop and maintain technical roadmaps and innovation plans for supported FinOps solutions and services. * Establish project estimates and plans, identify risks and mitigations, and oversee the development and delivery of technical FinOps solutions. * Provide technical leadership and coordinate technical delivery resources across skillsets, including cross\-practice work and deliverables, without direct personnel\-management responsibility. * Provide credible time and effort estimates based on available information, and initiate and author project change requests when additional work is identified beyond agreed scope. Cloud Cost Analysis and Optimization * Lead deep\-dive investigations into cloud spend drivers, billing anomalies, optimization opportunities, and cost visibility gaps across AWS, Azure, and GCP using native tooling and approved third\-party FinOps platforms. * Define the methodology by which the practice identifies, quantifies, prioritizes, and drives optimization opportunities including rightsizing, idle resource cleanup, storage and data transfer optimization, licensing alignment, and scheduling strategies. * Own the framework for tracking optimization opportunities through identified, recommended, approved, implemented, and realized states, ensuring financial outcomes are validated and unrealized savings are not double\-counted or misattributed. * Set the approach for cost visibility and allocation in containerized and Kubernetes workloads, including shared cluster cost distribution, namespace and label\-based allocation, and idle capacity analysis. * Lead analysis and optimization of AI a mily and Medical Leave Act (FMLA), and other applicable federal, state, and local laws. Performance of Essential Functions: Ability to safely and effectively perform all essential job functions listed herein while meeting established productivity and quality standards. Attendance: Ability to maintain regular and predictable attendance, consistent with ADA, FMLA, and other applicable requirements. Includes ability to safely and reliably travel to and from an office and/or client work site, as required. Work Environment: Ability to perform job duties in primarily remote, office, client site, or technical environments, which may include: * Extended periods of sitting, typing, and working at a computer or in virtual meetings. * Occasional standing, walking, bending, and lifting or moving laptops, monitors, or small equipment, generally up to twenty (20\) pounds. * Occasional exposure to client or production environments that may include higher noise levels, bright lighting, varying airflow, and changing temperatures. Manual Dexterity: Ability to use hands and fingers to handle, feel, or operate objects, tools, or controls, and reach with hands and arms, as needed. jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description: Senior QA engineer to become a part of the team, contributing significantly to the effort of modernizing legacy applications through their migration to AI based services. The ideal candidate will have a passion for quality, a strong technical background in automation of test scripts, and a proven track record of success in delivering high\-quality software products. **KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY:** **Technical Responsibilities:** * Test the accuracy, performance, and usability of speech recognition models and systems, ensuring they understand a wide variety of accents, dialects, and languages in real\-world environments. * Lead the test design and test execution to verify software components in alignment with requirements and architecture defined. * Develop test strategy to verify complex systems independently. * Document and report bugs found during testing, collaborate with the development team for resolutions, and perform regression testing to ensure fixes are effective. * Ability to influence teams to achieve project quality objectives. * Work closely with cross\-functional teams to understand system requirements and ensure test coverage aligns with business needs. * Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: What you will need (strongly desired): Technical Skills:** * Strong knowledge of speech recognition technologies and APIs (Microsoft Azure Speech or similar). * Experience with test automation methodologies like TestNg framework. * Familiarity with machine learning models and how they apply to speech recognition systems. * Understands the theory and methods of testing on\-prem/cloud applications and can apply them under minimal supervision while demonstrating: * Ability to create and implement testing methods, recording the test results and prepare test metrics. * Capability to test all aspects of the product/system including function/component, system, performance, regression and service. jobs.title: Data Architect
jobs.description: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing! We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. We are seeking a highly skilled **Data Architect** with expertise in modern data management platforms and a deep understanding of data ingestion from multiple sources, including SQL databases, APIs and cloud data services. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing robust, scalable data architectures and enabling advanced data integration pipelines that support analytics, business intelligence, and AI models. Proficiency in data visualization tools is essential. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Design and implement end\-to\-end data architecture solutions, including data models, ingestion and transformation processes, and storage. * Lead strategies for ingesting data from various sources including databases, APIs, flat files, and streaming data. * Develop, manage, and secure API integrations for seamless data exchange across platforms. * Architect and maintain data solutions across multiple cloud environments. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand data needs and align architectural solutions with business goals. * Ensure data quality, governance, lineage, and compliance standards are integrated into all solutions. * Optimize performance and cost of data infrastructure. * Support the creation of impactful dashboards and reports that drive insights for business stakeholders. * Document architectural standards, patterns, and best practices. **QUALIFICIATIONS:** * Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of experience in data architecture/ BI in corporate environments. * Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric and related tools. * Proven expertise in data ingestion, transformation, and ETL/ELT pipelines. * Proficiency in API design, development, and management (RESTful, OAuth, etc.). * Knowledge of AWS data services including Athena, RDS, Glue, Kinesis, and S3\. * Knowledge of Azure features and best practices. * Experience with data modeling, both relational and dimensional. * Advanced skills in SQL and Python for data querying and processing. * Proficiency with Tableau for building interactive dashboards and visualizations. * Familiarity with modern data governance and security practices. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Experience with ETL applications, or other modern data platforms. * Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices for data deployments. * Familiarity with data cataloging and metadata management tools. * Microsoft and/or AWS certifications (e.g., Azure Data Engineer, AWS Certified Data Analytics). **BENEFITS \& PERKS:** Aligned Data Centers is proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package to support the health, well\-being, and financial security of our team members. jobs.title: Software Engineer – Enterprise Applications
jobs.description: **Company Overview** *ACS (Allen Control Systems) is a defense technology company building precision robotic systems for the United States and its allies. Founded by two former U.S. Navy electrical engineers with deep experience in robotics and software, ACS brings together AI, computer vision, precision motion, and advanced hardware to solve complex defense challenges across land, air, and maritime environments.* *Our flagship product, Bullfrog, is an autonomous precision weapon system that transforms existing weapons into highly accurate counter\-drone systems — giving warfighters a scalable, cost\-effective response to one of the fastest\-growing threats on the modern battlefield. Bullfrog is deployed with U.S. forces, and ACS works with organizations throughout the U.S. military and national security community.* *Following a $200 million Series B at a $2\.2 billion valuation, ACS is rapidly expanding manufacturing, accelerating Bullfrog deployments, and developing the next generation of autonomous battlefield systems. This is an opportunity to join a proven, fast\-moving team and help scale technology with direct, real\-world impact on national security.* *ACS is headquartered in Austin, Texas, with additional operations in Alexandria, Virginia; Mountain View, California; and Huntsville, Alabama. For more information, visit* *allencontrolsystems.com**.* **Position Overview:** We are seeking a motivated **Software Engineer I/II to join our Enterprise Applications team.** In this role, you will help develop, enhance, and support internal and business\-facing applications that enable critical operations across the organization. You will work alongside experienced engineers, business systems professionals, and cross\-functional stakeholders to build software solutions, integrate enterprise platforms, troubleshoot issues, and improve existing applications. This is an excellent opportunity for an early\-career software engineer looking to gain hands\-on experience with enterprise systems and full\-stack development while continuing to grow their technical skills. **What You'll Do:** * Develop, test, and maintain applications and software components across the technology stack. * Enhance existing applications by implementing new features, resolving defects, and improving usability and performance. * Work with engineers and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions. * Build and maintain integrations between enterprise applications using APIs and other integration methods. * Support enterprise platforms such as Odoo ERP, workflow, and other internal business systems. * Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code following established development standards. * Troubleshoot application issues and assist with identifying root causes and implementing solutions. * Develop and maintain database queries, application logic, APIs, and user interfaces. * Participate in code reviews, testing, sprint planning, and other Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) activities. * Create and maintain technical documentation for applications, integrations, and development processes. * Learn and apply software engineering best practices related to testing, security, performance, and maintainability. * Collaborate with more experienced engineers and contribute ideas for improving applications and development processes. **What You'll Need:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 0–3 years of professional software development experience, including internships, co\-ops, academic projects, or equivalent hands\-on development experience. * Experience with at least one programming language such as Python, C\#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Node.js. * Familiarity with modern web development concepts and front\-end technologies such as React, Angular, Vue.js, HTML, CSS, or JavaScript/TypeScript. * Basic knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MySQL, including writing SQL queries. * Familiarity with REST APIs and basic application integration concepts. * Experience using version control tools such as Git. * Understanding of fundamental software development concepts, including testing, debugging, object\-oriented programming, and source control. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with an eagerness to learn new technologies. * Ability to communicate effectively and collaborate with both technical and non\-technical team members. **You'll Stand Out:** * Internship, academic, or professional experience developing business or enterprise applications. * Exposure to ERP, CRM, manufacturing, workflow automation, or other enterprise systems. * Experience with Python and PostgreSQL. * Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps concepts. * Experience working with APIs or integrating multiple applications. * Familiarity with Docker or containerized applications. * Basic understanding of application security concepts such as authentication, authorization, and data protection. * Experience working in an Agile or Scrum development environment. * Interest in learning how software supports business processes across areas such as manufacturing, supply chain, finance, engineering, and operations. **Leveling** This position may be hired as a Software Engineer I or Software Engineer II depending on the candidate's experience and demonstrated technical capabilities. * **Software Engineer I** candidates are expected to have foundational software development skills and will work with guidance from more experienced team members while developing their technical and enterprise application knowledge. * **Software Engineer II** candidates are expected to demonstrate greater independence in developing, troubleshooting, and delivering software solutions and may take ownership of smaller applications, integrations, or technical workstreams. **What We Offer:** * Competitive salary * ACS Equity Package * Health, Dental, Vision Insurance * Paid Time Off *Allen Control Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer, providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. Allen Control Systems prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Core Trading
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** **Alpaca is a US\-headquartered, global leader in agent\-first brokerage infrastructure** for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more. Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional\-grade APIs. This includes broker\-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts. Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open\-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award\-winning, developer\-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it. **Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top\-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.** **Our Team Members:** We're a dynamic team of 400\+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond! We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. ### **Your Role:** Your job is to build Alpaca's algo trading platform to satisfy our users who expect high quality and performance from their brokerage service. This opportunity is similar to joining AWS or Heroku in their early days, designing and architecting our platform by wearing many different hats in our small team. As an experienced engineer, you will write tons of code and make critical decisions about delivering the best experience to our customers. This certainly requires deep knowledge in both frontend and backend, databases and distributed systems, as well as broad experience from low to high level in CPU\-level hardware for high throughput, robust concurrency system design, abstract distributed system architecture for high availability and object\-oriented data modeling with long term growth in mind. Joining an early stage startup, the payoff to this highly demanding environment will be worth the effort. **Who You Are (Must\-Haves):** * Strong, experienced software engineer with lead experience is preferred * Coding skills in both low and high level languages around Go, C/C\+\+ * Low latency and high throughput optimization * Experience with messaging queues and message brokers * Analytical data\-oriented mindset and skills * Knowledge of algorithms, distributed systems, scalability, high availability, databases, low latency systems and concurrency control * Experience with highly scalable distributed low latency systems. * System design skills with object\-oriented data modeling, service\-oriented architectures, system abstraction **Who You Might Be (Nice\-to\-Haves):** * Algo trading experience (either professional or personal) * Experience with the development and implementation of Order Management systems (OMS) and Risk Management systems (RMS) * FIX protocol knowledge * Experience with trading or exchange systems (OMS, EMS, exchanges, market making, algorithmic trading, quant trading) * Experience with observability, tracing, continuous profiling and benchmarking * Financial market (exchange, broker\-dealers, clearing, etc.) knowledge * Experience with financial ledgers * Statistical and quantitative analysis skills * Experience with major cloud platforms (we primarily use GCP) * Experience with Docker and Kubernetes ### **How We Take Care of You:** * Competitive Salary \& Stock Options * Health Benefits * New Hire Home\-Office Setup: One\-time USD $500 * Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card *Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.* *Recruitment Privacy Policy*

jobs.title: GenAI/ML Specialist Solutions Architect, AGS Specialist Solutions Architects
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and comprehensive support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow. Are you passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and GenerativeAI? Are you passionate about helping customers build solutions leveraging the state\-of\-the\-art AI/ML/GenAI tools on Amazon Web Service (AWS)? Come join us! At Amazon, we’ve been investing deeply in artificial intelligence for over 20 years, and many of the capabilities customers experience in our products are driven by machine learning. Amazon.com’s recommendations engine is driven by machine learning (ML), as are the paths that optimize robotic picking routes in our fulfillment centers. Our supply chain, forecasting, and capacity planning are also informed by ML algorithms. Alexa is fueled by Natural Language Understanding and Automated Speech Recognition deep learning; as is Prime Air, and the computer vision technology in our new retail experience, Amazon Go. We have thousands of engineers at Amazon committed to machine learning and deep learning, and it’s a big part of our heritage. Within AWS, we’re focused on bringing that knowledge and capability to customers through layers of the AI stack: 1\) API\-driven Inference Services like Amazon Bedrock 2\) Agentic AI including Agentic platforms, tool usage, evaluations, governance and cost management along with use of Agentic SDKs such as Strands and platforms such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 3\) Frameworks and Infrastructure with tools like Pytorch and TensorFlow, 2\) Machine Learning Platforms such as Amazon SageMaker for data scientists, and, k to quickly add intelligence to applications with simple API calls. AWS is looking for a Machine Learning Solutions Architect (ML SA), who will be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for helping customers in the AMERICAS design solutions that leverage our ML services. As part of the team, you will work closely with ISV(Independent Software Vendors) to enable large\-scale use cases, design ML pipelines, and drive the adoption of AWS for the AI/ML platforms. You will interact with other SAs in the field, providing guidance on their customer engagements, and you will develop white papers, blogs, reference implementations, and presentations to enable customers to fully leverage AI/ML on AWS. Additionally, as the voice of the customer, you will work closely with the service teams, and submit product feature requests to drive the platform forward. You must have deep technical experience working with technologies related to Generative AI, machine learning and/or deep learning. A strong mathematics and statistics background is preferred in addition to experience building complex machine learning models. You will be familiar with the ecosystem of software vendors in the GenAI space, and will leverage this knowledge to help AWS customers in their selection process. If you are a qualified and accepted candidate, you may work out of any of the following cities: San Jose, Los Angeles, Denver, Chicago, Austin, Dallas, Atlanta, Arlington. Travel up to 50% across the USA may be possible. Key job responsibilities Working with customers’ development and data science teams to deeply understand their business and technical needs. After understanding their needs, you will design solutions that make the best use of the AWS cloud platform and AWS AI/ML Services including SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon AgentCore, Amazon Rekognition, Amazon Transcribe, Amazon Quick, Amazon Personalize, and other AI/ML services. * Partner with SAs, Sales, Business Development and the AI/ML Service teams to accelerate customer adoption and revenue attainment in the AMERICAS for Amazon SageMaker and related services that support GenAI use cases. * Thought Leadership – Evangelize AWS ML services and share best practices through forums such as AWS blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures and public\-speaking events such as AWS Summit, AWS re:Invent, etc. * Act as a technical liaison between customers and the AWS SageMaker or other service teams to provide customer driven product improvement feedback. * Develop and support an AWS internal community of GenAI related subject matter experts in the AMERICAS. About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AW eams bring to everything we do. Mentorship \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 2\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience * 4\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience working within software development or Internet\-related industries * Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud * Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits. jobs.title: Software Development Manager, AWS IoT (Physical AI)
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use. AWS IoT is building the infrastructure to deliver AI from the cloud to the physical world. The Physical AI team develops services that provision, deploy, monitor, and secure AI software across processors inside autonomous machines, including robots, vehicles, drones, agricultural equipment, and industrial workcells, operating in environments with limited or no cloud connectivity. We are looking for a Software Development Manager to build and lead the team behind edge\-first fleet management for Physical AI. Your team owns software that runs on embedded processors inside autonomous machines and the cloud control plane that orchestrates them, coordinating deployments across hierarchical, heterogeneous processor topologies that often operate entirely offline. You will lead engineers writing production C\+\+ and Rust for local artifact caching, cryptographic verification, peer discovery over link\-local networks, and coordinated over\-the\-air updates across nested processor hierarchies, and you will own the cloud services that track fleet state when the fleet is not reachable. Physical AI is a new business for AWS, so you will define the platform while you build it, hire the team that builds it, and decide what the team does not build. This is a rare chance to lead where cloud services meet physical machines, shipping software that keeps autonomous systems running safely in the real world. The Physical AI team within AWS IoT is focused on delivering intelligence to every processor inside autonomous machines at scale. We build the services that provision, deploy, and secure AI software across robots, vehicles, drones, and industrial equipment worldwide. Our work sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and embedded systems, and we partner closely with other AWS IoT teams to push what is possible in disconnected, resource\-constrained environments. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every engineer's voice matters and new ideas are welcomed. Key job responsibilities Lead a team of cloud and embedded engineers building the edge runtime and control plane for Physical AI fleet management, including artifact caching, peer discovery, coordinated OTA across nested processor hierarchies, and fleet state reconciliation after long disconnection. Hire, develop, and retain engineers from L4 through L6, and build a team where cloud engineers ramp on embedded systems and embedded engineers ramp on distributed systems. Own the roadmap from ambiguous problem statements through launch, and scale the platform from early adopters to global fleets of autonomous machines across every AWS region. Drive deployment reliability on hardware that is physically accessible and routinely offline, where a failed update reaches machines that move and rollback has to work without a network round trip. Own the security architecture for software and model distribution, including signed artifacts, secure OTA (TUF and Uptane), and hardware root of trust (TPM, secure boot, attestation) on devices an attacker can hold. Own operational excellence for physical fleets, including oncall, alarming, release discipline, and the version and security posture of every processor in the field. Partner with client teams across AWS IoT, applied science, and robotics, and with silicon and OEM partners whose attestation and boot primitives the security model depends on. jobs.title: Sr Software Development Engineer - AgentCore, AWS Agentic AI
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is building the foundational services developers use to create, deploy, and operate production\-ready AI agents securely at scale. Our team owns the developer experience across AgentCore—from a developer's first interaction through building, testing, deploying, and operating agents in production. This includes the AgentCore CLI, SDKs, infrastructure\-as\-code tooling, console experiences, configuration models, deployment workflows, and other interfaces through which developers use AgentCore. We bring the capabilities of AgentCore Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity, Observability, Browser, Code Interpreter, Evaluations, and other services together into a coherent experience. Our broader portfolio also includes AgentCore harness and new developer\-facing service offerings planned for AWS re:Invent 2026 and beyond. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to set the team's technical vision and lead its architecture. You will determine how developers interact with AgentCore across local development, configuration, deployment, testing, and production operations. You will turn ambiguous customer needs into durable technical designs and lead the delivery of capabilities that make sophisticated agent systems easier to build and operate. You will work directly with principal engineers, product managers, and engineering leaders across AgentCore service teams. You will establish consistent abstractions and APIs, shape cross\-service contracts, and make architectural decisions that affect the complete AgentCore development lifecycle. The technical challenges span both developer tooling and distributed systems. You will design configuration and resource models, SDK and CLI abstractions, infrastructure constructs, console workflows, deployment automation, and diagnostic experiences. You will address problems involving cross\-service orchestration, permissions and resource wiring, API evolution, state management, versioning, reliability, scalability, and the consistency of experiences across multiple interfaces. A central part of this role is serving as a voice of the customer for some of AgentCore's most impactful features. You will work backward from how developers actually build agents, identify friction across service boundaries, and ensure that developer experience is considered early in product and architecture decisions—not added after individual services have been designed. You will help determine which complexities AgentCore should manage automatically, where customers need explicit control, and how developers can move between guided workflows and advanced customization. This may include simplifying tool and memory integration, automating permissions and resource wiring, shortening the local build\-test\-deploy loop, improving operational diagnostics, introducing richer templates and skills, and creating safer ways to evaluate and release agent changes. As a senior engineer, you will lead complex, cross\-team initiatives from concept through production, make long\-term architectural decisions, and raise the engineering bar through implementation, design reviews, and mentorship. You will be expected to influence beyond the team's immediate codebase and help define what a high\-quality agent development experience should look like on AWS. Key job responsibilities * Set the technical direction and architecture for the AgentCore developer experience across APIs, SDKs, CLI, console, infrastructure as code, and local development workflows. * Design cohesive abstractions, configuration models, and workflows that bring AgentCore services together into a consistent end\-to\-end experience. * Lead the design and delivery of new developer\-facing services and capabilities, from early concepts through production launch and operation. * Simplify how developers connect models, tools, MCP servers, memory, identity, and custom environments using intuitive defaults, templates, and automation. * Shorten the build\-test\-evaluate\-deploy loop while preserving the control and extensibility advanced builders need. * Design jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager - Open Source, Kiro
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Kiro Labs is the public home for community\-built projects in the Kiro ecosystem \- a GitHub organization where Amazon engineers, and over time trusted external contributors, publish the experimental tools, SDKs, MCP servers, CLI extensions, and skill libraries they build on top of Kiro. Thousands of engineers already build for Kiro every day. Almost none of that work has left the building. Kiro Labs is how we open it up: a governed but deliberately low\-friction path that moves internal innovation into the open, where a broader community of developers can find it, use it, and build on it. We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to build that program. You'll own the mechanisms that turn Kiro Labs from a promising side effort into a durable, scalable incubator: the publishing pipeline, the governance model, the lifecycle, and the metrics. You'll be the connective tissue across the Kiro product team, open source strategy, security, legal, marketing, and customer success \- diving deep enough technically to understand what contributors are building, and program\-managing well enough to get it shipped and keep the org healthy. Key job responsibilities \- Own the publishing pipeline end to end \- Design and run the intake process that takes a project from proposal to public repo fit review, security review, license and trademark review, and repo creation \- and relentlessly drive down time\-to\-publish. \- Build the governance model \- Stand up the review committee, define the fit, quality, and security bar, establish decision rights and response SLAs, and document the entire workflow. \- Manage cross\-functional dependencies and unblock contributors \- Coordinate across product, open source strategy, security, legal/IP, marketing, and customer success. Own the critical path, clear blockers, and give contributors a single, obvious place to get answers. \- Own project lifecycle and org health \- Define and operate the active, maintenance, and archived states, health monitoring, and the sunset process, so Kiro Labs stays a curated set of working tools rather than a graveyard of abandoned repos. \- Define and report on success \- Establish the program's KPIs \- projects published, external engagement (stars, forks, issues, and PRs from outside Amazon), projects that graduate to broad adoption, time\-to\-publish, and growth in external awareness of Kiro and report progress, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leadership. \- Scale the operation \- Introduce automated quality and health checks, write the SOPs, and reduce manual effort so the program runs on mechanisms About the team Kiro Labs sits at the intersection of product, customer success, engineering, and open source for Kiro. It's the external\-facing complement to a thriving internal builder culture: the place where the tools Amazon engineers build on Kiro reach a public audience, and where a nascent external community can start to form around the product. This role brings together partners who have each carried a piece of it \- open source strategy, the Kiro product team, marketing, and customer success \- under a single program owner accountable for making it work. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience * 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience * Experience managing programs across cross\-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules * Experience presenting metrics and progress to goal to senior leadership **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience developing and implementing KPI goals and strategies based on broader organization goals * 3\+ years of software development experience, or Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent * Experience running open source or developer community programs, including GitHub organization administration, open source release and compliance processes, and open source licensing Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) team is seeking a dedicated, skilled, and innovative Applied Science Manager with a robust background in machine learning, statistics, quality assurance, auditing methodologies, and automated evaluation systems to lead a team ensuring the highest standards of data quality, to build industry\-leading technology with Large Language Models (LLMs) and multimodal systems. jobs.title: Engineering Operation Technician
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission\-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99\.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently. Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands\-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand\-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, \& motors. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H\-1B, TN, and other non\-immigrant visas, for this role. NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position. Key job responsibilities * Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability * Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS) * Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack\-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA) * Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA * Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment * Technical writing to support change management program * Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion * On\-site support of contractors, sub\-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures \& local legislation * Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12\-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on\-call rotations. * Role may support more than one location/site. Physical Requirements: Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations: * Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently * Participate in group lifts for 40\+ pounds * Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder * Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position * Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational. Essential Requirements: * Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed * Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational * Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs. A day in the life This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands\-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission\-critical data center facility equipment including stand\-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment. About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion of events fosters stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. Mentorship \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship, and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 1\+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience * Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays * 1\+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1\+ years of mechanical facilities **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 2\+ years of data center engineering experience * Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings * Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The starting pay for this position is listed below. Final starting pay will be based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Starting Day 1 of employment, Amazon offers EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, 401(k) matching. Learn more about our benefits at https://hiring.amazon.com/why\-amazon/benefits. USA, NV, Sparks \- 32\.88 \- 57\.50 USD hourly

That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Experience with network hardware: copper and optical fiber cabling, switches, routers * Experience in project management * 1\+ years of data center, critical environment, computer hardware repair, infrastructure cabling, network deployment, or data center operations experience **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 2\+ years of data center, critical environment, computer hardware repair, infrastructure cabling, network deployment, or data center operations experience * Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system * Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure * Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our ad solutions—including sponsored, display, video, and custom ads—leverage Amazon’s innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage intended audiences throughout their daily journeys. With a range of flexible pricing and buying models, including self\-service, managed service, and programmatic ad buying, these solutions help businesses build brand awareness, increase product sales, and more. We are looking for a Senior Software Developer with a passion for dealing with internet scale datasets to work on Amazon's Analytics, Forecasting and Optimization Platform for advertising. Our platform is used across Amazon by a variety of advertising programs including Display, Video, Mobile and Kindle. Our team builds end\-to\-end solutions including data pipelines, large scale index data structures, time series models, software services and large scale data visualizations. Our systems are based on a mix of AWS and third\-party technologies, using ones that make the best sense in a given scenario. Key job responsibilities * Own backend data pipelines, indexing systems and service \& API layer application support. * Work closely with a group of highly talented and motivated software and data science engineers who build systems and models used to analyze petabytes of data * Build systems and models to analyze supply and demand side of our advertising business and devise optimization methods. * Work on analyzing exchange bidding behavior, time series modeling, optimal inventory allocation and many other exciting problems posed by a advertising business * Invent ways to overcome technical limitations and enable new forms of analyses that drive key business decisions * Investigate new technologies and champion adoption within the team * Work on a platform that spans Hadoop, Map/Reduce, Pig, FastBit, Redshift, and S3 using programming languages such as Java, C\+\+ and Python * Mentor junior team members * Directly participate in setting the vision and objectives for strategic Amazon goals, in alignment with business needs and ad market dynamics. * Find new ways to use variety of Amazon's data sets to help one of the fastest growing businesses within Amazon **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 8\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 8\+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience * 8\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * 4\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution * Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent * Experience in debugging, profiling, and implementing software engineering best practices in large\-scale systems * Experience with and deep understanding of advertising technologies (i.e., ad server, DSP) Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits. USA, CA, Palo Alto \- 193,300\.00 \- 261,500\.00 USD annually USA, NY, New York \- 184,900\.00 \- 250,200\.00 USD annually

jobs.title: System Engineer I
jobs.description: **System Engineer I** ===================== **Join Our Team** ----------------- We are seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented **System Engineer I** to join our IT Infrastructure team. This role is ideal for an early\-career systems professional who is passionate about technology, server administration, and maintaining reliable computing environments. You will play a key role in supporting, monitoring, and optimizing Windows and Unix\-based systems while helping ensure system performance, availability, and security across the organization. **What You'll Do** ------------------ As a Systems Engineer I, you will: * Install, configure, maintain, and support Windows and/or Unix\-based operating systems, hardware, and related utilities. * Troubleshoot and resolve system hardware and software issues. * Monitor server performance and system activities to ensure optimal operation and security. * Fine\-tune system parameters and configurations to improve efficiency and reliability. * Perform capacity planning and analysis, including monitoring and managing disk space utilization. * Develop and maintain operational procedures for routine administration tasks, including system backups, restores, startups, and shutdowns. * Identify opportunities to improve the server environment by recommending enhancements related to capacity management, security, patch management, and hardware lifecycle planning. * Participate in system integration testing and support infrastructure projects as assigned. * Follow company policies, procedures, and ethical standards while supporting our mission and values. * Maintain consistent attendance and collaboration with team members to ensure timely completion of responsibilities. * Perform additional duties as assigned. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- ### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related field; **or** * One to two years of related systems administration or engineering experience; **or** * An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience. ### **Preferred Skills** * Working knowledge of Windows Server and/or Unix/Linux operating systems. * Familiarity with server hardware, operating system administration, and troubleshooting methodologies. * Understanding of system performance monitoring, security best practices, and disaster recovery concepts. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent organizational, communication, and documentation abilities. * Ability to prioritize tasks and work effectively in a team\-oriented environment. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- * Opportunity to build your systems engineering career with hands\-on experience. * Exposure to enterprise\-level infrastructure and technologies. * Collaborative and supportive team environment. * Professional development and growth opportunities. * Competitive compensation and benefits package. If you're ready to launch or advance your career in systems engineering and make an impact in a dynamic technology environment, we'd love to hear from you. **Apply today and become part of our growing team!** **\#corp** Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.
