jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI, Agentic Applications, Enterprise Integration
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **Senior Software Engineer – AI, Agentic Applications, Enterprise Integration** ***Building Modern Enterprise \& AI Solutions*** At Ashurst Perkins Coie US LLP, technology plays a critical role in delivering exceptional client service and supporting the firm’s business operations. We’re looking for a **hands\-on Software Engineer** to design, build, and support enterprise applications, integrations, APIs, and AI\-powered solutions across our Microsoft and Azure technology environment. The ideal candidate is a **full\-stack engineer with a strong foundation in C\# and .NET, strong Python development skills, and hands\-on experience building modern AI and agentic applications.** This role offers the opportunity to work across software engineering, cloud, data, and AI technologies to develop solutions that solve real business problems and support the firm’s evolving technology needs. **Key Responsibilities** * **Design, develop, test, deploy, and support** enterprise applications, APIs, integrations, and AI‑powered solutions. * **Build and maintain back‑end services** using C\#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Python, and FastAPI, as well as **modern front‑end components** using JavaScript/TypeScript and React. * **Design and develop secure, scalable REST APIs** and integrate enterprise applications, data platforms, and third\-party services. * **Build and integrate AI\-powered applications** using Azure AI, generative AI, Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, AI agents, and related technologies. * **Develop data and knowledge retrieval solutions** \*\* using SQL, Databricks, data virtualization, and enterprise data platforms. * **Deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize applications in Microsoft Azure** , using services such as Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, Azure Key Vault, and Azure Storage. * **Implement modern software engineering practices** , including Git\-based development, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, Docker/containerization, monitoring, and secure deployment practices. * **Collaborate with architects, engineers, data teams, business stakeholders, and end users** to understand requirements and deliver reliable, scalable technology solutions. * **Create clear technical documentation** and contribute to architecture, security, performance, code quality, and continuous process improvement. **What You’ll Bring** * **Strong professional experience in software development** , with proficiency in C\#, .NET, Python, REST APIs, SQL, and modern software engineering practices. * **Hands\-on experience building and deploying applications in Microsoft Azure** , with an understanding of cloud\-based application architecture. * **Experience with ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, FastAPI, Git, CI/CD, Docker, and relational databases.** * **Practical experience developing AI\-powered applications** , including generative AI, Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, prompt development, model integration, or related technologies. * **Strong understanding of application security and integration** , including authentication, authorization, API security, cloud architecture, and integration with enterprise systems. * **Ability to work across back‑end, front‑end, data, and AI technologies** to design and deliver reliable, production\-ready solutions. * **Strong problem\-solving, communication, documentation, and collaboration skills** , with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * **Ability to take ownership of projects end\-to\-end** , from understanding requirements and designing solutions through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support. * **Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.** **Preferred Qualifications** * **Experience with enterprise and AI technologies** such as Azure AI Foundry, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Denodo, React, GraphQL, SSRS, vector databases, or Kubernetes. * **Experience designing and building agentic AI applications,** including hands\-on experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar AI integration and orchestration technologies. * **Microsoft Azure certifications\*\*,** such as Azure Developer Associate (AZ\-204\) or Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI\-102\). * **Experience working in a professional services or law firm environment,** with an understanding of the unique technology, security, data, and workflow requirements of these organizations. **Why Join Ashurst Perkins Coie?** Join a collaborative, technology\-driven team where software engineering and AI are helping shape the future of the firm. This role offers the opportunity to build meaningful enterprise solutions, work with emerging AI technologies, and directly contribute to innovative tools and services that support attorneys, clients, and business operations. *This position is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, 401(k) plan, medical, dental, and vision insurance, accrued paid time off plan starting at 20 days annually, personal medical and parental leave, up to ten paid holidays, and family care benefits.**.* *This position may be filled in the following locations.* ***The listed compensation range reflects the typical pay for this role, though it is rare for new hires to receive an offer at the top of the range.*** *Actual compensation may vary depending on experience, skills, market conditions, and internal equity.* *Colorado compensation range: $126,800 to $200,950 annually* *Illinois compensation range: $133,820 to $212,080 annually* *Washington state compensation range: $133,750 to $211,970 annually* *Washington, D.C., compensation range: $144,450 to $228,930 annually* *\#LI\-Hybrid*

jobs.title: Data Science Intern - Summer 2027 - Bedford, MA
jobs.description: The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community. **The Role** ------------ As part of Emerson Electric, AspenTech is a global leader in industrial software, delivering advanced asset optimization solutions for capital\-intensive industries. With a presence around the world, we are uniquely positioned to drive innovation and sustainability across energy, chemical, manufacturing, and infrastructure sectors. With origins at MIT over 40 years ago, AspenTech has continually pushed the boundaries of what’s possible in optimization technology. Now, as a key innovation engine within Emerson, our Technology organization includes more than 1,300 experts in performance engineering, subsurface science, manufacturing and supply chain, digital grid management, and asset performance monitoring. Joining this team means transforming cutting\-edge ideas into impactful solutions used by hundreds of thousands of professionals globally—shaping the future of industry through technology. As a Data Science Intern in our AI Technology Group, you bring deep technical expertise in build the next generation of Asset Performance Monitoring AI technology. We are looking for sharp, disciplined, and highly quantitative individuals who have a passion for playing with complex data and cutting\-edge technologies, in all its forms, including data mining, mathematical modeling, cognitive computing and expert systems. You will leverage your skills and passion for Machine Learning, AI and Cognitive Computing to drive innovations in AspenTech’s software platforms.**Your Impact** --------------- * Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and software developers to develop new machine learning applications for the manufacturing and process industries * Collaborate with customers, product managers and technical staff to develop technology strategies to promote continuous innovation in our Engineering Design and Simulation offerings * Investigate new and developing technologies as they appear in industry and academia and determine how to leverage these new technologies into our software applications * Provide thought leadership and represent AspenTech at industry and academic meetings and conferences **What You'll Need** -------------------- * **Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Operation Research, or a related major; PhD candidates preferred** * 5\+ years of experience in data analysis and software development/programming with one or more of Python, C\+\+/C and C\# * Strong expertise required in engineering mathematics, statistics and optimization * Demonstrated experience with machine learning algorithms (regression, semi\-supervised learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, time series analysis, predictive modeling, data mining, cognitive computing) * Experience with LLM, generative AI, MLops, Graph Knowledge, and/or cloud technologies is a plus * History of publishing research and results in the ML field * Participated in the design, development, evaluation, and deployment of scalable data\-driven models and analytical solutions for machine learning application * Problem\-solving ability and attention to details * Demonstrated ability to use scientific research to deliver value to customers and are motivated to deliver results in a fast\-paced environment * Excellent interpersonal, communication, writing, and presentation skills * Demonstrated ability to convey complex information in a clear and concise manner **Hourly Internship Pay Rate:** $40\.00 \- $50\.00 **Work Location:** Aspen Technology has a global hybrid workplace for most of our roles. Employees are expected to work in the office 4 days per week and may work remotely 1 day per week, unless the employee has a reasonable accommodation or other approved exception to the hybrid workplace schedule. Our Internship role is based in our global headquarters in Bedford, MA. **Work Authorization** AspenTech will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F\-1(including those with OPT or CPT) , H\-1, H\-2, L\-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description: ### **Why AssemblyAI** AssemblyAI builds the best\-in\-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. Our models serve 600M\+ inference calls monthly, process 1M\+ hours of audio daily, and power 2 billion\+ end\-user experiences. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we're looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry. We are one of the most capital\-efficient AI companies on the planet \- with under 100 people generating roughly $500K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue\-dense teams within the fastest\-growing AI companies today. That's not an accident; it's a deliberate choice to stay lean, move fast, and give every person on the team outsized ownership and impact. With thousands of customers including Granola, Fireflies, Figure AI, and CallRail, the company has real scale \- processing over 2 million hours of audio daily and handling more than 1 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth\-stage opportunity where the business is proven and the trajectory is steep, but the team is still small enough that your fingerprints are on everything. If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow\-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name. We're committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. No matter your race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply! **About the role:** ------------------- We're looking for AssemblyAI's founding Enterprise Account Executive to own a book of strategic accounts and drive revenue across AssemblyAI's Voice AI infrastructure offerings. This person will generate pipeline in target accounts, develop strong champions, lead model evaluations, and win over enterprise engineering and product leaders. The ideal candidate has a strong background in enterprise infrastructure or API sales, thrives on building pipeline from scratch, and is energized by working with technical buyers on products that win on performance and developer experience. This is a cross\-functional role that requires close partnership with Applied AI, Research, Engineering, Marketing, and Deployment to shape go\-to\-market strategy and deliver an exceptional customer experience from first touch through deployment and beyond. **What You'll Do:** ------------------- * Own a book of enterprise accounts, leading potential customers across the full sales cycle from prospecting through initial production rollout * Generate pipeline through proactive, creative outbound \- including personalized outreach, conferences, exclusive events, and finding warm introductions * Craft outbound communications that deliver real value to prospects \- custom benchmarks, competitive insights, use\-case\-specific demos that earn replies * Develop authentic champions within target accounts who advocate for AssemblyAI internally and help shepherd deals to close * Engage multiple leadership stakeholders in parallel \- CTO, CPO, VP Engineering, VP Product, VP of AI, and other technical decision\-makers \- to build consensus and de\-risk deals * Position AssemblyAI's value and pricing against alternatives with clear, quantitative and qualitative differentiation * Drive urgency through business value at every touchpoint, keeping deals moving forward with intent * Quarterback complex, multi\-threaded deals \- bringing insights, perspective, and momentum to every customer interaction * Partner closely with Customer and Technology Teams to represent the enterprise voice of the customer and shape go\-to\-market strategy **What You'll Need:** --------------------- * 4\+ years of enterprise infrastructure or API sales experience closing large deals with engineering and product audiences * A track record of building pipeline from scratch \- experience breaking into cold accounts and creating opportunities where none existed * Technical fluency \- comfortable discussing API architectures, model accuracy tradeoffs, and deployment options with engineers and technical decision\-makers * Demonstrated ability to identify and develop champions who advocate internally on your behalf * A high sense of urgency and ownership; you move deals forward and don't let them go stale * Comfort selling in a frictionless, product\-led motion where customers stay because the product wins * Deep understanding of enterprise procurement, legal, and security review processes, with the ability to drive velocity through complex commercial cycles * A willingness to travel to drive impact \- expect to be on the road 50%\+ of each month for customer visits, industry events, and team offsites **Pay Transparency:** AssemblyAI strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity across our team. Our salary ranges are set to be competitive for our size, stage, and industry, and reflect just one component of the full compensation, benefits, and rewards we offer. Salary determinations consider a variety of factors, including relevant experience, technical depth, skills demonstrated during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below represents a general expectation for the posted position. However, we are open to considering candidates who may fall above or below the outlined experience level—in those cases, we will communicate any adjustments to the expected salary range. The range provided applies to candidates located in the **United States**. For candidates outside of the U.S., compensation ranges may differ; any adjustments will be communicated throughout the interview process. **Salary range: $300,000 \- $370,000** The expected total compensation for this role is listed above (including base salary and commission). Our total compensation package includes competitive equity grants, 100% employer\-paid benefits, and working alongside the team in our San Francisco or New York City office. A 401k match up to 4% is offered to all US\-based full time team members. ### **AI to Interview:** If you're selected for an interview, please review this resource to better understand how AssemblyAI approaches the use of AI in our interview process. ### **GDPR privacy notice:** Candidates from the EU should review this job applicant privacy notice before applying. ### **Keep Exploring AssemblyAI:** Speech\-to\-text \| Streaming speech\-to\-text \| Speech Understanding \| LLM Gateway Try the Playground Our $50M Series C fundraise Check us out on YouTube!

You have owned production automations end to end: APIs, webhooks, scheduled jobs, retries, error handling, and monitoring. * Experience building with LLMs beyond a single prompt: multi\-step agents, tool use, retrieval, and evaluation. You use Claude Code or similar tools daily, and you have the engineering judgment to review, test, and stand behind what they produce. * Solid fundamentals: clean code, version control, code review, debugging, and a habit of thinking in systems. You do not need an engineering team to ship. * Curiosity about how a sales org works. You don't need a RevOps background, but you need to care about how deals get found and closed, and be willing to learn our CRM and the tools around it quickly. * A builder's mindset with an operator's judgment: you scope for business impact, ship iteratively, and measure results in pipeline and revenue. * Low ego, high ownership, and comfort being the single\-threaded owner of an entire domain. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Hands\-on Salesforce or other CRM work at the object and API level, or experience with enrichment and outbound tools like Clay. * dbt, BigQuery, and Looker, or an equivalent warehouse and BI stack. * Time at a developer\-facing or API\-first company, or selling to technical buyers. * You've been the first engineer in a sales or growth org and built the function from scratch. ### **AI to Interview:** If you're selected for an interview, please review this resource to better understand how AssemblyAI approaches the use of AI in our interview process. ### **GDPR privacy notice:** Candidates from the EU should review this job applicant privacy notice before applying. ### **Keep Exploring AssemblyAI:** Speech\-to\-text \| Streaming speech\-to\-text \| Speech Understanding \| LLM Gateway Try the Playground Our $50M Series C fundraise Check us out on YouTube!

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern (PHX)
jobs.description: Join our Phoenix, AZ team as a **Software Engineering Intern**! Our internships are hands on, highly technical, and designed to let you see what it's like to work at Astronautics. This is a **paid** undergraduate intern opportunity. As an engineering intern, you will work closely with our engineering staff on actual customer projects. Our summer intern program consists of at least 10 weeks of real\-world experience in an engineering development environment. In addition to software engineering, we have an open opportunity in systems engineering this summer in our Phoenix office. Mentors are assigned to assist interns in achieving engineering related career development that is of mutual benefit to you and Astronautics. As a Software Engineering Intern, you will develop and maintain software in Primary Flight, Engine, and Multi\-function displays as well as in\-flight computing devices including Network Servers, Mission and Display Processors, Data Concentrator Units, and Flight Controls. You will work under the supervision of engineering managers and other experienced engineers to engage in all phases of software development including the following activities: * Participate in software development activities including requirement specification, design definition, and code implementation. * Perform software verification activities including test definition, test execution, and review of software lifecycle artifacts. * Integrate and debug executable code on avionics hardware platforms. * Generate software lifecycle documentation in support of the pursuit of formal certification of avionics software with the FAA and foreign certification authorities. **Desired Skills:** * Strong communication, analytical, organizational and problem\-solving skills * Ability to work effectively in a team environment * Capability of working independently with limited oversight from senior engineers **Education and Experience:** **Required Qualifications:** * Current accredited college or university enrollment with sophomore, junior or senior standing; making progress towards an undergraduate degree in Biomedical, Computer, Electrical, Software Engineering or Computer Science * Minimum cumulative grade point average of 2\.75 * Programming skills in C/C\+\+ * Working knowledge of software concepts, practices \& procedures * Proficient in Microsoft Office tools * Able to work full\-time onsite during the summer of 2027 * Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship **Desired Qualifications:** * Cumulative grade point average of 3\.0 or above * Experience with Python scripting * Experience in software debugging and troubleshooting * Capable of working independently with limited oversight from senior engineers * Ability to work part\-time during the school year **Who We Are:** Join a team that designs computers, displays, and electronic systems for aircraft of the future! At Astronautics, you will be part of a creative group of professionals who work on the cutting\-edge of technology. We offer competitive pay and the opportunity for professional growth in a friendly environment. Astronautics' key product areas include electronic primary flight and engine displays, connected aircraft and cyber solutions, electronic flight bags, and certified servers for airborne applications. Services include avionics system integration and custom software for critical applications. Since its founding in 1959, Astronautics has been providing trusted, reliable, and tailored solutions to help customers achieve mission success. Astronautics is the parent company of Kearfott Corporation, headquartered in Pine Brook, New Jersey. ***We are proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status.***

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Tax
jobs.description: **Who we are** Over 600 employees strong, Asure sees Human Capital Management (HCM) through the lens of entrepreneurs and executives with an owner’s mentality. We help businesses develop their “Human Capital” to get to the next level, stay compliant, and allocate their time, money and technology toward growth. Our HCM platform empowers more than 100,000 clients to build great teams and better manage their people while staying compliant in an ever\-changing HR legislative landscape. Asure’s HCM offering includes Payroll \& Tax, HR, and Time \& Attendance software and HR Services ranging from online compliance tools to a fully outsourced HR department. ***This is a hybrid position based in Dallas, TX. Candidates based in the Phoenix area will also be considered.*** **How you will contribute** As a Senior Software Engineer on our team, you will help the team in developing Cloud native applications, focusing on creating microservices for Tax. You will work closely with product owners, architects, and developers across the organization. You are up for the challenges of integrating greenfield development with existing infrastructure. Humble, passionate, collaborative, and entrepreneurial thriving in a dynamic and fast\-growing tech company. Work with our team on some of the world's top tech as we innovate the HCM industry. You are a part of a product application development team working on Payroll \& Tax, Time \& Attendance, and Human Resources. Actualizing our product roadmap, you own technical output. Providing empathy for our user base and collaboration with peers across the organization with: software engineering teams, product managers, operations and our executive team. You support the growth and success of our business through best\-in\-class software products for our clients. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop and maintain event driven cloud native HCM software * Develop and maintain full\-stack applications using .NET Core/Framework for backend and modern JavaScript frameworks (such as Vue.js, React, or Angular) for frontend development. * Design and implement RESTful APIs and microservices that are secure, scalable, and well\-documented * Maintain customer focus and understand your team's charter * Write and maintain unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests to ensure code quality and prevent regressions * Experience with application observability, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD tools * Collaborate with your team on best practices, effective code reviewing and continual process improvements * Contribute in scrum ceremonies including the daily stand up, backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint retrospectives and sprint review. Our technology stack: React, Vue.js, .NET Core/Framework, Telerik, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Cloud\-based infrastructure using Amazon Web Services (AWS), MS SQL Server, DynamoDB, and PostgreSQL. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software development related field, or similar work experience. * 8\+ years of work history in full stack production engineering experience, in a SaaS software environment * Experience with ORMs such as Entity Framework Core or Dapper * Strong hands\-on experience with .NET (Core/Framework) and cloud platforms (AWS preferred) * Experience designing and operating microservices in a container\-orchestrated environment * Familiarity with serverless architecture * Frontend expertise with Vue.js, React, Angular, or any other modern JavaScript framework. * Working knowledge of Database like RDBMS, NoSQL * AWS associate level certification is an advantage. **Compensation** The base salary range for this position is $120,000\-$140,000, based on relevant experience, skills, and industry knowledge. Asure Software offers a variety of employee benefits. Salary information is determined by market location and is provided in accordance with state and local pay\-transparency laws. Applicants should apply via www.asuresoftware.com/careers. **Benefits** * Medical, Dental, Vision, HSA, FSA\- All effective on day 1! * Company paid Basic Life Insurance, A\+D, Long\-Term Disability, and Short\-Term Disability * 401K Program with 3% safe harbor contribution * Employee Stock Purchase Program * Fitness Reimbursement Program * Self\-Managed PTO We are an equal opportunity employer. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the US, as we are unable to sponsor or transfer Visas at this time. Criminal background checks conducted at employment offer. NO AGENCIES PLEASE Any unsolicited resumes sent to Asure Software from a third party, such as an Agency, including unsolicited resumes sent to Asure’s mailing address, fax machine or email address, directly to employees or hiring managers will be considered Asure property. Asure will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 10 countries, and more than 170 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry\-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues. We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential. **Job Description** Avaloq's R\&D Lab is building a SaaS, API\-first, composable banking platform. As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer you will help build the reliability practice behind it. This is amongst the first technical roles we are hiring for our Fort Lauderdale site. You will partner with our Senior SRE in Zurich and work alongside our platform engineers and product teams. **The first three to six months:** Some of what you can expect early on: * Learning our AWS environment, our serverless platform, and how our product teams build and release * Contributing to the direction on observability tooling, together with the platform engineers, the SRE team, and our developers * Working with the Zurich team on the incident and on\-call operating model * Taking on increasing responsibility as you build context, always in alignment with the Zurich team **What you will do:** * Define and evolve SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets with product teams, and use them to drive reliability decisions * Collaborate on the design of our observability approach for a distributed serverless system, covering metrics, logs, and traces * Build the incident response practice with us: on\-call model, escalation, blameless post\-mortems, and the loop that turns findings into hardening work * Build reliability automation that detects and remediates issues before they reach clients * Improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation on GitHub Actions to reduce operational toil and release risk * Work with product teams on resilient design, capacity planning, and progressive delivery approaches such as canary and blue\-green * Contribute to disaster recovery design and testing for client\-facing environments * Partner with Security and Compliance so that operational practice holds up to regulatory and audit expectations * Help us define and implement operational readiness for client go\-live * Mentor colleagues and support a culture of shared operational ownership **Our stack:** Serverless\-first on AWS: Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, S3, and Bedrock. Terraform and OpenTofu for infrastructure, GitHub Actions for CI/CD. Product teams work in Rust, TypeScript, Python, Vue, and Angular. We do not run containers. **Qualifications** * 5\+ years in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or production operations for distributed cloud systems, with substantial hands\-on AWS experience * Practical experience defining and working with SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets * Strong incident response background, including on\-call, triage under pressure, and post\-mortem practice * A clear point of view on observability for distributed systems, and the reasoning behind it * Solid automation and scripting ability. We are language\-agnostic; Rust, TypeScript, or Python all work here * Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a pragmatic approach to balancing speed and stability **It would be a real bonus if you have:** * Experience with AWS serverless and event\-driven architecture, including idempotency, retries, dead\-letter queues, and failure handling. Strong AWS generalists who want to go deep here are welcome * Experience taking a platform from pre\-launch to production, including defining operational readiness criteria * Experience building AI agents to monitor platform health * Strong CI/CD background, ideally with GitHub Actions, including secrets management, least\-privilege permissions, and deployment controls * Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform or OpenTofu * Experience with progressive deployment approaches such as canary, blue\-green, or rollback automation * Disaster recovery design and testing for production SaaS * Experience operating across more than one cloud provider, or designing for portability * Experience operating a B2B SaaS platform in a regulated environment, including audit\-sensitive release processes * Familiarity with SOC 2, PCI DSS, or GDPR as they apply to operational practice * Experience with AI\-assisted engineering tools * AWS certification, particularly DevOps Engineer \- Professional, Solutions Architect \- Professional, or Security \- Specialty **Additional Information** **This role will require regular travel to Switzerland** We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices. In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self. We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way. Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

jobs.description: **Job Title:** **Construction Manager** --------------------------------------- Job \#: **2026\-16842** Location: **Front Royal, VA** Industry: **Manufacturing (Paint, Coatings, Chemicals)** Schedule: **1’st Shift (Days)** Salary: **Depends Upon Experience** Background: **Must be able to pass a Background Check \& Drug Test** Education: **High School Diploma (Minimum) Bachelors Degree preferred** **https://www.axalta.com/corporate/en\_US.html** (**Company Website Link**) **SUMMARY:** ------------ * The Construction Manager is responsible for managing the on\-site Axalta Construction Team at the Front Royal Site while also acting as a primary point of contact for non\-resident 3rd party construction contractors working at the Site. They ensure the safety of all construction activities on\-site through adherence to company policies and promoting a Goal Zero safety culture for their team. The Construction Manager will proactively communicate work schedules and scope to area teams and coordinate construction activities in such a way to minimize disruption to plant operations while maximizing construction resource efficiency. They will also assist in managing project and site costs by monitoring charge rates of the Axalta Construction Team and act as a primary reviewer of change orders from non\-resident 3rd party construction contractors. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** --------------------- * Work with Project Team Leads (PTLs) to plan, schedule, and coordinate construction activities to support project needs as well as larger business needs; Provide periodic updates on construction progress and assist PTLs in resolving issues that arise during construction. * Oversee construction activities for capital projects or significant maintenance projects that install new equipment or upgrade existing systems; Assist in delivering these projects safely, on time, and in\-budget. * Act as the de facto field administrator for capital project construction work at the Front Royal Site * Effectively lead the Axalta Front Royal Mechanical and Electrical Construction Crews with responsibility for all aspects of safety, quality and efficiency. * Ensure accurate charging of Axalta Construction Crews to capital projects and monitor charging rate as a contribution to Manufacturing Period Expense * Establish clear performance expectations, monitor, and provide periodic feedback to promote growth. * Consistently demonstrate strong interpersonal skills, integrity, and relationship management skills. * Motivate, influence, and positively affect / embrace / drive change. * Is responsible for coaching, counseling, career development and recognition of employees, as appropriate. * Monitors the performance of personnel and takes corrective action when necessary to maintain established company, site, or Axalta Way standards. * Strong written and oral communication skills to effectively collaborate to build solid business relationships with other functional areas that best supports customer and business objectives. * Exercise good analysis, problem\-solving and critical thinking skills. * Organize, prioritize and multi\-task while meeting and/or exceeding deadlines. * Participate in continuous improvement and Kaizen activities as needed. * Implementing and monitoring all construction related activities at the site as per approved drawings, methods, and safety rules. * Ensuring that all equipment systems are installed and functioning properly. * Coordinating with other engineers and contractors to ensure that all mechanical systems are integrated with other building systems. * Ability to follow established procedures and practices and read instruction, blueprints etc. * Participate in constructability reviews of proposed or approved capital projects during FEL or detailed design; provide feedback or identify **QUALIFICATIONS:** ------------------- **Education and/or Experience:** * High School Diploma minimum, but Bachelor’s Degree preferred or equivalent with 20\+ years related experience in Industrial Plant Maintenance or Industrial Construction, or equivalent combination of education and experience. * Previous people management experience required * Extensive experience with General Work/Hot Work/Confined Space Entry/Crane Lift permitting; preferably at Axalta * OSHA 30 training preferred **Computer Skills:** * Proficiency with Microsoft Suite (Word, Powerpoint, Excel, etc.) required * Experience with SAP required (maintenance or project transactions) * Proficiency with Microsoft Project (or similar) preferred **Other Qualifications:** * Strong project management capabilities: including planning, resource allocation, and schedule adherence. * Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of the organization. * Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios and proportions to practical situations. * Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables. * Supports and demonstrates One Axalta behaviors. **Physical Demands:** * Must be willing to work flexible work hours and overtime as needed. * Climbing on and working from fixed and portable ladders or scaffolds while wearing a safety harness. **Our Company:** Axalta has remained at the forefront of the coatings industry by continually investing in innovative solutions. We engineer technologies that protect customers’ products – whether they are battling heat, light, corrosion, abrasion, moisture, or chemicals – and add dimension and beauty with colorful finishes. We have a vast and ever\-evolving portfolio of brands primed to play an important part in everything from modernizing infrastructure around the world to enabling the next generation of electric and autonomous vehicles. Axalta operates its business in two segments: Performance Coatings and Mobility Coatings, which serve four end markets, including Refinish, Industrial, Light Vehicle and Commercial Vehicle, across North America, EMEA, Latin America and Asia\-Pacific. Our diverse global footprint allows us to deliver solutions in over 140\+ countries and coat 30 million vehicles per year. We’ve recently set an exciting 2040 carbon neutrality goal, in addition to 10 other sustainability initiatives, and we take pride in working with our customers to optimize their businesses and achieve their goals. jobs.title: Test Set Design Engineer I
jobs.description: **Job Description** At BAE Systems, we promote a strong, collaborative culture and provide our employees with the tools, skills and training they need to succeed. We are all about trust, camaraderie, and a shared mission on delivering world class products to our commercial and military customers. We offer a flexible hybrid work environment and 9/80 work schedule. Our company is part of the community, drives to improve our future, and protects our freedom. Are you a recent Electrical graduate with a couple of engineering internship experiences looking for the next step to grow your career? Do you want to design and test hardware that really matters and be a part of a cause greater than yourself? Then, help us protect those that protect us by maintaining vital defense products and developing Next Generation Electronic Systems Products and Solutions. We need your talent, motivation, and vision to join our growing teams. BAE Systems has recently been awarded new programs and is currently undergoing an exciting period of growth. As a Test Equipment Design Engineer, you will develop, upgrade, and maintain systems for testing products that support military and commercial aircraft and ground vehicles. You will join a cross\-functional group of professionals that are responsible for all aspects of test systems development including mechanical, electrical, software and fabrication. With our team, you will have the opportunity to utilize and develop your skills in a fast paced and exciting environment for a broad range of test systems from simple circuit card testers to very large and complex systems integration labs. We are looking for an Engineer with practical design, simulation, and integration experience to add to our team. This is an exciting opportunity to develop test systems to support products for some of the world’s most advanced military aircraft, sea, and ground vehicles. **In this Test Equipment Design Engineer position, you will make impacts in the following ways:** * Perform technical work that requires the application of engineering principles, theories, concepts, and techniques for the development of Test Equipment used to support the verification and acceptance testing of electronic assemblies and systems of varying technologies. * Consult with engineering specialists to devise new techniques and approaches and provide solutions to a wide range of technical problems dealing with the selection, design, and implementation of test strategies in support of acceptance and performance test methodologies. Make independent decisions based on available data, selection of materials and required parameters. * Work from technical objectives, overall schedules and expected results as specified by supervisor or senior engineering personnel. Support project segments for achievement of schedule, fiscal and technical performance objectives. * Support assignments that are broad and may include: + design and development of new test techniques + investigate and develop solutions for vital legacy test equipment + design and development of test plans, procedures, test strategies, and test requirements of company products + design and development of manual and automated test equipment + testing and integration of procedures, initial prototype equipment and systems integration support * Support a Senior engineer to complete tasks in a timely and cost\-effective manner. * Prepare charts, diagrams and reports expressing recommendations, technical accomplishments and project progress measured against specific plans. **Required Education, Experience, \& Skills** * Familiarity with requirements, documentation, and verification * Familiarity with Computer Aided Design (CAD) tools used for schematic capture of printed circuit board designs * Familiarity with electrical hardware design and documentation from top assembly to subassemblies, including assembly drawings, schematics, wire lists, parts lists, printed circuit boards, interconnect diagrams, configuration drawings, etc. * Experience and working knowledge of electronic circuits (analog, digital and power) and experience working electronic instruments * Electronics simulation, troubleshooting, and instrument familiarity (analog, digital, power, communications). * Familiarity with integration, troubleshooting, and debug skills. * Demonstrated proficiency in problem solving and critical thinking. * Effective communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills * Ability to read, edit, and integrate software **Preferred Education, Experience, \& Skills** * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering * Experience with Cadence System Capture PWB design tools * Experience with ADS, LTSpice, and HFSS simulation tools * Experience with the development of test equipment for flight controls, weapon controls, data links, and antennas. **Pay Information** Full\-Time Salary Range: $69439 \- $118047 Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience. Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well\-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20\+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non\-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics. **About BAE Systems Electronic Systems** BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference. Electronic Systems (ES) is the global innovator behind BAE Systems’ game\-changing defense and commercial electronics. Exploiting every electron, we push the limits of what is possible, giving our customers the edge and our employees opportunities to change the world. Our products and capabilities can be found everywhere – from the depths of the ocean to the far reaches of space. At our core are more than 14,000 highly talented Electronic Systems employees with the brightest minds in the industry, we make an impact – for our customers and the communities we serve. This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer I
jobs.description: **Department Name:** IT Identity Access Mgmt\-Corp**Work Shift:** Day**Job Category:** Information Technology Health care is constantly changing, and at Banner Health, we are at the front of that change. We are leading health care to make the experience the best it can be. We want to change the lives of those in our care – and the people who choose to take on this challenge. If changing health care for the better sounds like something you want to be part of, we want to hear from you. As a Cybersecurity Engineer I, you will be part of an Enterprise\-wide Cybersecurity Engineering team responsible for Identity and Access Management (IAM), tasked with the planning, implementation, and support of the Enterprise IAM Platform. Expertise should include Feature Development and Deployment, Access Certifications, Provisioning, Modeling, Workflows \& Automation. This impactful position will be responsible for the design, deployment, configuration, and maintenance of an IAM platform in a multi\-state enterprise environment. Candidates should have experience with various programming and development platforms including Git, Java, JavaScript, PowerShell, SQL, and Agile project management methodologies. They should also have a solid understanding of Identity Access Management and Identity Governance tools, preferably with SailPoint’s IdentityIQ, IdentityNow, or similar. Candidates should also understand IAM best practices that will drive maturity and adoption of the platform across the enterprise. **This is a remote position. In this role you would work Monday through Friday normal business with on\-call support. This is a remote position only if you live in the following states only: AL, AK, AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, ND, NE, NH, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV \& WY. NO other states will be considered.** Your pay and benefits (Total Rewards) are important components of your Journey at Banner Health. Banner Health offers a variety of benefit plans to help you and your family. We provide health and financial security options, so you can focus on being the best at what you do and enjoying your life. Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally\-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award\-winning patient care. POSITION SUMMARY This position designs, develops, configures, implements, tunes, maintains solutions, resolve technical and business issues related to cybersecurity threat \& vulnerability management, identity management, security operations center, forensics, and data protection. Cybersecurity Engineers work with Cybersecurity Architects to execute strategic cyber initiatives, evaluate security components of the network, applications and end\-user devices, and provides guidance to ensure new systems meet regulatory and technical standards. Cybersecurity Engineers participate in root\-cause analysis efforts to determine improvement opportunities when failures occur. Manage Cyber systems, ensures they are tuned, on the current release and manages appropriate change management across the IT organization and the business. CORE FUNCTIONS 1\. Participates in the design and implementation of cybersecurity solutions. 2\. Participates in providing technical expertise and support for cybersecurity solutions, including operational aspects of the software. 3\. Participates in the design, implementation, and compliance of secure baseline configurations for applications and infrastructure components. 4\. Performs technical assessments of systems and applications to ensure compliance with policy, standards and regulations. 5\. Participates in the ongoing evaluation and development of security policies and procedures. Leads the revision of policies and procedures, as needed. 6\. Update, sustain, and administer a high level of security for in\-house security infrastructures and services. 7\. Participates in cybersecurity projects, including the development of project scope requirements, budgeting, work breakdown. 8\. Under general direction, this position is responsible for cybersecurity across multiple departments system\-wide and requires interaction at all levels of staff and management. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Must possess strong knowledge of business, information security and/or computer science as normally obtained through the completion of a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Systems, or a related field. 0\-3 years of experience of enterprise\-scale information security engineering, preferably in healthcare. Experience with IT operations and or Security operations is also highly desirable. Experience with automation of security processes, coding and scripting languages. Ability to perform acquisition process, including vendor selection, define requirements, contractual documentation development. Ability to document security processes as well as Use case development. Proficient understanding of regulatory and compliance mandates, including but not limited to HIPAA, HITECH, PCI, Sarbanes\-Oxley. Experienced assessing and reaching out to vendors for needed features via enhancement requests. Experienced in planning, designing and implementing cybersecurity solutions. Experienced in operating, maintaining and the lifecycle of cybersecurity solutions. Knowledge of Security Engineering Principles, including risk management, resilience, vulnerability management, Information Security, and security operations. Requires independent judgment, critical decision making, excellent analytical skills, with excellent verbal and written communications. Ability to think quickly under difficult or complex conditions and clearly communicate to appropriate staff; ability to balance project workloads with customer support and on\-call demands. Must demonstrate general knowledge of information technology and information security principles and practices. Requires communication and presentation skills to engage technical and non\-technical audiences. Requires ability to communicate and interact across facilities and at various levels. As is typical in this industry, variable shifts and hours and responding to after\-hours notifications may be required. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Certification in one(1\)of the following areas Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP), HealthCare Information Security \& Privacy Practitioner, (HCISPP), CompTIA Security\+, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) – Engineering (ISSEP), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), SANS GIAC, or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA). Two years as a System Administrator, Security operations or in IT Operations. Or two years risk management or GRC experience in the healthcare/medical environment. Additional related education and/or experience preferred. **Estimated Pay Range:** $37\.14 \- $61\.90 / hour Banner Health is committed to pay equity and transparency. The posted compensation range is a reasonable estimate that extends from the lowest to the highest pay Banner Health in good faith believes it might pay for this particular job, based on the circumstances at the time of posting. This range is based on possible base salaries and does not include the value of our total rewards package. Actual pay determined at offer will be based on years of relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location, along with a review of current employees in similar roles to ensure pay equity is achieved and maintained. **EEO Statement:** EEO/Disabled/Veterans Our organization supports a drug\-free work environment. **Privacy Policy:** Privacy Policy

jobs.title: Founding Software Engineer (Backend)-Fuel Distribution SaaS
jobs.description: About the role We are building FuelOps: an integrated operations and finance platform for petroleum and bulk fuel distribution, and then for the wider transportation industry. This is not a greenfield idea looking for its first user. A working version is already running the business today. We built a full ERP covering dispatch, yard operations, driver logistics, inventory, and a complete general ledger that replaced QuickBooks Desktop. It has 56 data tables, tens of thousands of posted GL transactions, and it is in live beta right now with real loads and real money moving through it. We are now rebuilding it as a standalone multi\-tenant SaaS product on Postgres and AWS, because the low\-code platform we proved it on cannot be sold to anyone else. You would be the first engineer. You would work directly with the two founders, one of whom built the current system and knows every table in it. What you would actually build Year one, concretely: * Design the second\-generation data model from a ruled architecture specification. It is not a port of the existing schema. The entity core models quantity, identity, conversion, and transformability as independent typed traits, carries dual quantity with conversion provenance on every ledger row, and treats ownership and custody as separate axes. * Build the immutable transaction ledger and the general ledger posting engine. Balances are derived from the ledger, never written directly. Nothing edits history. You will do this alongside a founder who has already built one; you do not have to arrive knowing it. * Re\-express business rules that currently live in the low\-code layer as database constraints, triggers, and server\-side code: negative\-stock guards, delivery\-date authority, GL posting sequencing, blend and inventory movement rules. * Write the one\-time migration that loads a frozen export of the current system into the new model. * Stand up the platform foundations that do not exist yet: repository, CI, migration discipline, environments, backups, observability. * Multi\-tenancy, tenant isolation, and customer\-administered roles and permissions. * Document storage and lifecycle on object storage, not in the database. Beyond year one: third\-party integrations (fleet telematics, banking, fuel card networks, e\-invoicing, rack pricing feeds), a motor fuel tax engine, compliance tracking modules, mobile applications for drivers and yard staff, a public API, and a background AI layer that audits data entry and forecasts replenishment. What you need to be able to do Non\-negotiable: * Advanced relational data modeling in Postgres. Not ORM\-driven schema. You design normalized models, enforce invariants in the database rather than only in application code, write real SQL, and can reason about transaction isolation and concurrency. This is the core of the job and the thing we will dig into hardest. * Own a backend service end to end in production. Schema, API, deployment, monitoring, incident response. There is no platform team to hand it to. There is no team at all yet. * Migration discipline. Versioned, reviewed, reversible migrations applied by automation, never by hand against production. * AWS fundamentals: RDS, S3, IAM, networking, and infrastructure defined as code. * Work from a written specification and push back on it. Much of the architecture is already ruled and documented. We want someone who reads it, finds the flaw, and argues the case, not someone who implements it silently or ignores it. * Care about correctness over velocity. This system posts to a general ledger that a real business closes its books on. A fast feature that quietly corrupts a balance is worse than no feature. Strongly preferred. Any of these moves you toward the top of the range: * Double\-entry financial systems. Debits and credits, immutable ledgers, derived balances, period close, reconciliation. If you have shipped something where a balance being wrong was a real problem, lead with it in your application. * ERP, accounting, logistics, WMS, TMS, or similar transactional back\-office systems. * Multi\-tenant SaaS: tenant isolation, per\-tenant configuration, noisy\-neighbor and data\-leak risk. * Third\-party API integration where the other side is a bank, a regulator, or an enterprise vendor with poor documentation and no sandbox. * Enough front\-end capability to build usable internal and customer screens. You do not need to be a designer, but you will be building UI in year one. Useful, not required. We will teach the rest: * Petroleum, bulk liquids, hazmat, or trucking operations. * Motor fuel excise tax, DOT and FMCSA compliance, IFTA. * SOC 2 or comparable compliance preparation. * Mobile development, offline\-first sync, ML or forecasting work. * Experience migrating off a low\-code platform. Location and schedule Based in Katy, Texas, hybrid. We expect meaningful in\-person time, particularly in the first several months. This is deliberate. The product models physical operations: tanks, loads, meters, drivers, terminals. An engineer who has never watched a dispatcher build a load or seen a truck weigh out will model the wrong thing. We will get you in front of the actual operation. Travel to company terminals in Navasota and San Angelo is occasional, not routine. How we work * Specifications are written down and decisions are recorded with their reasoning. We do not rely on what somebody remembers. * One thing at a time, verified before the next thing starts. The existing system was built to zero compile errors as a standing bar and we intend to keep that habit. * Anything touching live production is gated and deliberate. The business runs on this. * We use AI tooling heavily and expect you to. It does not lower the bar for understanding what you shipped. Compensation and what this is $130,000 – $150,000 base. The top of the range is for candidates bringing real experience with financial, accounting, or ledger\-backed systems. Full\-time W\-2 with \[BENEFITS]. We are funded by an operating business, not by investors. That means no runway clock, no board deck, no pressure to inflate numbers, and no risk of the money disappearing in eighteen months. It also means we are not paying Bay Area compensation and there is no venture\-scale equity lottery ticket. What you get instead is unusual leverage. A product with a real, paying, working first customer from day one. A domain where the incumbent tools are genuinely bad and the buyers know it. No legacy codebase to inherit, only a legacy system to learn from. And the architecture decisions that will shape this product for the next decade are being made now, by a team of three, with you in the room. If you want to be employee number thirty on a mature platform team, this is the wrong role. If you want to design the data model that a company runs on for the next decade, it is the right one. To apply Send a resume and a short note covering: * A data model you are proud of, and one you got wrong and had to live with. * A time you found a flaw in a specification or design you were handed, and what you did about it. * Whether you would rather be handed a specification or write one, and why. Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Katy, TX 77450

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer (Full-Stack) — Fuel Distribution SaaS
jobs.description: About the role We are building FuelOps: an integrated operations and finance platform for petroleum and bulk fuel distribution. This is not a startup idea looking for its first customer. A working version already runs the business today. We built a full ERP covering dispatch, yard operations, driver logistics, inventory, and a complete general ledger that replaced QuickBooks Desktop. It is in live beta right now with real loads and real money moving through it. We are rebuilding it as a standalone multi\-tenant SaaS product on Postgres and AWS. You would be the second engineer, working directly alongside our founding engineer and the two founders. This is a real apprenticeship, not a title. You will be mentored by a senior engineer, you will get code review on everything, and you will be given work that is genuinely hard slightly before you feel ready for it. In exchange we expect you to be the kind of person who chases down the answer rather than waiting to be told. What you would actually do The job has two halves, and both matter. Half one: keep the current system running. Our existing ERP is live and people depend on it every day. While the senior engineer builds the replacement, you would own day\-to\-day support of the current system: investigating issues users report, tracing what actually happened through the data, fixing what is fixable, and documenting what is not. This is how you learn the business, and it is the reason the rebuild can go fast. Half two: build pieces of the new platform. * Front\-end screens against designs and specifications the senior engineer writes. * Migration verification: reconciliation scripts that prove the data moved from the old system to the new one without loss or distortion. Tedious, high\-stakes, and the best way anyone has ever learned a data model. * Automated tests, including the ones that catch a ledger going out of balance. * Integration client code against documented third\-party APIs. * Internal and administrative tooling. * Documentation that a future engineer can actually use. Over time, and depending on what you are good at, this grows toward owning features end to end. What you need * 1 to 3 years of professional software experience, or a strong project portfolio. Bootcamp graduates and self\-taught engineers are welcome. We care about what you can do and how you think, not where you learned it. * Working SQL. You can write a join, a group\-by, and a subquery without looking them up, and you understand what a foreign key is for. We will teach you the rest, and there is a lot of rest. * At least one language you are comfortable in. Python, TypeScript, C\#, Java, Go, whatever. We care that you know one well more than that you know five slightly. * You can read code you did not write and figure out what it does before asking. * Careful with other people’s data. This system holds a real company’s inventory and general ledger. Guessing is not a strategy here. We would much rather you stop and ask than push something you are unsure of. * Clear written communication. Much of the work is remote\-async against written specifications, and half your job involves explaining to a non\-technical person what went wrong. Nice to have, none of it required * Any exposure to Postgres specifically. * Microsoft Power Platform, Power Apps, Power Fx, or Dataverse. Our current system is built on it, so this is unusually useful here even though it is not a long\-term skill for us. * Accounting coursework, bookkeeping experience, or any familiarity with debits and credits. * Trucking, logistics, fuel, warehouse, or field operations experience of any kind, including non\-technical. If you have worked a yard or dispatched trucks and then learned to code, we want to talk to you. * Git, CI, cloud infrastructure, or AWS exposure. * Experience supporting software that other people depend on daily. Location and schedule Based in Katy, Texas, hybrid. In\-person time matters more for this role than most, because you are learning a business as much as a codebase, and because pairing with the senior engineer is how you get good quickly. Occasional visits to company terminals in Navasota and San Angelo. You will spend time around the actual operation: tanks, trucks, meters, dispatchers. That is a feature of the job, not a chore. How we work * Specifications are written down and decisions are recorded with their reasoning. Nobody has to guess what was decided or why. * One thing at a time, verified before the next thing starts. * Anything touching live production is gated and deliberate. The business runs on this. * We use AI tooling heavily and expect you to. It does not lower the bar for understanding what you shipped, and "the AI wrote it" is not an explanation of how something works. * Questions are cheap. Silent guessing on a live ledger is expensive. Compensation and what this is $85,000 – $100,000 base, depending on experience. Full\-time W\-2 with \[BENEFITS]. We are funded by an operating business, not by investors. No runway clock, no layoff risk from a funding round that does not close. For someone early in their career, the specific offer here is scope you would wait years for elsewhere. On a team this small there is no queue for interesting work, no layer of process between you and the person who decides, and no possibility of spending two years on a single component of somebody else’s system. You will see how a real company’s operations and finances actually work, from the inside, which almost no engineer ever does. It is also demanding. Small team, real consequences, and nobody to hide behind.
