jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: At CEC Entertainment, we build careers around great food, family, and fun! Our purpose and our passion is to create the best place for kids and families to eat and play! **Job Description** The **Sr. Software Engineer** is responsible for designing, developing and maintaining business\-critical software for CEC Entertainment as part of a distributed Software Engineering team. The role is full stack in the CEC sense: the same engineer builds C\# applications that run on our NCR Voyix Aloha point\-of\-sale terminals in more than 500 stores, design and develop microservices REST API to run our backend in an efficient way. Well versed with Azure cloud and its services. **Major Responsibilities:** * **Front end.** Develop and maintain web front ends (Angular or React) for internal tools, portals and configuration consoles that support the POS and loyalty platforms. * **Back\-end APIs and Azure services.** Develop, deploy and operate C\# .NET (Core/.NET 8\+) Web APIs, Azure Functions and background services in Microsoft Azure using App Service, API Management, Key Vault, Storage, Service Bus/Event Grid, Azure SQL and Application Insights; own infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD pipelines for the services you build. * **POS application development.** Design, develop and maintain the C\# applications that run on Aloha POS terminals (.NET Framework, WinForms) * **Integrations.** Build and maintain integrations with third\-party platforms and vendors — NCR Voyix, FreedomPay, Affirm, Twilio, SEMNOX, Workday and SaaS partners — and with internal platforms such as OmniFun loyalty and the enterprise data hub. * **Engineering quality.** Establish and enforce best practices for secure, scalable, resilient and efficient software: code reviews, unit and integration tests, static analysis, secrets management, structured logging and monitoring, and safe rollout and rollback of store\-impacting releases (pilot stores before fleet). * **Production support.** Provide tier\-3 support for POS and API incidents within the team's protected support capacity, perform root\-cause analysis, and drive permanent fixes into the backlog; participate in an on\-call rotation as required. * **Collaboration and communication.** Work with cross\-functional teams to ensure code quality, testing, piloting, installation and implementation are executed efficiently; communicate technical options, risks and trade\-offs clearly to both technical and business audiences. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering or similar degree * 8\+ years of professional software development experience, with at least 4 years in C\# and the .NET ecosystem spanning both .NET Framework (WinForms/desktop, COM interop) * Hands\-on experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs — contracts, authentication (OAuth 2\.0 / JWT / API keys), versioning, resilience patterns (retry, circuit breaker, idempotency) and API documentation (OpenAPI). * 3\+ years building and operating solutions on Microsoft Azure: App Service or Azure Functions, API Management, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, messaging (Service Bus/Event Grid), Application Insights, and Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions CI/CD. * Solid front\-end skills with a modern framework (Angular preferred; React), TypeScript, HTML and CSS. * Working knowledge of SQL Server / Azure SQL data modelling and query performance, and of secure coding practices for environments handling payment card and guest data (PCI DSS awareness; secrets never in code or logs; TLS in transit, encryption at rest). * Experience in a fast\-paced Agile / Scrum, continuous\-integration environment using Jira, Confluence and Git\-based workflows (GitHub). * Demonstrated ability to work effectively in and help lead high\-performing, globally distributed development teams. * Strong communication and presentation skills, demonstrated continuous technical learning, and the ability to build relationships across the organization with a sharp focus on the customer — both internal and external. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Direct experience with NCR Voyix Aloha (Aloha Connect / COM interop, Configuration Center, Aloha Kitchen or ATO), or with another enterprise POS platform's extension model. * Experience with payment and loyalty integrations (FreedomPay or similar gateways, tokenization, buy\-now\-pay\-later providers, loyalty/CRM platforms). **Physical Demands:** To perform the duties of this position, the incumbent must have the ability to sit, walk, stand, bend, twist, reach, and carry, lift, pull, push between 1 – 25 lbs. Cheese, Peter Piper Pizza and Chuck’s Arcade brands. Chuck E. Cheese celebrates over half a million birthdays annually, dedicated to creating joyful, lasting memories through fun, food, and play. Peter Piper Pizza offers a neighborhood pizzeria experience with quality food, engaging entertainment, and lifelong memories because fun isn't added on\-“The Fun is Baked In”! Through amusement and connection, families and communities are brought together every day. Both Chuck E. Cheese and Peter Piper Pizza champion play through different attractions to support physical wellness and strengthen motor skills in kids. CEC Entertainment and its franchisees operate nearly 600 Chuck E. Cheese locations and over 120 Peter Piper Pizza venues across 45 states and 18 countries. The company proudly fosters a culture of diversity and celebrates fun and play to unite every family. Learn more at chuckecheese.com and peterpiperpizza.com. **Benefits:** CEC Entertainment offers a wide variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible U.S. employees as part of their overall employment package. We also offer job training and career growth opportunities. Chuck E. Cheese is a "Work Today, Get Paid Tomorrow" employer. \* \* \* At CEC Entertainment, we believe that our workforce should reflect the diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives of many guests we serve. jobs.title: Transportation Review Engineer
jobs.description: **Come Join the City of Bellevue!** New hires typically receive between minimum and midpoint, however, we may go slightly higher based on experience, internal equity and market. **Job Summary** --------------- The Transportation Department is looking for a **Transportation Engineer** to join the City's Transportation Development Review team of highly experienced transportation professionals. Bellevue is recognized for its many advancements in transportation approaches and technologies. We are excited to provide an opportunity for an enthusiastic engineer to join our progressive team. You will be responsible for reviewing proposed commercial and residential development for traffic impacts and compliance with transportation standards. You will bring your experience in both the review of civil engineering design plans and the review of traffic analysis of development proposals. You will also have opportunities to build teams to address areas of need and to participate in the leadership of the Transportation Department through action teams. **Why Bellevue?** At The City of Bellevue you'll be part of a team committed to providing exceptional customer service, upholding the public interest and being a part of the community vision. Our people bring unique skills and qualities to the table, embrace the values of honesty, accountability and commitment to service, and take pride in the work they do. You'll work in an environment where being innovative, collaborative, and future focused are the status quo. Bellevue welcomes the world. Our diversity is our strength. It's what makes The City of Bellevue an exciting place to work, live, and explore. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** ----------------------------------------- * Reviews engineering plans for compliance with engineering standards and project requirements. * Reviews traffic analysis prepared by consultants. * Prepares letters, memos, and reports addressing site design and traffic impact issues; provides recommendations for developer conditions. * Conducts engineering analysis to identify areas of concern. * Works with other staff to resolve project issues as part of an interdepartmental team. * Provides excellent customer service to City residents and those doing business with the City. * Interprets, applies, and ensures compliance with codes, standards, specifications, policies, and procedures; ensures compliance with standard engineering principles for review of infrastructure plans. * Confers and advises with staff and developer representatives on acceptable design alternatives and solutions; works with developer representatives for plan design changes. * Manages a complex workload with competing schedules and deadlines. * Participates in Department and City efforts to provide stellar community outcomes through the City's shared leadership philosophy. * Develops mitigating measures to impose as conditions for projects with unmitigated impacts. * Represents the Transportation Department at the Permit Center. Answers general and technical transportation questions from the public. * Uses the city permit tracking and time\-keeping systems to maintain accurate records of current status of projects, billable time spent, and workload. * Attends evening meeting and public hearings to present information or recommendations related to development applications. Represents the City in a variety of public forums. **Supervision Received** * Works under the general supervision of the Transportation Department Development Review Manager. * This position does not supervise any employees. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Education and Experience Requirements** * Graduation from an accredited four\-year college or university with a degree in civil engineering or another closely related field. Professional Engineer License may be substituted for a degree. * Two years of experience in performing engineering work; or the equivalent combination of education, experience and training may be considered in lieu of professional experience. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** * Thorough knowledge of civil engineering principles, practices, and methods as applicable to a municipal setting. Thorough knowledge of applicable City policies, laws, and regulations affecting development review activities. * Experience conducting and reviewing complex traffic analysis of development proposals. * Experience in the review of civil engineering design plans to assure constructability is sound and design meets standards. * Ability to conduct necessary engineering research and compile comprehensive reports. * Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing; ability to work with the media and the public; ability to communicate with various groups with differences in age, language, culture, education level, and technical knowledge. * Ability to present technical information to the general public in a non\-technical manner. * Ability to apply sound engineering judgment un this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. * The employee may be required to push, pull, lift, and/or carry up to 25 pounds. * The noise level in the work environment is usually moderately quiet while in the office and moderately loud when in the field. **Flexible/Hybrid Working:** A hybrid work schedule is available for this position after an orientation period working in the office after hire. Remote work for this position is subject to department's operational needs and will be discussed with candidates during the selection process. Full\-time remote work is not an available option. Once hired, employees must reside in the State of Washington and within reasonable commuting distance to Bellevue City Hall. This is a full\-time, exempt, non\-union position. **HIRING PROCESS** The City evaluates candidates based on the information provided in the online application only. Do not submit resumes and cover letters. To evaluate all candidates fairly and equitably, the City will make all applicants anonymous when we are screening the applications. We will redact information from our application such as your name, address, and other demographics. To help us, please complete the online application form as fully as possible. * Answer the Supplemental Questions when requested which can be found on the Questions tab of the Job posting. * We do not accept resumes and cover letters during the anonymous application screening stage, unless otherwise stated in the job description. * Applicants advancing to the next stage may be required to provide a cover letter, resume, writing sample, and references. **CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT** * All candidates will be required to establish employment authorization and identity at the time of hire. The City is not able to sponsor work visas. * All positions require the completion of references checks, including at least one prior supervisor. * Some positions may require completion of a criminal background check prior to start employment * Some positions may require obtaining a commercial driver's license (CDL), licensures, or additional certifications. *At the City of Bellevue, you'll be part of a team committed to providing exceptional customer service, upholding the public interest and advancing the community vision. The six essential and enduring principles that guide our individual actions, our interactions, and our decision making in the City of Bellevue organization is: Exceptional Public Service, Stewardship, Commitment to Employees, Integrity, Innovation, and Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion. You'll work in an environment that is innovative, collaborative, future focused, and committed to excellence. Bellevue welcomes the world. Our diversity is our strength. We embrace the future while respecting our past. It's what makes the City of Bellevue an exciting place to work, live, and explore.* *Have we piqued your interest yet? Come join our team! The City of Bellevue supports workplace diversity. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, genetic information, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected status. Persons needing assistance with the application process may call the Human Resources Office, at 425\-452\-6838 or* *recruiting@bellevuewa.gov**. If you are invited to participate in the selection process and need ADA accommodations, please notify HR before you are scheduled for an interview or testing.* The City of Bellevue participates in the E\-Verify program. Learn more about the E\-Verify program. For any technical difficulties with your application, please contact the NEOGOV support line at 855\-524\-5627\. ***\*\* Please be sure to check your junk folder for any messages that may be sent to you about this recruitment.\*\****

jobs.description: **Company Description** **Specific information regarding this recruitment process are listed below:** * Appointment Type: Permanent Exempt: This position is excluded by the Charter from the competitive Civil Service examination process and shall serve at the discretion of the Appointing Officer. The duration of the appointment shall not exceed 36 months. * Application Opening: September 16, 2026 * Application Deadline: September 30, 2026 * Compensation Range: $159,120 \- $200,226 * Recruitment ID: RTF0168220\-01107222 San Francisco is a vibrant and dynamic city, on the forefront of economic growth \& innovation, urban development, arts \& entertainment, as well as social issues \& change. This rich tapestry of culture and ideas is sustained by our City's commitment to heighten the quality of life for the diverse population of San Franciscans and residents of the greater Bay Area. Our employees play an important role not only in making our City what it is today, but also in shaping the future of San Francisco. **Our Office** The Office of the Assessor\-Recorder is responsible for fairly and accurately executing property assessment functions in accordance with the State Constitution and State and local laws. Our core responsibilities include identifying all taxable property in the City and County of San Francisco, establishing a taxable value, and applying all legal exemptions. Property broadly includes real property as well as personal property owned by businesses. The Office is also responsible for recording documents and securing public records. We ensure each document meets recording requirements and make them accessible to the public. We record over 400 different types of documents annually, including deeds of trust, reconveyances, liens, maps, and public marriage certificates. Additionally, the Office is responsible for collecting any transfer tax due upon a change in property ownership and performing audits to ensure the correct property value basis for taxation. In all that we do we seek to advance the values of fairness, care, equity, and excellence in service to our diverse constituents and communities. **What We Do** Each year we prepare an assessment roll that reflects the taxable values of land, improvements, and personal property. The assessment roll is the basis for San Francisco’s property tax revenue. We enroll property tax value by discovering new construction or changes in ownership. The work of our Office in enrolling property valued at approximately $352 billion generates an estimated $4\.1 billion in property tax revenue for the City and County of San Francisco. Property tax revenue represents over one\-third of the City's General Fund which pays for crucial services ranging from public safety, affordable housing, and education to neighborhood improvements and health and family support services. Our success is grounded by our Office's investment in our four strategic pillars: people, systems, services, and engagement. We prioritize a climate and culture where belonging and inclusion are advanced, staff can be their authentic selves and pursue pathways for career growth, and diverse constituencies are equitably supported with a meaningful and seamless experience through care in customer service and efficient technology systems. In line with these values, we are taking significant steps to modernize our operations, including leading a cross\-departmental effort to replace the legacy property assessment system currently used to manage the City’s hundreds of billions of dollars in assessed property value. This modernization work will provide for increased security and service as well as greater integration with other City systems utilized by the Office of the Treasurer \& Tax Collector and the City Controller’s Office. We are committed to developing an organization that works to address the pervasive and persistent inequities resulting from systemic racism in our society. This extends to our external engagements where our Office seeks to increase access to resources across multiple constituencies by hosting presentations, workshops, attending events, tabling at resource fairs, and more to ensure that all San Franciscans know what our office can do for them. **Job Description** The Office of the Assessor\-Recorder is hiring 1043 Senior Technology Engineer, under the direction of the IT Product Director, this role is responsible for being the lead Salesforce Architect, acting as a strategic advisor bridging business needs with technical solutions. The position will be responsible for designing, supporting and managing the Assessor\-Recorder’s secure, scalable, and high\-performance Salesforce platform (“SMART”). Key responsibilities include solution and design strategy, technical leadership, integration and data management, governance and security, and stakeholder engagement. The class is distinguished from the journey level 1042 Technology Engineer by the complexity and size of the systems or -6015 (TTY). jobs.title: INDUSTRIAL WASTE INSPECTOR-OPEN
jobs.description: **General Statement of Duties** ------------------------------- This position is responsible for supporting regulatory compliance and monitoring activities associated with the Pretreatment, Surcharge, Special Billing Meter, Hauled Waste, Infrastructure Protection, and related monitoring programs. Duties may include the installation, configuration, calibration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of monitoring, sampling, and remote sensor instrumentation, as applicable to assigned programs. Working independently or collaboratively, the position performs field and office functions that support wastewater monitoring, compliance verification, data collection, and technical program implementation. **Minimum Qualifications (KSAs)** --------------------------------- **(Illustrative only. Any one position may not require all of the listed KSAs nor do the listed examples include all the KSAs which may be required.)** **Knowledge of**: Properties of acids, caustics, and combinations to determine effect of industrial waste on the sewerage system. Standard laboratory procedures related to collection of samples. Liquid, solid, and vapor sample collection procedures. Basic chemical and engineering terms. Differences among various types of pumps and valves. Utility and process flow plans to relate symbols, plan elevations, and dimensions to pipes, pumps, valves, and discharge outlets in plants. Safety policies and procedures, e.g., Employee Safety Instruction Manual and applicable agency requirements. Parameters of wastewater strength for revenue purposes such as biochemical oxygen demand (B.O.D.), suspended solids, and total Kjeldahl nitrogen determinations (TKN). Emergency response and Communication Procedures. Characteristics and behaviors of odors, emissions and gases. Software systems such as: ArcView, GIS, iPACS, On Base, CagisDocs. The impact of pollutants/contamination on natural bodies of water. **Skill to**: Label sample collections sufficient to establish correct procedures for court cases. Use a variety of video/photographic equipment. Drive a van, pick\-up truck, or car. **Ability to**: Measure and isolate problems or possible causes of pH which affect safety, health, and corrosion. Assess corrosive and safety problems of sewage by odor, color, and effect on physical senses. Offer assistance to plant managers, engineers, etc., related to control of illegal discharges. Evaluate whether a chemical, metal, property, condition etc., is present, whether it is a nuisance or hazard. Read, understand, interpret, and apply appropriate M.S.D. Rules and Regulations concerning discharged wastes. Testify and use plans and drawings in court as MSD's expert on sampling, location and practices. Work alone for extended periods of time. Demonstrate professional and effective behavior in stressful situations. Prepare detailed timely reports related to findings. Communicate effectively, orally and with tact, with technical plant personnel at various organizational levels. Work safely, independently, and collaboratively as part of a team, including taking initiative and carrying out assignments with minimal supervision. **Examples of Work Performed****(Illustrative only. Any one position within this classification may not include all of the duties listed nor do the listed examples include all of the tasks which may be performed.)** Drives to establishments to inspect and/or sample waste treatment facilities, sewers, drains, meters, tanks, vehicles, etc. Conducts field tests for acidity, alkalinity, and other characteristics to determine whether discharged wastes will cause water pollution, deterioration of sewerage facilities, or health and safety problems. Inspects sewers and storm drains to determine presence of explosive gases using gas\-analysis equipment. Assembles mathematical and chemical information to develop and write reports relative to treatment plant loading, industrial revenues and associated waste problems. Evaluates water usage at industrial facilities to determine the portions of metered water that do not discharge to the wastewater treatment systems. Pursues reports of illegal or suspicious discharge to the MSD sewer system. Demonstrates a working knowledge of current safety policies, instructions for proper usage, and other procedures and professional practices required for completing job duties. Identifies unsafe practices and conditions and brings such matters to the attention of the crew leader or supervisor. Monitors and reports activities of the Special Billing Meter, Septic Hauler, and Infrastructure Protection Programs. Investigates Wastewater Treatment Plant problems related to Industrial Discharge. Recommends enforcement action related to inspection findings. Designs and operates monitoring stations using timed, discreet and composite sampling methods. Prepares evidence for enforcement actions as required. Responds to spills, dumps or other similar emergency events. jobs.title: SENIOR ENGINEER / ENGINEER
jobs.description: **General Statement of Duties** ------------------------------- ***The Metropolitan Sewer District's Compliance Services Division is looking for an engineer to serve as the technical lead supporting day\-to\-day Consent Decree and Discharge Assessment activities.*** ***Key responsibilities would include: Supporting preparation, review, and quality assurance of Consent Decree reports, deliverables, and regulatory responses. Providing engineering review of sanitary sewer overflows, sewage surfacing events, bypasses, and other unauthorized discharges. Evaluating recurring overflow locations, system conditions, contributing causes, and potential corrective actions. Maintaining historical documentation demonstrating progress toward overflow elimination and WWIP compliance. Coordinating with engineering, Wastewater Collection, operations, modeling, and project teams to track corrective actions and long\-term solutions. jobs.description: **GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF CLASS** -------------------------------- This is an entry\-level position for high school graduates who have successfully completed the required electrical industry certification at the Lakeland Electric Power Academy or Traviss Technical College. This position involves learning routine engineering tasks and assisting in engineering, statistical work, mathematical, contract and construction support, or various other utility\-related tasks. Additionally, this position receives training and performs a variety of technical office and fieldwork in support of City engineering\-related activities. Work is performed under the direction of a supervisor or senior engineering technicians and checked upon completion to ensure quality, accuracy, and completeness. ***This position is with Lakeland Electric ED Engineering located at 501 East Lemon Street in Lakeland, FL. Utility Workers will work a maximum of 30 hours a week.*** **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS** ----------------------- * Performs basic level skills as required in the designated position * Collect and organize data for use and analysis by higher\-level technicians or engineers * Assist in preparing routine reports, forecasts, studies, legal descriptions, memos, letters, and related activities * Learn basic procedures of using computer\-aided Design Software of the Department's choosing to produce maps, drawings, charts, graphs, and related documents * Enter data into processing devices using procedures designated by engineers, planners, and others * Run programs or execute procedures to obtain the necessary output in proper format * Learn to use various software applications to create presentations, collect data, plot technical data, and calculate statistical averages, statistical trends, rates of change, and percentages * Assist with preparation of cost estimates * Learn to use the City's GIS Software and provides maps as required by the Department Learn to read, understand and interpret plans, legal property descriptions, specifications, technical reports, and engineering drawings * Assist with maintaining an efficient filing and records system * Position designated Mission Critical **ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:*** Performs related work as required. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:*** None **QUALIFICATIONS (EDUCATION, TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE)** ------------------------------------------------------- * Graduate from Lakeland Electric Power Academy/Traviss Energy Academy with required industry certification * Recommendation of the Lakeland Electric Power Academy instructor or a current City of Lakeland/Lakeland Electric employee * To obtain a full\-time Utility Worker position, you must serve six (6\) months as a part\-time Utility Worker or have six (6\) months of experience as an intern or apprentice in the electrical industry. * An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience that provides the knowledge, skills, abilities, and other competencies necessary for success in the target position may be considered ***Required:*** ***Resumé must be uploaded with the application to be considered for this position.*** **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES** -------------------------------- * Ability to build successful working relationships with employees at all levels of the organization. * Ability to follow complex instructions * Ability to learn utility\-specific skills based on position assignment * Ability to perform physically demanding work (in some positions) * Ability to properly use hand tools or office equipment appropriate for the position. * Must maintain City driving privileges/valid Florida driver's license * Must maintain a valid contact phone number **WORKING ENVIRONMENT/CONDITIONS:*** Requires sedentary work that involves walking or standing some of the time, exerting up to 10 pounds of force on a recurring basis, routine keyboard operations * The job risks exposure to no significant environmental hazards * The job requires normal visual acuity, and field of vision, hearing and speaking All City of Lakeland positions are subject to testing (e.g. written, oral, performance, computerized, interview, and/or any combination). Candidates selected for testing will be notified via email or telephone. Please check your e\-mail and telephone messages regularly, including "junk" folders. Test times and locations to be announced. **THE CITY OF LAKELAND IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY/EQUAL ACCESS EMPLOYER AND A DRUG FREE WORKPLACE** **City of Lakeland** **2026 Summary Sheet** ***Annual Leave*** Annual leave is accumulated bi\-weekly and based upon years of service as follows: Annual leave may be taken as earned by employees hired after January 1, 1989\. Employees hired prior to that date use annual leave within the calendar year following the year the leave is earned. All employees may carry over up to a maximum of twenty (20\) days at the end of the calendar year. Regular part\-time employees who work at least twenty (20\) hours per week per election upon hire Employer 15\.54% Deferred Compensation 457 Plan: A voluntary plan that is invested in mutual funds. The Employees' Pension Board performs the due diligence on the mutual funds. Employees may reallocate their account at any time. Maximum contribution for 2026 is $24,500; employees age 50 or older can also add a "catch\-up" amount of $8,000; employees age 60\-63 can also add a "catch\-up" amount of $11,250\. Additionally, a match of up to 5% of salary is offered by the City in Plan C. ***Holidays*** Twelve (12\) holidays, includes one (1\) personal floating holiday to be used at any time after three (3\) months of employment and prior to the end of the calendar year. ***Funeral Leave*** Up to three (3\) days off with pay due to death of an immediate family member (as defined in the policy manual). Up to four (4\) hours off with pay may be obtained through supervisor approval to attend local funeral services of persons other than immediate family. ***Jury/Witness Duty*** Employees required to serve on jury duty will be relieved of responsibility for their regular work shift or portion thereof and receive full pay while serving. All fees received for such service may be retained by the employee. Employees subpoenaed to any civil or criminal court proceeding, which employee is not personally or monetarily interested, shall be paid as if engaged in regular work activities. ***Military Leave*** Allows for up to 240 hours in any one calendar year for annual military training without loss of pay or benefits for any employee in some type of reserve status for the United States Armed Forces. (see policy manual for additional information). ***Maternity Leave*** Refer to Family \& Medical Leave for those employees who qualify. jobs.title: Municipal Civil Engineer II
jobs.description: Salary $73,944\.00 \- $122,241\.60 Annually Location Public Works Shop, 497 S Main St, Clearfield City, UT Job Type Full\-Time (FT) Job Number 092026\-801 Department Public Works/Administration Opening Date 09/10/2026 Closing Date 9/24/2026 11:55 PM Mountain **General Purpose** ------------------- Typical hiring salary for this exempt position ranges from **$73,944 to $81,329 annually (may underfill)** depending on experience. **GENERAL PURPOSE** Performs a variety of professional, technical, and complex engineering duties in the planning, design, construction, and maintenance of City infrastructure. Serves as a project manager or project lead for engineering projects and performs administrative and technical functions in support of the City's engineering and public works programs. **SUPERVISION RECEIVED** Works under the general supervision of the City Engineer. **SUPERVISION EXERCISED** May provide direct or general supervision to assigned staff, consultants, interns, and contract engineering personnel. **Examples of Duties** ---------------------- Organizes, manages, and administers a variety of engineering functions, including the research, surveying, design, permitting, and construction inspection of site and subdivision development projects. Provides highly responsible technical and professional assistance to the City Engineer and Community Development staff. Coordinates projects related to all aspects of Public Works, including research, data analysis, report writing, and presentations. Serves as project manager for assigned capital improvement projects; coordinates with contractors and consultants; keeps the Director and City Engineer informed of project costs, budgets, schedules, and related issues; conducts project observations; identifies compliance issues; and negotiates or directs appropriate corrective actions. Oversees the issuance of a variety of City permits. Reviews engineering plans submitted for private development and provides recommendations based on applicable City standards and ordinances. Responds to public inquiries and concerns. Administers escrow and bond agreements for private development projects and authorizes the release of funds as public improvements are completed. Meets with developers, engineers, contractors, and property owners to discuss City requirements for proposed development projects. Participates in field reviews of current and proposed construction projects and resolves engineering and construction issues as appropriate. Reviews and approves site grading plans, encroachment permits, transportation overload permits, and construction plans. Maintains current knowledge of developments, regulations, technologies, and best practices in civil engineering through professional organizations, continuing education, and industry resources. Prepares engineering reviews, reports, and cost estimates for proposed projects and developments. Assists in developing and updating master plans for City utility systems. Performs complex engineering calculations and technical analyses. Conducts field inspections to ensure compliance with Public Works and Engineering standards, specifications, and ordinances. Prepares reports, projections, and evaluations and provides technical information and recommendations to the City Council, boards, committees, and staff as assigned. Assists with project management and scheduling activities. Monitors project progress to ensure compliance with approved plans, standards, regulations, ordinances, budgets, and schedules. Performs periodic inspections to verify compliance with material specifications, construction standards, and quality requirements. Manages, with assistance from other staff, the City's Municipal Separate Storm Sewer System (MS4\) permit program. Coordinates stormwater compliance activities with City departments and regulatory agencies. Develops and maintains programs and procedures to ensure permit compliance, identify, track, investigate, and eliminate illicit discharges, prepares the annual MS4 report for the State, and assists with development of the Stormwater Master Plan and Capital Facilities Plan. Inspects storm drain outfalls, drainage basins, and related infrastructure as required by the MS4 permit and develops recommendations and corrective action plans as needed. Develops, maintains, and administers the City's Geographic Information System (GIS). Administers ESRI ArcGIS software, databases, servers, and related applications to track, maintain, and analyze utility infrastructure data. Trains staff in GIS data collection, maintenance, and use. Utilizes surveying, inspection, and measurement equipment, including GPS rovers, data collectors, unmanned aerial systems (drones), and associated software, while maintaining all required certifications, licenses, and software necessary to perform assigned duties. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor's or Master's degree from an ABET\-accredited college or university in Civil Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline; **AND** * Four (4\) years of progressively responsible professional civil engineering experience. **Special Qualifications:** * Must possess and maintain a valid Utah Driver License, or obtain one within the time required by Utah law following hire, and maintain an acceptable driving record in accordance with the City's Motor Vehicle Policy. * Must obtain Registered Stormwater Inspector (RSI) certification within six (6\) months of hire. * Must possess a Professional Engineer (PE) license in the State of Utah, or obtain Utah licensure within twelve (12\) months of hire. * Drinking Water Operator Certification is preferred. **Additional Qualifications/Information** ----------------------------------------- **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** Knowledge of civil engineering principles, practices, methods, and standards; construction methods and materials common to public works projects; engineering software applications, including CAD, GIS, and utility modeling; engineering equipment, surveying instruments, and drafting tools; building, engineering, planning and zoning codes, standards, and regulations; traffic signalization systems; and political, legal, and governmental processes affecting municipal engineering projects. Skill in project management, engineering analysis, plan review, report preparation, cost estimating, and the operation of engineering software and technical equipment. Ability to interpret and apply applicable laws, regulations, and engineering standards; analyze complex engineering issues and develop practical solutions; manage multiple projects and competing priorities; communicate effectively both verbally and in writing; and establish and maintain effective working relationships with elected officials, contractors, consultants, developers, regulatory agencies, City staff, and the public. **Work Environment:** Work is performed in both office and field settings. Duties require a variety of physical activities, including sitting, standing, walking, bending, stooping, reaching, climbing, and occasional lifting and carrying of equipment. The position requires periodic field work with exposure to varying weather conditions, uneven terrain, traffic, construction sites, heights, noise, dust, and other conditions associated with public works and engineering operations. Periodic local travel is required in the performance of assigned duties. Clearfield City is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This is an Exempt Position.* As of 07/01/2026

jobs.title: Software Developer II - Pathology Informatics
jobs.description: Join the Cleveland Clinic team, where you will work alongside passionate caregivers and provide patient\-first healthcare. Cleveland Clinic is recognized as one of the top hospitals in the nation. At Cleveland Clinic, you will work alongside passionate and dedicated caregivers, receive endless support and appreciation, and build a rewarding career with one of the most respected healthcare organizations in the world. As a Software Developer II, you will be responsible for the design, documentation, coding, unit testing, systems testing and deployment of software applications. In this role, you will work closely with other developers, project managers, analysts and leaders, as well as clinicians to obtain regular feedback on design and development. You will support PIRO, an internal application and search engine for pathology notes and cases, assist with assigned tasks and support AI and machine learning initiatives. You will communicate system issues and implications while utilizing knowledge in computer science or software engineering and software development methodologies to create innovative health solutions. A caregiver in this position works remotely from 8:30 a.m. \- 5:00 p.m. Caregivers are preferred to reside in Ohio or Florida for this role. A caregiver who excels in this role will: Iterate with team members around analysis, design and development of software systems. Develop new software and proofing/testing the development to assure production of a quality product. Work with lead developers, lead engineers, and senior developers to ensure software development and engineering standards are met. Make recommendations which yield a more cost\-effective product and better streamlined workflows while supporting team strategy in development approach. Observe operational and clinical workflow and works to build solutions around observed behaviors. Help to translate clinical problems into innovative healthcare solutions. Provide technical support to other developers when project support is needed. Experience in interfacing with internal and external customers. Gather business and application specific requirements. Ensure all requirements are met as well as maintained within defined project scope and documented within documentation management system. Keep up with industry trends and bring new ideas and industry solutions to healthcare for a unique application. Troubleshoot issues and support fix and updates in a timely manner. You understand cloud software delivery practices deeply and are technologically curious, staying current on emerging tools, patterns, and standards. you will:* Software Solutioning \& Design (10%) * Develop deep understanding of the business processes and domains that the BAWP UI serves * Lead evaluation of feature requests, provide effort estimates, and drive sprint/technical planning * Define and own architectural patterns and API contracts for integrating multiple domain services into the BAWP UI * Lead peer code and design reviews to ensure quality, consistency, and scalability Design, Architecture \& Implementation (60%) * Architect and build scalable, secure full\-stack solutions using React (TypeScript) on the front end and AWS\-native services on the backend * Design and implement APIs and data integration layers that aggregate content from multiple upstream domains, with robust handling of latency, partial failures, and caching * Build reusable, well\-architected front\-end components and shared modules within the BAWP Shell (micro\-frontend/Module Federation or equivalent) * Design and implement cloud\-native standards across the platform * Ensure systems meet enterprise requirements for scalability, data integrity, security, availability, and reliability * Integrate monitoring, telemetry, and operational readiness into all platform components * Own and evolve automated end\-to\-end and UI testing frameworks (Playwright) to ensure application quality and reliability * Drive performance optimization across API integration and rendering layers Technical Contribution \& Engineering Excellence (20%) * Solve complex technical problems and drive improvements to overall system design * Mentor and guide other engineers on best practices in development, testing, and system design * Continuously evaluate and introduce new cloud, front\-end, and test automation technologies where they add value * services: Lambda, API Gateway, SNS, SQS, S3, Step Functions, EC2, ECS, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, DynamoDB * Experience with Backstage and GitHub Actions * Experience designing systems that integrate and aggregate data and content from multiple independent backend/domain services into a single UI * Strong knowledge of distributed cloud infrastructure and microservices architecture * Experience with Infrastructure as Code (AWS CDK, CloudFormation) * Experience building responsive, secure, high\-performance UIs using React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS * Familiarity with micro\-frontend architectures (e.g., Module Federation) and shared shell/component patterns * Experience with automated testing frameworks, for end\-to\-end and UI testing, and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines * Strong focus on scalability, data integrity, reliability, and quality engineering practices * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to present ideas in business\-friendly language and mentor other engineers * Ability to prioritize and lead execution of tasks in a high\-pressure, fast\-paced environment Nice to Have: * Experience with monitoring/observability tools such as Grafana, CloudWatch dashboards * Familiarity with real\-time stream processing (Apache Flink or similar) * Familiarity with ML/AI lifecycle concepts, and interest in AI\-driven features (e.g., AI\-generated insights) as part of the platform roadmap * Understanding of data isolation, performance segmentation, and secure access in distributed systems **All roles at College Board require:** * **A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities** and mission\-driven work * Authorization to work in the United States for any employer * **Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies**, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI\-driven solutions and a comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively. * **Clear and concise communication skills**, written and verbal * **A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth:**welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input. * **A drive for impact and excellence:**solving complex problems, making data\-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking. * **A collaborative and empathetic approach:**working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success. **About Our attorneys and clients regarding Cooley practice group services and software * Partner with product managers and practitioners to prioritize form collection, template automation, and automated testing based on business value, user feedback, and regulatory requirements * Assist with automation efforts for practice group work product and processes * Develop automated testing methodologies to support seamless and efficient deployment of updated legal language via digital platforms * Assist with usability and accessibility testing to ensure legal software enhances user experience for attorneys, proactive mitigation strategies. * Promote continuous learning across the group in the needs of the assigned practice group and the impact of solutions delivered to\-date * Foster strong working relationships between practitioners, QA, software engineering, legal engineering, and operations to enhance collaboration across departments * All other duties as assigned or required **Skills and experience:** Required: * After orientation at Cooley LLP, exhibit proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite, iManage and other firm applications * Ability to work extended and/or weekend hours, as collaborate with multiple stakeholders across various departments (legal, IS, etc.) * Ability to work effectively in a highly matrixed team environment * Outstanding communication skills Cooley offers As a Lead Electrical Engineer on our Oil Free Centrifugal team, you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and supporting the electrical component, hardware development and additionally work with the lab team providing support and training. Based in our Sidney, OH location, you will be a team member on the Oil\-Free Centrifugal team. This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious, process\-oriented person. **As a Centrifugal Electrical Engineer, you will:** * Work closely with the Controls Engineering team to learn and understand the control method and develop the process for validating electrical hardware. * Follow the requirements of Copeland Business System * Work together to optimize the design, program logic, testing methods of the controller, control program, VFD, motor, cabling, transformer and supervisory control system. * Explore the opportunity for ancillary equipment (remote data communication and storage, control program updates, 120V power supply transformer, HVAC, Hydraulic Control Center (HCC), etc.) * Own and optimize the design, performance and durability of the electrical systems * Work and draw conclusions from test data obtained during validation activities * Train and support production and field teams on product assembly and connection processes * Document electrical system safety best practices for the company * Lead troubleshooting efforts on OFC compressor controller, drive and motor * Field service support may be required on occasion * Conduct RCCMs (Root Cause Failure Analysis) of failed OFC units * Conduct electrical system modeling for unique deployment configurations * “I Own Safety” leader and facilitator, p rocess changes /implementation and participate/initiate continuous improvement processes **REQUIRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS:** * Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering or related discipline * A minimum of 7 years of electrical engineering experience in an industrial environment minimum of 3 years in power electronics integration, motion control, turbomachinery or similar * Demonstrated success in hands\-on setup, operation and troubleshooting of complex electrical systems * Ability to use and set up test equipment, such as oscilloscopes, data loggers/analyzers, software development tools, etc. * Familiarity with the safety requirements for high power applications * Understanding of digital, analog and power electronics components and operation * Strong oral and written communication skills * Good interpersonal, project management, presentation, and teamwork skills * Ability to run multiple projects in a fast\-paced engineering environment * Understanding of lean manufacturing principles * Proficient in use of Microsoft Office programs * Ability to travel up to 10\-15% of the time including some international travel * Legal Authorization to work in the United States \- Sponsorship will not be provided for this role **PREFERRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS:** * Minimum of 3 years in power electronics integration, motion control, turbomachinery or similar highly preferred * Power electronics troubleshooting experience is preferred * Hands\-on familiarity with industrial communication protocols, such as Modbus and signal level instrumentation, is preferred * Experience in the design of digital, analog and power electronic circuits is a plus * Familiarity with motor controls is a plus * Familiarity with the agency approval process (UL, CE, etc.) is a plus \#LI\-GR1 **Our Commitment to Our People** Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal \- to make the world a better place. We invest in the end\-to\-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally. Learn more about us and how you can join our team! **Our Commitment to Inclusion \& Belonging** At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment. If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: copeland.careers@copeland.com

We align to a set of Values that are the core pillars that define our culture and help bring our brand purpose to life: * We are stronger as one: We collaborate across the enterprise, scale what works and act decisively for our customers and partners. * We deliver on commitments: We are accountable, empower each other and go above and beyond for our stakeholders. * We learn, improve and innovate: We get better each day by challenging the status quo and equipping ourselves for the future. * We are inclusive: We embrace different perspectives, enabling our colleagues to make an impact and bring their whole selves to work. **Who You’ll Work With** The Information Technology organization is the technological foundation of our business and works in collaboration with our partners from across the company. inference, and lifecycle management on AWS. * AWS Engineering: Develop and support cloud\-native solutions using relevant AWS services for compute, storage, networking, security, observability, data processing, and AI/ML, including Amazon Bedrock and Amazon SageMaker where applicable. * Generative and Agentic AI Enablement: Support the development and integration of generative AI applications, AI agents, APIs, model endpoints, prompt workflows, and retrieval\-augmented generation solutions. * Platform Automation: Create infrastructure\-as\-code, CI/CD pipelines, deployment templates, configuration standards, and self\-service capabilities that improve engineering productivity and consistency. * Data and Integration: Help connect AI/ML workloads to enterprise data platforms, APIs, event streams, and data pipelines while applying appropriate access controls and data\-handling standards. * Security and Governance: Implement platform controls for identity and access management, secrets protection, encryption, logging, monitoring, auditability, model governance, and responsible AI practices. * Reliability and Operations: Build monitoring, alerting, troubleshooting, cost\-management, and operational support capabilities for AI/ML services and production workloads. * Collaboration: Partner with data scientists, software engineers, data engineers, architects, security teams, and business stakeholders to translate use\-case needs into scalable platform solutions. * Continuous Learning: Evaluate emerging AI/ML and AWS technologies through prototypes and jobs.title: System Administrator (Cleveland, OH)
jobs.description: **Who We Are** We’re Dealer Tire, a family\-owned, international distributor of tires and parts established in 1918 in Cleveland, OH. We’re laser focused on helping the world’s largest and most trusted auto manufacturers grow their tire business—in fact, we’ve sold more than 60 million tires to date. We’re a thriving company, and we’re looking for driven individuals to join our team. That’s where you come in! **Base Pay Range:** $82,000\-$90,000**Position Summary** The System Administrator is responsible for the administration, maintenance, security, and operational support of the organization's on\-premises and cloud infrastructure. This role supports Windows and Linux operating systems, VMware environments, Active Directory services, cloud platforms, and enterprise applications while ensuring system availability, security compliance, and operational excellence. Relevant responsibilities align with existing Dealer Tire server administration functions. **As a Systems Administrator, your essential job functions will include the following**: * Administer and support Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Configure Conditional Access, Single sign\-on (SSO), Enterprise Apps * Maintain AWS and Microsoft Azure resources. Troubleshoot cloud\-based infrastructure and application issues. * Manage VMware vSphere, virtual machines, monitor infrastructure health and resolve performance issues. * Identify, assess, and remediate operating system and infrastructure vulnerabilities, Participate in vulnerability management and compliance meetings. * Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Linux Server and Windows operating systems, Perform system patching, upgrades, and lifecycle management, Support backup, recovery, and disaster recovery processes. * Manage Active Directory users, groups, organizational units, and Group Policies, Administer DNS, DHCP, DFS, and related infrastructure services. * Support Kubernetes clusters running on\-premises or in cloud environments, assist with deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting of containerized workloads. * Respond to and resolve incidents, service requests, and operational issues, document procedures, troubleshooting steps, and technical solutions. * Coordinate with Network Engineers, Business Analyst, and Database Administrators to implement client/server systems that utilize industry best practices to meet corporate objectives * Establish and adhere to company metrics for system uptime, problem response, and resolution. * Interact closely with hardware and software vendors, leveraging the vendor as the next (higher) level of support in addition to license compliance matters. * Develop and promote standard operating procedures (SOP’s). * Proactively recommend improvements to both Physical and Virtual infrastructures and processes to ensure systems are designed to support business requirements, reliability, and performance * Analyze and determine hardware/software issues by applying a backup process or resolution such as operational discrepancies, job aborts, and connectivity issues. Interact with application teams to prepare schedules for nightly backups. Resolve issues and problems with backup solutions; directly work with outside support vendors to resolve hardware/software issues. * Ensure the integrity and security of enterprise data on host computers, multiple databases, and during data transfer in accordance with business needs and industry best practices regarding privacy, security, and regulatory compliance. * Participates in 24x7 off hour/on call schedule on a rotating basis. * Looks for innovative ways to use AI tools to streamline and automate processes. * Other Duties as Assigned **Position Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent work experience. * 3\+ years working with Microsoft operating systems and applications, including Windows 2016 / 2019/ 2022/2025 * 3\+ working with Linux operating systems and applications, including Red Hat 7, 8 and SUSE 15, 16\. * Minimum of 1 year experience supporting Citrix environment or similar equivalent. * Understanding of Citrix or an equivalent product * Understanding Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) * Experience with backup software in an 800\+ server environment. * Embraces new technology, automation, and AI tools * Configure and troubleshoot network services at the operating‑system level, including interface setup, routing, name resolution, and connectivity across Linux and Windows environments. * Ability to work with challenging deadlines, fast pace, ever changing environment. **Competencies Required** * Results Orientation * Agility * Initiative * Influence * Customer Focus * Learn Quickly * Recognize Implications * Apply Knowledge **Physical Job Requirements** * Must be able to install/remove rack mounted servers and PC’s including peripheral equipment such as network switches, printers, etc. * Work in front of a computer screen for extended periods of time. * Participates in 24x7 off hour/on call schedule on a rotating basis. * Lift and move computer devices up to 50 pounds. * Travel as necessary, \< 10%. **Drug Policy** * Dealer Tire is a drug\-free environment. All applicants being considered for employment must pass a pre\-employment drug screening before beginning work. **Why Dealer Tire:** An amazing opportunity to join a growing organization, built on the efforts of hard working, innovative, and team\-oriented people. The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and geographic location. The total compensation package may also include commission, bonus or profit sharing. We offer a competitive \& comprehensive benefit package including: paid time off, medical, dental, vision, and 401k match (50% on the dollar up to 7% of employee contribution). For more information on our benefit offerings, please visit our Dealer Tire Family of Companies Benefits Highlights Booklet. **EOE Statement:** Dealer Tire is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, religion, gender, age, veteran status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status or disability (in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act\*), or any other legally protected status, with respect to employment opportunities. * ADA Disclosure: Any candidate who feels that they may need an accommodation to complete this application, or any portions of same, based on the impact of a disability should contact Dealer Tire’s Human Resources Department to discuss your specific needs. Please feel free to contact us at 1\-800\-933\-2537 x6550\.

jobs.title: QA Engineer Associate
jobs.description: Launch your technology career as a **QA Engineer Associate**, where you'll help ensure the quality, performance, and reliability of enterprise applications through both manual and automated testing. You'll collaborate with developers, product owners, and cross\-functional teams while gaining hands\-on experience with Azure, DevOps practices, AI\-powered testing tools, and modern development technologies. This is an exciting opportunity for an early\-career professional who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and contributing to innovative digital solutions. If you're passionate about software quality, automation, and continuous improvement, we'd love to meet you. **Job Title:** QA Engineer Associate **FLSA Status:** Exempt **Department:** Web Development Services **Reports To:** Supervisor of Architecture, DevOps, Engineering **Position Summary** We are seeking a motivated Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer Associate to join our team and contribute to the testing of the enterprise applications. In this role, you will test both front\-end and back\-end components with different testing tools, while collaborating with senior engineers and cross\-functional teams. You will gain hands\-on experience with Azure cloud services, and modern DevOps practices, ensuring secure, scalable, and high\-performing solutions. This position offers an excellent opportunity to apply your technical skills, learn industry best practices, and grow within a dynamic and innovative environment. **Essential Functions and Job Responsibilities** * Assist in developing the test plan and test scripts for the portals and other applications. * Perform QA by execution of manual and automated test scripts. * Design and implement innovative automation solutions to streamline internal processes and optimize business workflows. * Participate in sprint planning, issue tracking, and progress reporting using Jira. * Work with Visual Studio Code, SQL Server Management Studio, and other modern development and testing tools. * Leverage AI\-powered tools and analytics to improve test coverage, identify quality trends, and enhance defect detection and resolution processes. * Develop and maintain unit\-based testing scripts. * Ensure compliance with data protection and privacy standards. * Handles low to moderate difficulty development tasks, resolving issues through established processes and standard engineering practices rather than complex or novel solutions. * Collaborate with development team, product owners, UI/UX designers, implementation partners, and offshore teams to deliver features on time. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field, or soon to graduate with 1–3 years of relevant experience through internships, co\-ops, or academic projects in Application testing using Playwright, Postman, Selenium, Apache JMeter, etc., and exposure to full\-stack development using Angular, Node.js, JavaScript, C\#, and Python. * Basic understanding of Azure services, containerization (AKS), and CI/CD pipelines. * Familiarity with SQL Server, RESTful APIs, and secure coding principles. * Strong problem\-solving skills and willingness to learn new technologies. * Demonstrated commitment to the company’s core values of integrity, adaptability, service\-focused, accountability, curiosity, and community. **Working Environment** This position currently functions as a hybrid role working from both home and in\-office environments. Any home office setting must be conducive to all guidelines outlined by the organization. This role operates in a general office environment and may require prolonged periods of sitting and regular use of a computer and standard office equipment. This position also requires attendance at in\-person meetings, with frequency determined by management based on departmental or organizational needs. **Physical and Other Demands** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Specific vision abilities require the ability to focus distant and near objects clearly. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to use hands and arms to handle, feel and reach as well as operate a personal computer. **Disclaimer** This job description is designed to provide a general overview of the requirements of the job and does not entail a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties, or responsibilities that will be required. The organization reserves the right to modify this job description at any time; including assigning or reassigning job duties. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.description: Job Posting: Cloud DevOps Engineer Department of Public Health JC\-532118* Cloud DevOps Engineer INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY SPECIALIST I $6,513\.00 \- $10,537\.00 per Month New to State candidates will be hired into the minimum salary of the classification or minimum of alternate range when applicable. **Final Filing Date:** **9/29/2026** **Application Methods:**Electronic (Using your CalCareer Account) By Mail Drop\-off Print Job Save Job ### **Job Description and Duties** The Cloud DevOps Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, automating, and securing cloud\-based applications and infrastructure to ensure the delivery of highly available, scalable, and reliable systems. This role integrates software development, cloud architecture, infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipeline management, monitoring, and security to streamline application deployment and improve overall operational efficiency. The engineer supports the full application lifecycle, collaborating with development teams to plan architectures, write and maintain code, implement testing practices, and document designs to ensure long\-term maintainability. A key focus of the position is building and managing cloud environments using industry\-standard tools and infrastructure\-as\-code methodologies. The engineer deploys secure and resilient cloud architectures, optimizes performance and resource utilization, and automates operational processes to reduce manual intervention and risk. Through strong DevOps practices, the engineer maintains CI/CD pipelines, supports containerized and microservices\-based systems, and ensures consistent, reliable delivery workflows. Reliability, security, and compliance are central to the role. The Cloud DevOps Engineer monitors system health, troubleshoots issues, participates in incident response, and contributes to disaster recovery planning. The engineer applies cloud security best practices, manages identity and access controls, addresses vulnerabilities, and supports regulatory requirements. Through ongoing collaboration, documentation, and evaluation of emerging technologies, the Cloud DevOps Engineer drives continuous improvement and helps build a robust, future\-ready cloud environment aligned with organizational goals. In July 2025, the State of California implemented the Personal Leave Program (PLP) 2025\. This program temporarily reduces employees’ monthly base pay in exchange for paid leave credits. This position is subject to PLP 2025 and will have a monthly base pay reduction of 3% in exchange for 5 hours of leave credits through June 2027\. The salary ranges shown on this job posting do not reflect the salary reduction. **Please let us know how you heard about our position by taking this brief survey:** **https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/CDPHRecruitment** You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**. ### **Working Conditions** **Telework Information:** This position may be eligible for telework. The amount of telework permitted is at the discretion of the Department and is subject to change, consistent with CDPH’s Telework Program. All employees who telework are required to be California residents in accordance with Government Code 14200\. Candidates who reside outside of the state of California may be interviewed; however, the selected candidate must have a primary residency in the state of California prior to appointment (and continue to maintain California residency) as a condition of employment. Failure to meet this requirement may result in the job offer being rescinded. Travel may be required for this position. Reimbursement for travel takes into consideration an employee’s designated headquarters, as reflected in the duty statement, and is subject to regulations and bargaining unit contract provisions. All commute expenses to the designated headquarters office will be the responsibility of the selected candidate. The headquarters office location for this position is identified in the attached duty statement. ### **Position Details** **Job Code \#:** JC\-532118 **Position \#(s):** 580\-151\-1402\-909 **Working Title:** **Cloud DevOps Engineer** **Classification:** INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY SPECIALIST I $6,513\.00 \- $8,729\.00 A $7,163\.00 \- $9,599\.00 B $7,864\.00 \- $10,537\.00 C New to State candidates will be hired into the minimum salary of the classification or minimum of alternate range when applicable. **\# of Positions:** 1 **Work Location:** Sacramento County **Telework:** Hybrid **Job Type:** Permanent, Full Time ### **Department Information** At the California Department of Public Health (CDPH), equity, diversity, and inclusion are at the core of our mission to advance the health and well\-being of California’s diverse people and communities. We are genuinely and strongly committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and connectedness where we can grow and learn together with a diverse team of employees. In recruiting for team members tions may be directed to the EEO contact listed on this job posting. ### **Desirable Qualifications** In addition to evaluating each candidate's relative ability, as demonstrated by quality and breadth of experience, the following factors will provide the basis for competitively evaluating each candidate: * Three or more years of experience as a .NET / C\# software engineer * Three or more years of experience supporting cloud infrastructure and DevOps environments. * Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure * Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation. * Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar languages. * Experience with Git\-based source control platforms. * Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. * Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud). * Experience supporting healthcare, financial, or other regulated environments. * Knowledge of security frameworks and compliance requirements. * Experience supporting cloud\-hosted data platforms, analytics solutions, or enterprise applications. ### **Benefits** **Benefit information can be found on the** **CalHR** **website and the** **CalPERS** **website.** ### **Contact Information** The Human Resources Contact is available to answer questions regarding the application process. (Resumes do not take the place of the Statement of Qualifications) **Questions:** In your SOQ, please provide responses to the following questions: * Describe your experience as a .NET / C\# software engineer. * Describe your experience designing, deploying, or maintaining cloud infrastructure. * Discuss your experience building and supporting CI/CD pipelines or deployment automation. Discuss the tools, scripting languages (such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash), and techniques you used to improve system reliability and delivery efficiency. * Discuss your experience implementing cloud security best practices, managing IAM controls, addressing vulnerabilities, or supporting compliance requirements. Explain how you ensure secure configurations in a cloud environment. ### **Equal Opportunity Employer** The State of California is an equal opportunity employer to all, regardless of age, ancestry, color, disability (mental and physical), exercising the right to family care and medical leave, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, military or veteran status, national origin, political affiliation, race, religious creed, sex (includes pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and related medical conditions), and sexual orientation.
