jobs.title: Chief Engineer
jobs.description: Position Overview We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled **Chief Engineer** to lead and oversee all engineering, facilities, and maintenance operations for our hotel. The Chief Engineer is responsible for ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of the hotel’s mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, life\-safety, and building systems. This leadership role requires a hands\-on approach, strong technical expertise, and the ability to effectively manage an engineering team in a fast\-paced hospitality environment. The Chief Engineer will work closely with hotel leadership and other departments to maintain exceptional guest comfort, protect the property’s assets, minimize downtime, and ensure compliance with applicable safety and regulatory requirements. The successful candidate will promote a culture of safety, preventive maintenance, accountability, and service excellence while identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency, sustainability, and the overall condition of the property. Key Responsibilities * Lead, supervise, and develop the hotel engineering and maintenance team, overseeing daily operations and ensuring work is completed safely, efficiently, and to a high standard. * Maintain reliable operation of the hotel’s **HVAC, electrical, plumbing, mechanical, building, and life\-safety systems**. * Establish, implement, and maintain preventive and corrective maintenance programs to protect property assets and minimize equipment downtime. * Manage the hotel’s **CMMS** to monitor work orders, preventive maintenance schedules, equipment history, inspections, and outstanding repairs. * Respond to and coordinate the troubleshooting of mechanical, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, controls, and building\-system issues, prioritizing guest comfort and operational continuity. * Diagnose electrical and mechanical problems using appropriate testing equipment, including voltmeters and ohmmeters, and interpret electrical, mechanical, and HVAC schematics and technical manuals. * Oversee the maintenance and repair of HVAC equipment, pumps, motors, plumbing systems, electrical systems, low\-voltage systems, controls, and other hotel equipment. * Coordinate inspections, testing, and maintenance of life\-safety and emergency systems in accordance with applicable codes, regulations, and hotel requirements. * Conduct regular property inspections to identify safety hazards, maintenance deficiencies, energy inefficiencies, and potential capital needs. * Ensure engineering operations comply with **OSHA requirements, applicable building and safety codes, environmental regulations, and company standards**. * Develop and conduct safety training, toolbox talks, and other training programs to promote safe work practices. * Manage engineering projects, renovations, repairs, and property improvements from planning through completion, including budgeting, scheduling, vendor coordination, and quality control. * Work closely with hotel leadership, housekeeping, front office, food and beverage, and other departments to respond promptly to operational and guest\-related maintenance needs. * Maintain accurate records, documentation, inspections, maintenance reports, and equipment histories. * Coordinate and oversee outside contractors and service providers, ensuring work is completed safely, professionally, and according to specifications. * Monitor departmental expenses, maintenance costs, inventory, and purchasing while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and control costs. * Support sustainability initiatives, including energy conservation, water efficiency, waste reduction, and responsible equipment operation. * Participate in emergency response procedures and provide engineering support during outages, severe weather, equipment failures, and other emergencies. * Foster a professional team environment built on accountability, communication, teamwork, safety, and exceptional service. Qualifications \& Skills * Proven leadership experience managing a hotel engineering, facilities, or maintenance department, preferably within a full\-service or complex hospitality environment. * Strong hands\-on knowledge of **HVAC, electrical, plumbing, mechanical, building, and facilities systems**. * Experience troubleshooting electrical systems, controls, HVAC equipment, motors, pumps, plumbing systems, and other mechanical equipment. * Knowledge of **programmable logic controllers (PLCs), low\-voltage systems, building controls, electrical wiring, and technical schematics**. * Ability to use electrical and diagnostic testing equipment safely and effectively. * Working knowledge of OSHA requirements, safety practices, applicable building codes, and regulatory compliance. * Experience developing and managing preventive maintenance programs. * Proficiency with **CMMS platforms** and computerized work\-order and asset\-management systems. * Strong project management skills, including budgeting, scheduling, contractor management, and completion of capital and maintenance projects. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and the ability to maintain accurate operational and maintenance documentation. * Strong organizational and problem\-solving skills with the ability to prioritize multiple requests in a fast\-paced hotel environment. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with guests, hotel leadership, associates, contractors, and vendors. * Ability to lead, coach, motivate, and hold engineering team members accountable for performance, safety, and quality. * Strong written and verbal English communication skills. * Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends, holidays, and participate in an emergency/on\-call rotation as required by hotel operations. Leadership Expectations The Chief Engineer is expected to be a visible and engaged leader who takes ownership of the hotel’s physical plant and engineering operations. The position should balance **hands\-on technical expertise with effective team leadership**, ensuring that maintenance issues are addressed proactively rather than reactively. Success in this role means maintaining a safe, comfortable, efficient, and well\-maintained property while supporting an exceptional guest experience and developing a high\-performing engineering team. Pay: $22\.00 \- $27\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Benefits: * Employee discount * Flexible schedule * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.description: Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes. Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under immense pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in new partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful and substantive change. To succeed long\-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients. Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer\-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise. Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future. We are looking for a Platform Integration Engineer to join our engineering team and take on one of our most strategically important challenges: unifying a diverse ecosystem of analytics applications under a coherent, scalable technology platform. Our analytics landscape has grown organically across multiple teams and products. The result is a collection of powerful but siloed tools — each with its own technology stack, data contracts, and deployment patterns. You will be the connective tissue that brings these applications together, making pragmatic decisions about when to consolidate and when to preserve the right tool for the right job. This role is for an engineer who is energized by ambiguity, skilled at reading distributed systems, and opinionated (but flexible) about platform design. You will work directly with engineering leads and data teams, and you will be empowered to use AI\-assisted development tools as a first\-class part of your workflow.**What** **You’ll** **Do** **Platform Unification \& Integration** * Audit existing analytics applications to understand their underlying technology choices, data flows, and integration points * Design and implement integration patterns (APIs, event streams, shared data contracts) that allow siloed applications to interoperate without unnecessary rewrites * Evaluate build vs. consolidate vs. federate tradeoffs for components across the platform, documenting your rationale and driving alignment * Build and maintain shared platform services — authentication, observability, configuration management, logging — that reduce duplication across applications **Data Pipeline \& ETL Engineering** * Develop a deep understanding of existing data pipelines owned by distributed teams — including their data sources, transformation logic, and dependencies * Design and build a unified presentation layer that surfaces data from heterogeneous compute environments — including large\-scale distributed systems (e.g., Spark) and traditional relational databases — in a consistent, accessible way * Partner with domain teams who have the deepest knowledge of their own data — acting as an integration architect and collaborator rather than a centralized pipeline owner; identify unification opportunities but defer to domain expertise on data semantics and processing logic **Cloud Infrastructure** * Deploy and manage platform services on cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred; Azure/GCP experience a plus) * Contribute to infrastructure\-as\-code practices using tools such as Terraform, CDK, or Pulumi * Collaborate with DevOps/SRE to define deployment pipelines and reliability standards for integration services * Construct evidence\-based business cases for cloud feature adoption — translating technical requirements into business value, risk reduction, and compliance language that resonates with IT governance and procurement stakeholders **What** **We’re** **Looking For** **Required Qualifications** * 3\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 1 years focused on integration, platform, or infrastructure work * Proficiency in at least one backend language commonly used in data\-intensive systems (Python, Go, Java, or similar); proficiency in two or more languages strongly preferred * Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS strongly preferred) including compute, storage, networking, and managed services * Experience building and operating data pipelines (ETL/ELT), including schema management and data quality monitoring * Working experience with AI\-assisted development tooling in a professional engineering context * Strong written communication skills — able to produce clear architecture decision records (ADRs), runbooks, and design documents **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience evaluating and rationalizing heterogeneous technology stacks — i.e., inheriting systems you didn’t design and making them work together * Familiarity with analytics or ML platform tooling (e.g., Airflow, dbt, MLflow, Spark, or SaaS equivalents) * Experience with API gateway management, service mesh, or distributed tracing tooling * Background working with both structured (SQL) and semi\-structured (JSON, Parquet, Avro) data at scale **How You Work** We care as much about how you think as what you’ve built. The ideal candidate for this role: * Is pragmatic over dogmatic — you reach for the right solution given real constraints, not the theoretically perfect one * Communicates tradeoffs clearly to both technical peers and non\-technical stakeholders * Is comfortable making a recommendation and defending it, but genuinely updates when presented with better information * Brings structure to ambiguous problems — you can walk into a complex legacy system and produce a clear map of what’s there * Understands that “don’t touch what works” and “build it right” are often both correct answers, depending on context * Takes ownership of quality and reliability — you care about what happens after you ship **What We Offer** * Competitive base salary commensurate with experience * Flexible remote\-first or hybrid work environment * Opportunity to define integration and platform patterns that will shape the organization’s technical direction The estimated base salary for this job is $100,000 \- $130,000 USD. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay for performance philosophy. Inclusive of annual incentive compensation opportunity, the total estimated compensation range for this job is $112,000 \- $153,400 USD. jobs.title: Data Scientist & Machine Learning Engineer (Bellevue, Denver or LA)
jobs.description: **Summary / Objective** The Data \& Analytics team builds and manages data systems, analyzes information to generate insights, and develops machine learning models to support automated decisioning. As a Data Scientist and Machine Learning Engineer, you will work across (and connect) the expertise of these two related but distinct disciplines. Your responsibilities will include (but not be limited to): deriving data insights to drive decision making, applying ML and modeling techniques to solve business problems, and deploying and managing those models in production. This role reports to the Director of Business Intelligence. **What You'll Do** * Translate complex business problems into data, modeling, and machine\-learning solutions * Collect, clean, transform, and validate data for analysis and model development * Explore data to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, and actionable insights * Design, train, evaluate, and refine predictive or optimization models * Select appropriate features, algorithms, metrics, and validation strategies * Build reproducible data and machine\-learning pipelines * Deploy models for batch or real\-time inference * Develop and maintain infrastructure for reliable model serving * Monitor model performance, data quality, drift, latency, and operational health * Communicate findings and collaborate with stakeholders, engineers, and domain experts * Actively models and promotes Identity Digital’s core values through day\-to\-day interactions, behaviors, and decision\-making * Other duties as assigned **Who You Are / What You Bring** * 3\+ years of experience in developing, deploying, and monitoring production data / ML pipelines * Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or other quantitative field is required; Advanced degree (Masters or PhD) in AI/ML preferred * Deep technical knowledge in several of the following topics: anomaly detection, time\-series analysis, structured and unstructured data processing, causal inference, reinforcement learning, embeddings and vector databases, large language models, and modern MLOps / LLMOps practices * Professional development experience with the following tools and platforms: Airflow, Argo Workflows, cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake), major cloud providers (AWS, GCP), Git, Kubernetes, MLFlow, Pandas, Polars, PyTorch, TensorFlow, SHAP and leveraging AI / LLMs. * Strong programming proficiency in Python and SQL; familiarity with Shell scripting is a plus * Exceptional problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve issues from limited or ambiguous information * Creative and strategic thinker with a strong analytical foundation and a focus on measurable impact * Collaborative communicator who excels in cross\-functional environments and builds strong working relationships * Highly organized with excellent time management, attention to detail, and execution discipline * Knowledge of the domain name industry or digital identity ecosystem is a plus * Ability to travel as needed * Ability to work across time zones as part of a global organization as needed * Reliable transportation to the workplace **Physical Requirements** * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times **Location** This is a hybrid role based in one of our US offices: * Bellevue, WA * Denver, CO * El Segundo, CA We welcome applications from candidates who currently live near these locations or are willing to relocate. **Salary Range** The U.S. base salary range for this full\-time position is $107,000 \- $139,000 (flexibility based on experience) plus benefits as described below. In addition, the successful candidate will be eligible to receive other compensation from time to time in the form of discretionary and/or nondiscretionary bonuses and long\-term incentive plan. Actual compensation will be influenced by a candidate’s qualifications, internal employee equity considerations, and location. We will not ask for information about a candidate's current or past compensation for purposes of developing an offer of employment. US team members (and their spouses, domestic partners, and/or dependent children) are covered by generously subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance which includes company contributions to a Health Savings Accounts. Team members are also covered by company\-paid life and disability insurance and have the option of participating in employee\-paid supplemental life, accidental death and dismemberment, critical illness, and accident insurance. In addition, team members can enroll in the company's 401(k) plan with up to a 5% match. You receive 15 days of paid vacation yearly, increasing to 20 days after one year. Additionally, you get 5 days of paid sick leave, 13 paid holidays, and 20 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents, 12 weeks for others. Also, there's an opportunity for tuition reimbursement for qualifying expenses. Note: Benefits programs are subject to eligibility requirements and may vary in certain locations. **A few things to know about us** Identity Digital is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or any other category prohibited by local, state or federal law. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, placement, promotion, transfer, demotion, compensation, benefits, social and recreational activities, and termination. **Background Check Statement** At the time of an offer, you will be required to complete a background check. While we strive to support our candidates, not all roles will qualify. Eligibility will be reviewed on a case\-by\-case basis. **Accommodation Statement** We are committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Identity Digital will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. jobs.title: Product Manager I
jobs.description: **Our Mission** --------------- As the world’s number 1 job site\*, our mission is to help people get jobs. We strive to cultivate an inclusive and accessible workplace where all people feel comfortable being themselves. We're looking to grow our teams with more people who share our enthusiasm for innovation and creating the best experience for job seekers. (\*Comscore, Total Visits, March 2026\)**Day to Day** -------------- At Indeed, we're dedicated to facilitating meaningful connections between job seekers and employers, ultimately resulting in successful hires. As a Product Manager, you'll occupy a central position in shaping the future of our messaging platform and refining the overall user experience. Your responsibilities will encompass the end\-to\-end process\- building, owning, and maintaining products and features within the Messaging domain. Partnering closely with diverse teams across Indeed, your role will be instrumental in enhancing our platform to assist people in securing meaningful employment opportunities. Join us in our mission to empower people to find their dream jobs!**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Partner with engineering teams and other interested parties to prioritize and manage roadmaps for delivering toward product vision incrementally and efficiently. * Communicate roadmap and product plan to and get alignment with leadership, collaborators and interested parties. * Be the face of the customer internally, advocating for, and representing their needs, opportunities, and product requirements. * Identify, and monitor product goals and success metrics. * Iterate quickly to launch new features and make data\-driven judgments to test their efficacy. * Provide clear written and verbal updates on the roadmap and progress toward goals to leadership and collaborators. **Skills/Competencies** ----------------------- * Requires a minimum of 7 years of related experience; or a minimum of 5 years with a Bachelor’s degree; or 3 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD without experience. * Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to align partners and communicate roadmap decisions clearly. * Experience working closely with engineers, designers, and data scientists to define, prioritize, and deliver product improvements. * Data\-driven mindset including experience with data analytics tools (SQL or equivalent), A/B testing, comfortable writing queries, interpreting experiment results, and making decisions grounded in evidence. * Deep curiosity and accountability for the data and insights of their products. **Salary Range Transparency** ----------------------------- Tier 2 \- United States of America 115,000 \- 173,000 USD per year**Salary Range Disclaimer** --------------------------- The salary range for this role reflects the minimum and maximum compensation for the role. We have a multitude of benefits to support Indeedians, as well as their pets, kids, and partners including medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance. Indeedians are able to enroll in our company’s 401k plan, as well as an equity\-based incentive program. Indeedians will also receive open paid time off, 11 paid holidays a year and up to 26 weeks of paid parental leave. For more information, select your country and learn more about our employee benefits, program, \& perks at https://www.indeed.com/careers/benefits!**Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement** ---------------------------------------------------- Indeed is deeply committed to building a workplace and global community where inclusion is not only valued, but prioritized. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, family status, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, neuro\-diversity, disability, age, or veteran status, or any other non\-merit based or legally protected grounds. Indeed provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in the employment application process. To request an accommodation, please visit https://www.indeed.com/careers/accommodations. If you are requesting accommodation for an interview, please reach out at least one week in advance of your interview. For more information about our commitment to equal opportunity/affirmative action, please visit our Careers page (https://www.indeed.com/careers). **Inclusion \& Belonging** Inclusion and belonging are fundamental to our hiring practices and company culture, forming an integral part of our vision for a better world of work. At Indeed, we’re committed to the wellbeing of our employees and on a mission to make this the best place to work and thrive. We believe that fostering an inclusive environment where every employee feels respected and accepted benefits everyone, fueling innovation and creativity. We value diverse experiences, including those who have had prior contact with the criminal legal system. We are committed to providing individuals with criminal records, including formerly incarcerated individuals, a fair chance at employment. Those with military experience are encouraged to apply. Equivalent expertise demonstrated through a combination of work experience, training, military experience, or education is welcome.**Indeed’s Employee Recruiting Privacy Policy** ----------------------------------------------- Like other employers Indeed uses our own technologies to help us find and attract top talent from around the world. In addition to our site’s user and privacy policy found at https://www.indeed.com/legal, we also want to make you aware of our recruitment specific privacy policy found at https://www.indeed.com/legal/indeed\-jobs. **Agency Disclaimer** Indeed does not pay placement fees for unsolicited resumes or referrals from non\-candidates, including search firms, staffing agencies, professional recruiters, fee\-based referral services, and recruiting agencies (each individually, an "Agency"), subject to local laws. jobs.title: Warehouse Supervisor
jobs.description: At IEM, we're not just building innovative electrical distribution systems, we're shaping the future. IEM is dedicated to delivering world\-class solutions for complex power needs. After 75 years, we continue to push the boundaries of what's possible. Whether you're an experienced professional or just starting out, you'll have the opportunity to contribute, grow, and make a lasting impact on industries that power the world's most dynamic markets. **Position Summary:** IEM is currently seeking a Warehouse Supervisor for our Jacksonville, FL and will report into the Materials Manager. This role plans, organizes, and oversees the shipping and receiving of parts and supplies used to assemble switchgear and related electrical equipment. The Warehouse Supervisor maintains accurate inventory through cycle counts and the annual physical inventory, and prior experience in an industrial manufacturing environment is required. **Please note: This position requires 100% in\-office presence in our Jacksonville, FL offices and does not offer remote work.** **Key Responsibilities:** * Plan and coordinate work, and train, motivate, and monitor the team members who verify and keep records on incoming and outgoing shipments and prepare items for shipment * Review shipping notices, bills of lading, invoices, orders, and other records to set shipping priorities, work assignments, and shipping methods needed to meet shipping and receiving schedules, using knowledge of shipping procedures, routes, and rates * Oversee incoming and outgoing receiving and shipping activities to ensure accuracy, completeness, and condition of shipments as well as inventory accuracy * Maintain inventory of shipping materials and supplies * Inspect material handling equipment for defects and coordinate repairs * Direct movement of shipments from the shipping and receiving area to storage work areas * Assist team members with shipping and receiving activities as needed * Adhere to established safety guidelines * Directly supervise the Material Control Attendant * The candidate will be expected to perform additional duties as assigned to support the team and organization **Qualifications:** * High School Diploma or GED required * At least 5 years of experience in warehousing, receiving, inventory control, or materials management within an industrial manufacturing environment, including 2 years of supervisory experience * Demonstrated competencies in technical capability, leadership, ethical conduct, performance management, communication, teamwork, and financial management * Demonstrated career ambition with a track record of growth and increasing responsibility; highly promotable with the potential to take on broader leadership roles within a fast\-paced, high\-growth organization **Physical Requirements:** This role is physically active, requiring standing and walking for about 75% of the shift and sitting for the remainder. Employees must be able to lift up to 50 lbs on a continuous basis, and to bend, squat, and climb as needed. The role also requires extended close work on a computer screen and the ability to see small or detailed items, along with the ability to interpret information and manage multiple tasks at once. Work takes place in both a climate\-controlled office and a shop or warehouse area that is not climate\-controlled, with exposure to heat, cold, moisture, noise, dust, and fumes. Compensation actually offered for this role will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. **Why Join IEM** At IEM, you'll join a team that powers some of the world's most ambitious projects. We're engineers, makers, and problem\-solvers who thrive on tackling complex challenges and delivering solutions that keep industries moving forward. If you're driven, collaborative, and ready to make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Your creativity and passion can help us achieve great things—come be part of the journey. Learn more about IEM at https://www.iemfg.com We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees' well\-being, growth, and long\-term success. View a snapshot of our benefits at https://www.iemfg.com/careers **Recruiting Scams** Beware of recruiting scams. IEM never charges candidates fees, and all recruiter emails come from an @iemfg.com address. If you suspect fraudulent activity, do not share personal information and report it to us at iemfg.com/contact **Non\-Discrimination Statement** IEM does not discriminate against any applicant based on any characteristic protected by law. **Privacy** Information collected and processed as part of your IEM Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to IEM's Workforce Member Privacy Policy. **Use of AI** At IEM, we are committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. Use the link below to view how we use artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing job applications and your rights as an applicant. AI Use in IEM's Hiring Process

jobs.title: .Net Programmer Analyst
jobs.description: **Please go through the below job description and if you are interested, qualified, available, planning to make a change, or know of a friend who might have the required qualifications and interest, please respond to this posting with an updated resume along with your contact information to reach you.** Please see below the detailed .NET Selenium role job details for ADP \- Number of positions \- 2 Title \- Senior Full Stack .NET Developer – SQL Server \& Selenium Position Overview Our client is seeking a Senior Full Stack .NET Developer to design, develop, test, and support enterprise applications within a large\-scale business environment. This is a hands\-on development position requiring strong experience across the full application stack, including C\#/.NET, front\-end development, SQL Server, and Selenium test automation. The ideal candidate is a well\-rounded developer who can build functionality across the user interface, application/business logic, and database layers while also contributing to automated testing and overall application quality. This individual should be comfortable owning development throughout the full software development lifecycle—from requirements and development through testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and production support. Essential Responsibilities * Design, develop, test, enhance, and maintain full\-stack enterprise applications. * Develop backend services, APIs, and business logic using C\# and .NET. * Build and enhance responsive, user\-facing application components using modern front\-end technologies. * Design, develop, and optimize solutions within Microsoft SQL Server, including complex queries and stored procedures. * Develop and maintain Selenium automated tests supporting functional and regression testing. * Ensure application functionality is tested across the UI, application, API, and database layers. * Troubleshoot and resolve issues throughout the full technology stack. * Participate in all phases of the SDLC, including development, testing, deployment, and production support. * Collaborate with product owners, QA, business partners, and other technical teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions. * Write clean, efficient, reusable, and testable code following established engineering standards. * Identify opportunities to improve application performance, reliability, test coverage, and maintainability. * Support application releases and troubleshoot production issues as needed. Required Qualifications * 7\+ years of hands\-on software development experience, with significant experience developing full\-stack enterprise applications. * Strong hands\-on development experience with C\# and Microsoft .NET, including .NET 10\. * Strong experience developing REST APIs, services, and backend application components. * Hands\-on experience with modern front\-end development technologies. * Extensive experience with Microsoft SQL Server. * Strong SQL development experience, including: o Complex queries o Stored procedures o Database design o Query optimization o Performance tuning * Hands\-on experience developing and maintaining Selenium test automation. * Experience testing web applications and incorporating automated testing into the development lifecycle. * Strong understanding of full\-stack application architecture and the interaction between the UI, APIs, business logic, and database layers. * Experience troubleshooting applications across multiple layers of the technology stack. * Experience working within large\-scale enterprise environments. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications * Experience developing Selenium automation using C\#/.NET. * Experience with React, Angular, or another modern JavaScript front\-end framework. * Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. * Experience with unit, integration, functional, and regression testing. * Experience working within Agile/Scrum development environments. * Previous experience supporting payroll, financial services, human capital management, or other enterprise business applications. * Previous experience within the client's environment is highly preferred. * Ability to independently own functionality from development through testing and production implementation. Technical Environment * .NET 10 * C\# * Microsoft SQL Server * Selenium * REST APIs * React / Angular / JavaScript * SQL / Stored Procedures * Test Automation * Full Stack Development * CI/CD * Enterprise Application Development * Agile/Scrum

jobs.title: Sr. Manager Project Engineering
jobs.description: **About Ingredion:** Join Ingredion, where innovation impacts lives worldwide! Without even realizing it, you’ve experienced our work in your favorite chocolate, your pet’s food, the paper you write on, and your everyday snacks. As a global powerhouse across more than 60 industries, we harness the potential of natural ingredients to transform lives. Whether you’re just starting your career or bringing years of experience, there's a place for you here to make a real difference. Be part of our team that values a wide range of perspectives and is committed to shaping a better world with every product we create. Location: Bedford Park, IL (Argo Plant) Workplace type: On Site Successfully lead and optimize a multi\-million\-dollar capital project portfolio by aligning site investment strategies with broader business objectives, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and with measurable operational and financial impact. Develop and mentor a high\-performing team of project engineers, removing barriers to execution, strengthening technical capabilities, and building a sustainable pipeline of engineering talent. Drive continuous improvement through strategic capital investments, best practice adoption, reliability enhancements, and data\-driven decision making, while fostering cross\-functional alignment, stakeholder engagement, and a culture of safety, accountability, and operational excellence. As a **Senior Manager, Project Engineering**, you will be responsible for general portfolio management of their site’s – and other sites – capital budget and strategic plan. They will lead a team of project engineers and are responsible for facilitating the training and mentorship of these engineers. The manager will be influential in the successful development of less experienced members of the site’s teams. The manager is responsible for removing the teams’ barriers to execution. A significant portion of the time will be dedicated to managing people, while overseeing the portfolio. Capable of managing up to ensure the strategic plan of the plant is correct for both the larger company strategic plan and the plant’s needs. This role report to the Director of Project Engineering and oversees a team of seven. **What you will do:** * Develops complex project plans and capital investment proposals, including financial analysis, capital and operating cost estimates, and business case justification. * Creates advanced engineering designs, including material and energy balances, process flow diagrams (PFDs), P\&IDs, and process control strategies. * Manages and optimizes the plant project portfolio through KPI tracking, project reviews, and performance improvement initiatives. * Develops and executes capital investment strategies aligned with long\-term business objectives. * Provides leadership for capital projects by establishing standards, ensuring compliance with policies and procedures, and aligning cross\-functional stakeholders. * Promotes knowledge sharing by leveraging technology, knowledge management systems, and collaborative tools. * Identifies, evaluates, and implements best practices and innovative solutions to improve operational and project performance. * Leads and validates Management of Change (MOC) activities for process, safety, engineering, and operational modifications. * Applies data analysis and technical expertise to support decision\-making, process improvements, and project execution. * Utilizes financial metrics and profit\-and\-loss understanding to guide investment decisions and capital budget allocation. * Builds collaborative relationships across functions to identify, develop, and deliver effective solutions that meet stakeholder expectations. * Leads root cause analyses, process studies, and continuous improvement efforts to enhance safety, quality, reliability, and operational performance. * Directs major maintenance and reliability improvement projects to improve asset performance and operational efficiency. * Applies operational governance standards and project management frameworks to drive consistency and project standardization. * Supports management system implementation, assessments, and the adoption of best operating practices across the organization. * Champions the sharing and adoption of best operating practices, critical routines, and continuous improvement methodologies. **What you will bring:** * Degree or advanced degree in an engineering discipline or relevant, and significant years of experience in project execution. Team leadership experience desired. * Demonstrated success leading engineering organizations and managing complex capital project portfolios in a manufacturing environment. * Experience directing multidisciplinary engineering teams, external consultants, contractors, suppliers, and engineering service providers. * Strong knowledge of capital planning, estimating, budgeting, scheduling, permitting, construction, commissioning, and project closeout. **Who you are:** * Be agile in responding and engaging the team to deliver solutions for customer needs. * Actively listen to team members and motivate them to bring their best. * Drive the development of teams, provide tools and resources, and anticipate future talent needs for the organization and set high standards for team performance. * Clearly communicates expectations, monitors progress and results, and holds individuals and teams accountable. * Collaborates with cross\-functional Site Leadership Team to deliver value for both internal and external customers. * Influences stakeholders with data and strong business cases to gain alignment and inspire action around competing key priorities. * Inspires and influences others. * High emotional intelligent leader with strong self\-awareness. * Increase engagement in teams and plant, enable an inclusive and diverse culture and team. **Why Join Ingredion?** Discover why Ingredion is the ideal place to advance your career with our exceptional rewards and benefits package designed to help you thrive. Create the future with us and enjoy: * Total Rewards Package – Competitive salary and performance\-based pay recognizing your contributions to our success. * Comprehensive Benefits \& Wellness Support – Health, long\-term savings, and resources for your physical, mental, and emotional well\-being * Career Growth – Learning, training, and development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement. * Employee Recognition Program – A culture of real\-time appreciation, with personalized recognition rewards globally * Employee Discount Program – Provides exclusive discounts on everyday products, services, and travel. \#LI\-JS1 \#LI\-ONSITE We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. Ingredion seeks to provide a work environment that is free from harassment and discrimination. We will not tolerate any form of discrimination based on race, color, religion, age, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, handicap or disability—mental or physical—marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability resulting from military service, or any other classification protected by law (“protected classifications”). We are committed to establishing and maintaining a work environment where everyone is treated with dignity and respect. Ingredion provides accommodations to job applicants with disabilities throughout the hiring process. If a job applicant requires an accommodation during the application process or through the selection process, we will work with the applicant to meet the job applicant's accommodation needs. Ingredion uses AI\-enabled tools to support parts of the recruitment process, including resume screening and interview scheduling. These tools help match candidate skills to job requirements and streamline communication. jobs.title: Head of AI & Program Technology Engineering
jobs.description: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non\-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions\-driven, passionate change\-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world\-wide for a better future. The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non\-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. If you're a solutions\-driven, passionate change\-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people worldwide for a better future. **Background:** Build the AI systems that will reach hundreds of millions of people in the world's hardest places. Nearly 240 million people will need humanitarian aid in 2026, and global funding has fallen by more than half. Closing that gap demands a different kind of humanitarian organization — one that uses AI to multiply what frontline workers can do, reaches people before crises hit, and brings diagnostic and decision\-support tools to places the technology industry has historically ignored. The International Rescue Committee (IRC) is already one of the most ambitious AI\-deploying humanitarian organizations in the world. We are working on dozens of AI initiatives across 30\+ countries: agentic systems serving millions of displaced people through Signpost; anticipatory action models that deliver aid in advance of a disaster; pocket\-sized AI diagnostics and AI teaching mentors. We have strategic partnerships with AI partners and a portfolio of programs ready to scale. We are hiring a Head of AI Engineering to lead the technical team that builds these systems — and to help shape what we build next. J**ob Overview:** This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who wants to build at the frontier of applied AI in service of humanitarian impact. You will lead a team of engineers and AI specialists designing and shipping AI\-powered, program\-facing solutions — primarily agentic systems, predictive analytics, and AI diagnostics deployed in low\-resource and high\-stakes settings. **You will own three things:** **Technical strategy and direction for IRC's program\-facing AI portfolio.** You will help translate IRC's AI ambitions into a clear technical roadmap, make build\-vs\-buy\-vs\-partner decisions, and set the architectural direction for systems that need to work reliably in some of the hardest operating environments on earth — including AI that runs offline on low\-cost smartphones, agentic systems with high safety standards, and diagnostic models trained on populations the major datasets ignore. **A high\-performing engineering team.** You will manage and grow a team of engineers, applied AI engineers, and QA specialists; raise the bar on engineering quality; and build the kind of culture that attracts top technical talent to mission\-driven work. **Deep partnership with program leaders and strategic partners.** You will be a true thought partner to IRC's program experts in health, education, protection, resettlement, and emergency response — co\-designing solutions with them rather than receiving requirements. You will also help us get maximum value from our flagship partnerships with Anthropic, OpenAI, and other frontier labs, with direct access to frontier models, early features, and the researchers building them. **Major Responsibilities** **AI Strategic Leadership** * Translate IRC's AI strategy and program priorities into a prioritized technical roadmap, in close partnership with program leaders, the SVP for Research, Innovation, AI, and People \& Culture, and the T4P demand pipeline. * Stay at the edge of AI/ML advances — particularly in agentic systems, multimodal models, and edge/on\-device inference — and bring promising approaches to IRC's programs. * Serve as a core member of IRC's AI leadership, helping shape organizational direction alongside the SVP for Research, Innovation, AI, and People \& Culture and other senior leaders. * Champion responsible, human\-centered AI deployment in some of the most sensitive humanitarian contexts in the world, with t  partnership with the SVP for Research, Innovation, AI, and People \& Culture * **Position directly supervises:** Engineers, applied AI engineers, ML specialists, and QA staff on the T4P Development team. * **Other internal contacts:** Program leaders across CRRD, RAI, R\&I, and Signpost; the Enterprise Applications and DevOps teams; the AI governance and policy team; AI@Scale (I@S) leadership; IT leadership across regions and HQ. * **External contacts:** Strategic partners with leading AI organizations; technology vendors; AI sector peers; NGO tech community; major foundation funders. **Job Requirements** *Strong candidates will bring most — not necessarily all — of the following:* **AI and engineering depth** * Hands\-on experience building and shipping production AI systems — agentic frameworks, LLM applications, RAG systems, computer vision, or applied ML pipelines. * Solid full\-stack foundation (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks) with the technical credibility to engage directly with engineers on architecture and design decisions. * Experience with cloud architecture (Azure preferred; AWS/GCP transferable), including AI services, DevOps pipelines, and cost\-effective scaling. * Working knowledge of data security and privacy practices for sensitive or personally identifiable information. **Leadership and collaboration** * 7–10\+ years in software engineering or technical product development, with 3\+ years leading engineers as a manager or tech lead. * A track record of building or growing strong engineering teams — hiring, raising the bar, and creating a culture people want to be part of. * Ability to engage non\-technical leaders as a peer: explaining trade\-offs clearly, listening well, and translating between worlds. * Comfort operating across global teams, time zones, and contexts very different from your own. **Mindset** * Genuinely motivated by humanitarian impact * Leads with humility. Deep respect for the people closest to the problem, including those without technical backgrounds. * Technically curious and forward\-looking — reads, experiments, and brings new ideas to the team. **Nice to have** * Experience deploying AI in low\-resource, low\-bandwidth, or offline contexts. * Prior work with humanitarian, development, or global health organizations. * French or Arabic language skills. **Working Environment** Standard office work environment; hybrid/remote available. Some travel may be required for partner meetings, field engagement, and sector conferences. **Compensation**: (US Pay Rate: 185,000\-200,000 USD); (UK Pay Rate: 87,000\-100,000 GBP) Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements. **Professional Standards:** All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way \- Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients. Cookies: https://careers.rescue.org/us/en/cookiesettings **Equal Opportunity Employer:** IRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. IRC considers all applicants on the basis of merit without regard to race, sex, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what's possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core. Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics. **Role** -------- As a Software Engineer on the Data Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the data infrastructure that powers our cutting\-edge robotics systems. As a global leader in robotic\-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. Were a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. The Future Forward organization is Intuitive’s advanced concepts group. We explore emerging technologies, prototype next\-generation solutions, and build software experiences that shape the future of robotic\-assisted surgery. If you're ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you'll find your purpose here. **Job Description** **Primary Function of Position** The Future Forward group within Intuitive Surgical is searching for a Staff Mechanical Engineer with a focus on the development of new endoscopes, contributing to the exploration of a novel concept for a new application of surgical robotics from proof of concept through detailed mechanical design, prototype manufacturing, and pilot level manufacturing. This role is an exciting opportunity to join a small and innovative team in the early phases of product development. The Future Forward team at Intuitive is a cross\-functional team dedicated to the creation of the innovative medical robotic platforms, technologies and programs. We create transformational technologies in order to address the major pain points and unmet needs in our healthcare system. Our goal is to create the future of healthcare through platforms and ecosystems that empower providers and teams in order to deliver transformational life\-enhancing care. The Senior Mechanical Engineer will develop robotic endoscopes for robotic systems for minimally invasive surgical applications. The successful candidate will have both the technical depth to resolve complex mechanical, materials and manufacturing design issues and the ability to work in an interdisciplinary team to troubleshoot to root cause higher level system issues. They must excel in a high\-energy, focused, small\-team environment, and have a commitment to high quality prototypes and concepts and a demonstrated record of developing creating and innovative engineering solutions. A strong sense of shared responsibility and shared reward is required as well as a commitment to high product quality. **Essential Job Duties** * Work in a small, cross\-functional project team to design, develop, and verify flexible robotic surgical instruments * Develop test methods, fixtures, and measurement tools to evaluate the performance of individual components, sub\-assemblies, and full assemblies * Analyze and interpret data generated by novel / custom sensors to optimize performance, reliability, and accuracy. * Generate requirements and design specifications that drive product safety, performance, and durability * Hands\-on assembly and testing of equipment and devices to support proof of concept, design development, pre\-clinical, and V\&V activities * Research and utilize knowledge of catheter component suppliers and internal catheter prototyping to facilitate rapid requirements, risk analysis, and testing * Generate and execute test methods to investigate and determine root cause of design, manufacturing, or material defects * Support preclinical labs, observe clinical cases, and conduct review literature to inform design decisions * Development and documentation of design and manufacturing documentation including: inspection procedures, assembly instructions, test methods, purchase specifications, BOMs, component / assembly drawings per the company’s operating procedures **Qualifications** **Required Skills and Experience** * Minimum 8 years of experience developing medical devices; flexible instruments preferred * Experience with… + integrating and optimizing the performance of electrical / optical sensors into flexible catheters or medical devices + catheter components and processes such as braiding, laminating, coiling, and/or laser cutting + plastics, plastics molding, 3D printing, adhesives, and/or epoxies + data analysis of complex datasets * Proficiency using CAD; Solidworks strongly preferred * Familiar with all phases of product development lifecycle including design, implementation, debug, verification, qualification, and transfer * High autonomy and ability to work independently under limited supervision to determine and develop approach to solutions. * Excellent organizational skills; Able to manage multiple fast\-paced projects simultaneously * Excellent documentation and communication skills * Ability to travel up to 10% of the time **Required Education and Training** * BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or related engineering or scientific discipline, or equivalent work experience **Working Conditions** * None **Additional Information** Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID\-19\. Translate operational, programmatic, or business requirements into functional Foundry solutions that support end\-user needs. Participate in testing, quality assurance, deployment support, and ongoing enhancement of Foundry\-based tools. Proficiency with at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, or a comparable language. jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineering Manager
jobs.description: At Jack Henry, we’re more than a technology company, we’re a force for good in financial services. We’re redefining how community banks and credit unions connect with the people they serve. Our mission is rooted in people inspired innovation, empowering financial institutions to deliver seamless, secure, and human centered experiences. We deliver cutting\-edge solutions that are paving the way for the next generation of digital banking and payments, but our true impact begins with our associates. If you're ready to help transform an industry and grow with a company that values purpose, collaboration, and excellence then we’d love to meet you. Infrastructure Core Services teams focus on delivering compute, network, data, secrets management, and workload orchestration in the cloud. We partner with product engineering teams to build performant, scalable, and secure services that are responsible for transactions, payments, deposits, transfers, auth, and platform integrations. We partner with our infrastructure platform teams to deliver pipelines, identity, observability, tooling, and security within the platform. We want our organization to be one that supports, challenges, and motivates you to build strong, dynamic connections with your coworkers. We promote a hard working, highly communicative, flexible, and transparent culture. How well work integrates with your life is an important quality of a healthy individual and organization. In the world of remote work that is always on and always connected we pay attention to providing margin and space for the things you hold dear This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70\-mile radius of our office locations in: Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; or Monett, MO. This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H\-1B, PERM). The salary range for this position is $180,000\- $215,000 and will be determined based on location and experience level. All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in\-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity. **What you’ll be responsible for:*** Reinforce the expected responsibilities of our teams so that we don’t get lost in the winds and rains of urgency or focus sacrificed to the loudest voice in a room. * Work with product engineering teams to develop alignment of priorities. Then proactively and openly communicate what will be impacted when priorities change. * Build relationships with technical leads and team leads to support delivery and team health. * Provide clarity to those around you to know who we are and who we are not to give space for teams to focus and deliver. * Enable staff to engage and take ownership of problems both large and small and in all instances advocating decision\-making by engineers. * Have difficult, but candid conversations that enable teams to calibrate their approach to work. * May perform other job duties as assigned. **What you’ll need to have:*** A minimum of 5 years in development or infrastructure as an individual contributor and advanced to a high functioning Sr or Staff engineer. * At least 4 years managing a team or multiple teams in a fast paced, rapidly evolving environment. * 4 years leveraging a framework that fits within the broader agile umbrella. e.g. scrum, kanban, Lean. * Experience within a cloud infrastructure environment. **What would be nice for you to have:*** Relaxed in how you work through interruptions and yet steadfast at guarding your focus time. * Committed to developing your craft/craeft; ie. a deep understanding of the technical and socio\-technical systems, skills and techniques important to the masterful execution of your work. * A rebel in all the best ways; you challenge prevailing thought or assumptions when warranted and suggest better alternatives. * Able to identify, develop, and support the formative practices and rhythms that make for effective engineers and leaders. * Skilled at listening well to those you work with to understand their views, in order to equip and challenge team members to take on progressively more difficult situations. * Quick to get up to speed on situational context. Open to discussing the merits of a solution amongst your co\-workers by inviting others to the conversation yet holding steadfast to the vision and values of the organization. * Effective at facilitating opportunities for engineers with opposing thoughts to listen to one another and help them develop the ability to see problems from multiple viewpoints. * Capable of serving in the background and able to recognize when to step in front of a problem to take it on directly. * An effective and candid communicator. Deliberate to openly communicate in large/public channels. * Able to hire and fire; hiring is fun and firing is not, but experience doing both is critical. If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this opportunity. Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement on this posting, we still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who align with our mission and can bring unique perspectives to our team. **Why Jack Henry?** At Jack Henry, we live by the motto: “*Do the right thing, do whatever it takes, and have fun.”* It’s more than a tagline, it’s the foundation of our culture. We recognize that our associates are the key to our success, and we’re deeply committed to their wellbeing. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health so you can thrive both personally and professionally. We’re also leading the way in technology modernization, helping financial institutions evolve with speed, security, and flexibility. Our strategy focuses on delivering secure data access, mitigating fraud, and enabling seamless integration. Empowering our teams to build innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of accountholders. **Culture of Commitment** Ask our associates why they love Jack Henry, and many will tell you it is because our culture is exceptional. We do great things together. Our culture empowers us to rise to challenges, seek new opportunities, and support one another through change. It’s this shared commitment that drives our success. We’re proud to foster an environment where inclusion, sustainability, and community impact are more than values, they’re how we operate. Visit our Corporate Sustainability site to learn more about our culture and commitment to our people, customers, community, environment, and shareholders. **Equal Employment Opportunity** At Jack Henry, we know we are better together. jobs.title: Principal Controls Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **Location / employment:** Houston, Texas / Full\-time (proposed) **Proposed base salary:** $145,000–$195,000 annually, depending on relevant experience and qualifications. Jacobi Motors is developing variable flux memory motor technology. We are seeking an accomplished controls engineer who can personally develop algorithms, implement embedded firmware, and make motors, power electronics, and test systems perform reliably on real hardware. You will work alongside our existing controls experts on core technology and assigned product programs, from control strategy through bench and dynamometer validation. We value deep controls expertise, sound engineering judgment, rapid problem\-solving, and measured results. The role will expand into charging controls as our power electronics programs develop. **What you’ll do** * Develop, implement, and tune motor control algorithms, including field\-oriented control, current and torque regulation, speed control, field weakening, and regenerative operation. * Collaborate on variable flux memory motor control, including magnetization strategies, flux\-state estimation, operating limits, and coordination with electromagnetic design. * Implement deterministic C/C\+\+ firmware on microcontrollers or DSPs; integrate synchronized ADC sampling, PWM, position feedback, communications, and inverter hardware. * Develop and commission motor test\-system controls, coordinating the motor under test, dynamometer/load drive, DC power equipment, instrumentation, and data acquisition. * Define focused validation tests, characterize system dynamics, tune loops, and verify stability, transient response, efficiency, and operating limits against measured data. * Diagnose hardware–firmware interactions, including sensing errors, timing, noise, inverter nonlinearities, and control instability; implement and verify corrective actions. * Develop startup and shutdown sequences, limits, fault detection, safe states, and recovery logic in coordination with hardware protections and test\-cell interlocks. * Extend control and firmware capability into charging and bidirectional power conversion, including current/voltage regulation, converter sequencing, and system coordination. * Share algorithm development and hardware debugging, lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, and maintain reusable, documented, version\-controlled implementations. **What you’ll bring** * Extensive relevant experience, typically 10\+ years, with substantial hands\-on responsibility for motor controls, embedded firmware, and power electronics. * A record of personally taking motor\-drive algorithms from concept through embedded implementation, commissioning, tuning, and validated hardware performance. * Deep practical knowledge of electric machines and field\-oriented control, including reference\-frame transforms, current loops, PWM, field weakening, and voltage/current constraints. * Strong control\-theory fundamentals: system modeling, loop stability and bandwidth, sampling and computation delays, filtering, anti\-windup, and parameter identification. * Advanced C/C\+\+ skills for real\-time embedded systems (TI C2000m STM32 or similar automotive\-grade MCUs), with practical command of interrupts, timers, ADC/PWM peripherals, execution timing, and hardware debugging. * Hands\-on experience with inverters, motor dynamometers, programmable power equipment, and instrumentation; ability to interpret schematics and debug signals and power\-stage behavior. * Experience controlling and automating test equipment using CAN/CAN FD, SPI, I2C and UART; proficiency in Python for testing and analysis. * Ability to quickly understand an existing system, isolate the dominant problem, and deliver measured improvements while maintaining disciplined validation and protection. * Ability to collaborate as a technical peer, explain control decisions clearly, and transfer practical knowledge to other engineers. * A degree in electrical engineering, controls, computer engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. Demonstrated controls accomplishments are essential. **Additional experience we value** * Power\-factor correction, DC/DC and bidirectional converter control, constant\-current/constant\-voltage regulation, or charging state machines. * MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS or comparable modeling tools; hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing; sensorless control and state observers. * Variable flux machines, integrated chargers, or production electric\-drive controls. Pay: $145,000\.00 \- $195,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Health insurance * Health savings account * Paid time off * Parental leave * Professional development assistance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Missouri City, TX 77489

jobs.title: Applied AI & Systems Associate
jobs.description: Applied AI \& Systems Associate About the Role K12 Computers is looking for an **Applied AI \& Systems Associate** to help us build the next generation of our internal business systems using AI. This is **not a traditional software developer position**. We're looking for someone who understands how businesses operate, enjoys solving problems, and is excited about using tools like **OpenAI Codex and other AI development tools** to turn ideas into working applications, automations, and workflows. You'll work directly under our Value Chain Engineer – Applied AI to identify operational problems across the company and rapidly build solutions for them. Instead of spending most of your time writing software from scratch, you'll use AI\-assisted development to move quickly from: **Business Problem → Process → AI\-Assisted Build → Test → Deployment → Improvement** What You'll Work On You'll help build and improve systems supporting areas such as: * IT asset receiving and inventory * Device auditing and grading * Quality assurance * Warehouse operations * E\-commerce operations * Logistics * Customer portals * Reporting and analytics * Sales and business development * Financial workflows * Data integrations * Internal automations * AI agents and AI\-assisted workflows Our systems interact with databases, APIs, business applications, and real\-world operational processes. What You'll Actually Do You'll spend your time working with employees throughout K12 Computers to understand how their jobs work and where technology can make them better. You'll: * Identify repetitive or inefficient business processes. * Translate operational problems into clear system requirements. * Use **Codex and AI\-assisted development tools** to build applications and features. * Create internal tools, dashboards, forms, workflows, and automations. * Work with databases and structured business data. * Connect systems through APIs and integrations. * Test AI\-generated code and troubleshoot problems. * Prototype new ideas quickly instead of waiting months for traditional software development. * Document how systems and workflows operate. * Train employees on new tools. * Collect feedback from users and continuously improve what you've built. * Work with our Applied AI leadership on larger automation and AI initiatives. Who We're Looking For We're more interested in **how you think and what you can build** than a specific degree or number of years of experience. You may be a good fit if you: * Are naturally curious about how businesses operate. * Regularly use AI tools to solve problems. * Have experimented with Codex or other AI coding tools. * Can take a vague business problem and turn it into a working solution. * Understand basic programming concepts even if you aren't a professional developer. * Are comfortable learning new software quickly. * Enjoy automating repetitive work. * Can communicate with both technical and nontechnical employees. * Are willing to test, fail, troubleshoot, and try again. * Want to work in an environment where you can build things that employees actually use. Experience with any of the following is helpful but **not required**: SQL, PostgreSQL, Supabase, APIs, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, GitHub, workflow automation, ERP systems, databases, dashboards, or AI development tools. What This Role Is NOT This isn't a position where you'll spend six months engineering one application. It's also not an IT help desk role. Our goal is to use modern AI development tools to allow a small team to build business software at a speed that previously required a much larger development organization. We're looking for someone who wants to operate at the intersection of: **Business Operations \+ AI \+ Software \+ Automation** The Person We're Trying to Find You might be finishing college, have a few years of professional experience, or have taught yourself through building projects. What matters most is that when someone says: "We're doing this manually every day. There has to be a better way." Your instinct is to figure out how to build one. Compensation **$45,000–$65,000 annually**, depending on experience and demonstrated ability. This position provides an opportunity to develop practical experience in applied AI, business systems, automation, databases, APIs, and AI\-assisted software development while working directly on systems used in real business operations. Pay: $45,000\.00 \- $65,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) Work Location: In person
