jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer, AI Agents & Automation
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Site Reliability \& Infrastructure Engineering team. We run entirely on the cloud, and this team owns the reliability and health of the applications running on top of it — designing the signals that tell us when something's wrong, and building the systems that keep ServiceTitan running better, faster, and cheaper as we scale. We make a huge impact on thousands of companies in the U.S. and abroad by enabling them to be more efficient and effective at running their business. Our Site Reliability and Infrastructure Engineering team centralizes the concerns of measurement and guidance so every engineer can improve availability and efficiency in their own area of the ServiceTitan cloud. We have a cultural foundation built on diversity, inclusion, and innovation, and we want you and your ideas to thrive at ServiceTitan. Come join us. **What You'll Do** * Participate in an on\-call rotation, using runbooks and playbooks to diagnose and resolve production issues (e.g., adjusting Horizontal Pod Autoscaler rules in response to load). * Design, build, and maintain observability dashboards and alerting grounded in Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). * Operate and improve our Kubernetes\-based compute platform, which runs the large majority of our infrastructure. * Work across cloud networking and infrastructure (Azure/AWS) to support reliable, scalable systems. * Investigate and resolve production incidents, including root\-cause analysis and follow\-up remediation work. * Build and operate AI agents and automation that take on manual, repetitive SRE work directly — not just tools that assist a human doing the work. * Partner with product engineering teams to review architecture and infrastructure decisions before they ship. * Write and maintain runbooks and documentation so on\-call knowledge is shared across the team, not siloed with one person. * Help define non\-functional requirements — scalability, availability, performance — for new systems as they're designed. * Collaborate across engineering teams to adopt best practices in reliability and observability. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and help teams ship changes safely and quickly. **What You'll Bring** * Kubernetes (must\-have): strong, hands\-on understanding of Kubernetes as a system. * AI\-native SRE practice (must\-have): hands\-on, personal experience using AI tools and agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Workspace, Cursor, or custom agents built on Claude/MCP servers) to diagnose, automate, and resolve infrastructure and reliability work. + ***Agentic depth:*** You've built or operated agents that autonomously monitor infrastructure and take action (e.g., an agent that watches system load and scales, remediates, or escalates without a human in the loop) — not just general AI coding assistance. You can speak concretely to how these agents are actually built and operated (MCP protocol, what a harness is, how to differentiate agent\-design strategies rather than just naming tools), to context management (e.g., progressive\-disclosure strategies for surfacing the right information without dumping everything into context), and to securing agent actions (scoping authorization, guardrails, what's available in the AI infra ecosystem to enforce it). + ***SRE application:***That agentic work is pointed at infrastructure and reliability problems specifically — you use AI to move at a materially faster pace in the SRE domain, not as a general\-purpose coding aid. * SRE principles: practical experience with SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets — able to speak to how you've defined and monitored these on real systems, not just definitions. * Cloud engineering \& networking: solid grounding in AWS or Azure, including networking fundamentals (subnetting, IP addressing). * Observability: deep experience with at least one modern observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Elasticsearch) and the ability to translate that understanding across tools. * CI/CD: strong understanding of a CI/CD system — GitHub Actions preferred, but TeamCity, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI experience is acceptable. * Programming: strong programming skills with the ability to build web applications — ideally with solid working knowledge of .NET and ASP.NET. We're also open to strong Python (Flask, FastAPI) or Java (Spring) backgrounds. The coding assessment will be tailored to whichever language/framework you're most comfortable in. * Experience with distributed systems and their common failure modes (retries, timeouts, cascading failures). * Strong production troubleshooting skills — comfortable diagnosing issues under pressure. * 8\-10\+ years of relevant hands\-on experience. * Nice\-to\-have: database experience (not mandatory — databases are monitored by the same team, not owned individually). **About You** You're someone who enjoys being directly accountable for the reliability of a business\-critical, large\-scale enterprise system. You're comfortable guiding and making decisions with limited information, and capable of operating within the trade\-offs between solving for immediate needs versus bigger\-scale solutions. You feel rewarded by developing an operability culture in a quickly growing and changing environment, and you're comfortable owning a wide and diverse set of problem areas. **Be Human With Us:** Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us. **Use of AI Technology:** We use technology, including automated and AI\-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. **What We Offer:** When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: * **Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work**: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer\-nominated awards, and more. * **Holistic health and wellness benefits:** Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical. * **Support for Titans at all stages of life:** Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more. ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. jobs.title: Senior Integrations Engineer
jobs.description: **About Sirona Medical** ------------------------ At **Sirona Medical**, we're building software that enables physicians to work as fast as they can think. Each year in the U.S., **billions of patient images** are captured—and nearly all of them are reviewed and diagnosed by radiologists. These specialists are the central hub of diagnostic medicine: **over 80% of all healthcare data flows through radiology IT systems**. Yet despite their pivotal role, radiologists are overburdened by outdated, fragmented software which limits their efficiency and ultimately the quality and efficiency of care that health systems can provide patients. That's where Sirona comes in. We're a **San Francisco\-based, cloud\-native software company** with employees around the world. Our deep understanding of both the **practice and business of radiology** has allowed us to build **RadOS**—a unified, AI\-powered operating system powering the entire radiology workflows. ### **How Sirona Solves the Problem** Sirona is **uniquely positioned to transform the way radiology is practiced**. We're delivering the organizational shift that both individual radiologists and entire practices urgently need: * A **unified**, intuitive, and **platform\-agnostic** solution * A streamlined workspace that makes **every part of the radiologist's workflow faster and easier** * The freedom to **read from anywhere, for anyone** By cutting clicks, optimizing diagnostic time, and unlocking efficiencies that extend **far beyond the reading room into all care settings**, Sirona empowers radiologists—and in doing so, we help the entire healthcare system move faster, smarter, and with greater impact on patient outcomes. For more information, please visit https://sironamedical.com/join/.**Senior Integrations Engineer** Scale what works. Shape what's next. Bring modern radiology to life. At Sirona Medical, we're rethinking how radiologists work, building a smarter, faster, and more intuitive platform to support the doctors behind the diagnosis. **But none of it works unless we integrate seamlessly with real\-world clinical systems.** That's why we're investing deeply in our Integrations team. We're looking for a Senior Integrations Engineer with strong DICOM experience to help lead the way. You'll join a capable team that's already delivered critical integrations and you'll play a key role in **scaling and evolving that work** as we grow. This is a hands\-on, high\-impact role focused on designing, implementing, and optimizing integrations that make modern radiology tools accessible within complex hospital environments. **Why This Role Matters:** DICOM is core, not a checkbox. Our platform depends on rich, high\-fidelity imaging data. Deep DICOM expertise is essential, and this role gives you a chance to apply it across varied environments and architectures. You'll scale what's already working. The groundwork is in place. You'll help us operationalize and expand it. You'll lead technically. From interface design to workflow orchestration, you'll help define best practices for high\-performance, clinically safe imaging integrations. You'll impact the mission directly. Every integration you deliver helps radiologists work faster, smarter, and more accurately, with direct impact on patient care. **What You'll Do:** * Lead customer integration projects with a strong emphasis on DICOM interface design, implementation, and support. * Analyze imaging workflows and develop solutions that fit smoothly into hospital PACS, RIS, and VNA environments. * Design and build data pipelines that normalize and route imaging and metadata reliably at scale. * Collaborate with internal teams to ensure product alignment with real\-world imaging use cases and clinical workflows. * Improve internal tools, documentation, and architecture to make DICOM integrations more repeatable and maintainable. * Participate in an on\-call rotation to support live integration environments and troubleshoot urgent issues. **What We're Looking For:** * Extensive experience working with DICOM, including image routing, metadata management, and PACS/VNA interoperability. * Strong technical skills with one or more of: Java, JavaScript, SQL, PostgreSQL, or XSLT. Familiarity with Python is a plus. * Experience with integration engines (e.g., Mirth, Cloverleaf, Rhapsody) and system\-level debugging * Understanding of HL7 and healthcare IT standards * Ability to work cross\-functionally and communicate clearly with both technical and clinical stakeholders. * A practical mindset with a passion for solving real\-world healthcare challenges through smart, scalable integrations. **Why Join Now?** This is a rare opportunity to shape a critical function within a company that's growing quickly and solving real problems in healthcare. You'll work on high\-impact projects, partner with experienced teams, and help define how Sirona scales imaging integrations across diverse health systems. If you're a DICOM expert who wants to make an outsized impact, we'd love to talk. **Benefits:** * Stock Options * Unlimited PTO * Medical, dental, vision insurance * Life insurance * Maternity and Paternity Leave * 401K matching * Apple equipment * Sponsorship for conferences, continuing education, etc * Dynamic role–technological innovation is at the core of our business * Growth and learning opportunities from a startup environment include working closely with an international team of scientists, engineers, platform architects, programmers and professionals The annual US base salary range for this full\-time position is $125,000 \- $142,500 \+ equity \+ benefits. jobs.title: Director of IT Infrastructure & Operations
jobs.description: ##### **Job Summary** The State of Mississippi Division of Medicaid (DOM) administers the state's Medicaid program, providing healthcare coverage to eligible Mississippians. DOM's Office of Information Technology Management supports the agency's mission through enterprise technology services spanning cloud infrastructure, networking, service desk operations, cybersecurity, application integration, and vendor management. DOM is undergoing a significant technology modernization effort that includes migration of enterprise workloads to cloud platforms, implementation of federal interoperability mandates, adoption of cloud\-native services, and restructuring of IT service delivery operations. These concurrent transformation initiatives require sustained, senior\- level technical leadership to ensure continuity of operations, effective vendor coordination, and successful execution of modernization objectives. The purpose of this Statement of Work (SOW) is to procure staff augmentation services for one (1\) Director of IT Services to provide executive\-level leadership and operational oversight for DOM's enterprise IT Infrastructure Management (ITIM) and Delivery Services functions. The contractor shall serve as a key member of DOM's IT leadership team, reporting to the Chief Information Officer (CIO) and/or Chief Technology Officer (CTO), and shall be responsible for the day\-to\-day management of infrastructure operations, cloud services, vendor relationships, service desk operations, and technology modernization initiatives. **SCOPE OF SERVICES:** The contractor shall provide leadership and operational management across the following functional domains: Enterprise Cloud Services; Network, Voice \& Telecommunications; IT Service Desk \& End\-User Support; Infrastructure \& Operations; Cyberscurity Partnership \& Compliance; Vendor \& Contract Management; and IT Services Management \& Governance. The scope encompasses both ongoing operational responsibilities and active modernization initiatives. Enterprise Cloud Services Provide strategic and operational leadership for DOM's enterprise cloud environment, including infrastructure provisioning, platform services, identity integration, monitoring, and capacity management. Oversee cloud migration activities, including coordination with cloud professional services teams, managed migration vendors, and DOM internal teams. Establish and enforce governance for cloud adoption, architecture standards, cost management, security compliance, and operational procedures. Manage cloud account provisioning, vendor onboarding to cloud environments, and service ticket workflows for cloud service requests. Develop strategies for disaster recovery, high availability, and technology resiliency within cloud environments. Monitor cloud consumption, performance, and costs; identify and implement optimization opportunities. Provide strategic and operational leadership for DOM's enterprise cloud environment, including infrastructure provisioning, platform services, identity integration, monitoring, and capacity management. Network, Voice \& Telecommunications Direct enterprise network and telecommunications operations supporting statewide Medicaid business functions, including LAN/WAN, wireless, Internet connectivity, remote access, and unified communications. Oversee load balancing and DNS provisioning for application environments. Coordinate with telecommunications carriers, managed service providers, and technology vendors to ensure service\-level requirements are met. Lead modernization of network infrastructure to support cloud services, mobility, and evolving security requirements. Manage network access restoration and firewall rule change requests through ITS coordination. IT Service Desk \& End\-User Support Lead the enterprise IT service desk and end\-user support organization, including client support technicians and supervisory staff. Establish and monitor service desk KPIs: first\-contact resolution, response times, resolution times, backlog management, and customer satisfaction. Oversee incident escalation, major incident management, and post\-incident review processes. Manage ITS Service Center ticket workflows for DOM, including cloud and hosted application service categories. Develop self\-service capabilities, knowledge management, and automation to improve employee technology experience. Infrastructure \& Operations Provide leadership for enterprise infrastructure operations, including compute, storage, virtualization, operating systems, backup, monitoring, and related platforms. Ensure critical infrastructure is monitored and maintained to established availability and performance standards. Lead infrastructure modernization and technology lifecycle management, including hardware refresh strategies and capacity planning. Establish effective backup, recovery, redundancy, and disaster recovery capabilities. Manage assessment artifact collection and compliance documentatio , firewall rules, account provisioning, and access management.  Lead incident response for major technology outages and service disruptions, including root cause analysis and corrective action.  Manage vendor relationships through regular status calls, performance reviews, and escalation management.  Review and contribute to Statements of Work, procurement documents, and contract renewals.  Conduct interviews and manage hiring processes for infrastructure and client support positions.  Develop and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for all ITIM service areas.  Prepare and deliver weekly status reports to IT leadership.  Manage bi\-annual assessment artifact collection and compliance documentation **REPORTING STRUCTURE:**  The contractor shall report directly to the DOM Chief Information Officer (CIO) and/or Chief Technology Officer (CTO).  The contractor shall participate in DOM IT leadership meetings, weekly status report cadence, and executive briefings as required.  The contractor shall coordinate regularly with network administration, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, IT procurement, and application development teams. **SECURITY AND COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS:**  The contractor shall pass a background investigation as required by the State of Mississippi and DOM prior to commencing work.  The contractor shall comply with all HIPAA Privacy and Security Rule requirements, including safeguarding of Protected Health Information (PHI) and electronic PHI (ePHI).  The contractor shall comply with CMS Acceptable Risk Controls for Automated Medicaid Program Eligibility (ARC\-AMPE) and all applicable federal security requirements.  The contractor shall adhere to Mississippi ITS security policies, standards, and procedures.  The contractor shall complete all required security awareness training within thirty (30\) days of onboarding and annually thereafter.  jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: As a Database Engineer on the Professional Archive team, you'll operate as a subject\-matter expert for the data infrastructure that powers our platform – driving the architecture, scaling, and reliability decisions that keep high\-velocity, compliance\-critical systems performant and secure. You'll work with SQL Server environments spanning multi\-terabyte data volumes, tables with billions of rows, and sustained throughput exceeding 100,000 transactions per second. technical approach for scalable data solutions, partnering with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, and Site Reliability to shape direction rather than simply implement it * Drive larger, cross\-functional projects from design through delivery, proactively identifying and addressing upstream and downstream impacts before they become issues * Informally mentor other engineers, modeling sound engineering discipline and raising the technical bar for the wider team * Shape how the team adopts modern engineering practices, including Agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps principles * Review code and database changes with an eye for systemic risk and performance, while also leading efforts to pay down technical debt across systems * Track emerging technologies and make the call on which are worth adopting, guiding the team's direction * Interpret database health and performance data (Splunk, Datadog, Grafana) to proactively flag and address risk before it surfaces as an incident ### **What will you bring?** We're looking for a recognized subject\-matter expert who operates independently, drives clarity through ambiguity, and raises the bar for those around them. * Advanced, wide\-ranging experience with database systems, with the judgment to operate independently in unfamiliar or ambiguous situations * Deep expertise designing logical and physical data models, including schema design and data relationships, at a level others rely on for direction * A demonstrated ability to set database performance strategy by tuning queries and indexes and establishing standards that others follow * Strong command of data security practices (encryption, access controls, auditing), with the ability to shape how the team approaches them * A track record of independently troubleshooting complex issues in systems that require high availability, serving as an escalation point for others * Ability to plan for data growth and scale infrastructure with the full flow of work in mind, not just the immediate ask * The credibility and collaborative instinct to influence peers and cross\-functional partners, not just execute their requests * Strong command of modern development practices and Agile methodologies, with a voice in how the team applies them * Ability to communicate technical direction, trade\-offs, and risk clearly to stakeholders outside your immediate team * Comfort setting a course through evolving, ambiguous requirements rather than waiting for them to be resolved * A proactive approach to identifying and solving problems that cross team boundaries ### **Preferred Qualifications** * If you don't meet every qualification listed below, we still encourage you to apply. We value diverse experiences and perspectives. Progression to this level reflects demonstrated ability to perform as a subject\-matter expert, not years of experience alone. + 7\+ years of hands\-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server in a production environment, with demonstrated impact as a subject\-matter expert + Deep expertise in schema and data model design, including normalization, partitioning, and indexing strategy for both OLTP workloads + Advanced proficiency in performance tuning, including T\-SQL and stored procedure optimization, execution plan analysis, and query tuning at scale + Proven, hands\-on experience managing and troubleshooting SQL Server databases at terabyte scale, including tables with billions of rows, and sustained throughput exceeding 100k transactions per second + Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve production capacity and contention issues at this scale, including lock/latch contention, TempDB performance, and transaction management + Experience designing for horizontal as well as vertical scalability, anticipating data growth before it becomes a production risk + Familiarity with NoSQL technologies (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB) is a plus + Experience with cloud database platforms (e.g., AWS RDS/Aurora, MongoDB Atlas) is a plus ### **What do we offer?** * Healthcare insurance: We provide medical, dental, and vision insurance, and a flexible spending account that allows you to set aside pre\-tax dollars to pay for eligible out\-of\-pocket expenses. * Stock options. * Personal time off: A healthy work\-life balance is critical to your success at the office. Smarsh offers a “take\-what\-you\-need” time off policy as well as flexible work arrangements. * 401K Match: Smarsh provides a 4% 401K match for which employees are fully vested on day one. * Sabbatical: The Smarsh sabbatical programme provides a time to recharge, study or simply do something you are passionate about away from the workplace. Employees are eligible after six years of service. * Recognition: We’re big on kudos for a job well done. Our employee\-recognition programme enables co\-workers to nominate their peers who best embody our core values for recognition. The above salary range represents Smarsh's good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible base compensation at the time of posting. Any applicable bonus programs will be discussed during the recruiting process. The salary for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, location, specialty and training. Local cost of living assessments are done for each new hire at the time of offer. Don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway! Studies have shown that some strong candidates may self\-select out of the interview process prematurely, at Smarsh we encourage an inclusive, high\-performing environment. In compliance with pay transparency laws, pay ranges are disclosed for positions and locations where required.* **Work\-Life Balance** We realize there’s more to life than just work. Member\-ownership is at the heart of our culture, aligning client satisfaction, company performance, and personal reward. Paid Time Away. We provide a comprehensive insurance package including medical, dental, vision, FSA, HSA, Doctor On Demand, wellness reimbursement, and mental health resources. Financial Health. When your skills grow, so do we, which is why we offer tuition assistance, professional society membership, and more. Financial Rewards. Built for modern, data\-driven teams, the platform empowers marketers, CX leaders and field organizations to transform complex data into dynamic, relevant video communications that deepen engagement, improve the customer experience, increase conversion, and strengthen long\-term relationships. jobs.title: Applications Engineering, Sr Staff Engineer
jobs.description: ### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. ### **You Are** You have spent time in the trenches of physical implementation, and you know that getting a design to close is only half the battle. The other half is making sure the customer's team can actually replicate it, understand why it worked, and apply it to the next tapeout without calling you at midnight. You think in flows, not just tools. When a customer says "it's not converging," you are already mentally walking through their floorplan, their timing constraints, and whether they are fighting the tool or fighting their own methodology. You do not just answer questions, you teach people how to ask better ones. Walking a customer through a debug session energizes you because you know that the fifteen minutes you spend explaining why their clock tree looks like that will save them three weeks on their next project. At the same time, you are technical enough to roll up your sleeves, pull their database, reproduce the issue, and loop in the product team with a clear, actionable summary when it is actually a tool problem. You have a point of view on what good implementation looks like, and you are not afraid to push back when a customer is headed toward a dead end. At Synopsys, you will work with some of the most advanced semiconductor teams in the world, and what you help them accomplish will show up in products millions of people use. ### **What You'll Be Doing** * Support customer adoption of Fusion Compiler by diagnosing complex place and route issues, reproducing problems in\-house, and driving resolution with engineering teams * Lead technical engagements with advanced node customers, defining deployment strategies that align tool capabilities with their design goals and constraints * Roll out new product methodologies by designing and delivering training sessions, workshops, and hands\-on enablement for customer engineering teams * Serve as the technical voice of the customer to the product team, translating field feedback into actionable feature requests, bug reports, and roadmap input * Collaborate with account teams to shape technical solutions during pre\-sales and post\-deployment phases, ensuring customers see measurable improvements in PPA and turnaround time * Debug and optimize customer flows across design planning, placement, clock tree synthesis, routing, and timing closure using Fusion Compiler and related Synopsys tools * Build and maintain deep technical relationships with customer architects and implementation leads, becoming their go\-to resource for methodology questions and escalations ### **The Impact You Will Have** * Accelerate customer tapeout schedules by resolving critical implementation bottlenecks that would otherwise delay production by weeks or months * Increase Fusion Compiler adoption and deployment success rates across your accounts, directly contributing to revenue growth and customer retention * Shape the product roadmap by surfacing real\-world use cases and gaps that engineering teams would not see without your field insight * Reduce customer support escalations by enabling teams to solve their own problems through better training, documentation, and methodology guidance * Influence how the next generation of AI, automotive, and hyperscale chips get implemented by working with customers pushing the edge of process technology * Strengthen Synopsys' reputation as a trusted technical partner, not just a tool vendor, by consistently delivering solutions that work in production * Help define best practices and reference flows that get reused across multiple customer engagements and become part of the standard methodology ### **What You'll Need** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent * Deep expertise in place and route methodologies, including floorplanning, placement optimization, clock tree synthesis, routing, and timing closure * Proven experience with Synopsys Fusion Compiler in a production design environment or customer\-facing role * Strong working knowledge of static timing analysis (STA) and low power design flows, including multi\-voltage domains and power gating techniques * Proficiency in TCL scripting for automation, flow customization, and debug * Experience with advanced node designs (7nm and below) is a strong plus * Ability to travel to customer sites as needed, typically 20\-30% depending on account needs ### **Who You Are** * You can walk into a room where a customer's design is failing timing by 500ps and leave two hours later with a clear plan, a list of owners, and everyone aligned on next steps * When a customer pushes back on a recommended flow change, you do not just defend it, you explain the tradeoff in terms of their schedule, their PPA targets, and their team's capacity * You are comfortable presenting technical content to both hands\-on engineers who want to see waveforms and directors who want to know if this will delay the tapeout * Ambiguity does not slow you down. If the customer has not fully defined their problem, you ask the right questions to get to the root cause without waiting for a perfect ticket * You keep track of multiple customer engagements at once without dropping threads, and you know when to escalate internally before a small issue becomes a crisis * You genuinely enjoy teaching, and you measure success not just by whether the issue got solved, but by whether the customer can solve the next one on their own ### **The Team You'll Be Part Of** Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. ### **Rewards and Benefits** We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Applications Engineering, Staff Engineer
jobs.description: ### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. ### **You Are** You have spent years solving real engineering problems, not just running simulations. The kind where a customer's product launch depends on getting the structural analysis right, and you know how to work backward from their constraint to a solution they can actually use. You understand that the best technical answer means nothing if it does not fit their workflow, their timeline, or their team's skill set. You are comfortable walking into a room where you are the only one who understands both the physics and the software, and you can translate between those worlds without making anyone feel lost. When a customer describes a packaging failure or a thermal issue, you are already thinking about which solver to use, what assumptions to test, and how to script the setup so they can repeat it next month. You do not wait for perfect data. You work with what is available, ask the specific questions that matter, and move the project forward. If a demo does not go as planned, you troubleshoot in real time and turn it into a teaching moment. At Synopsys, you will work with customers who are building the next generation of semiconductors and electronics, and what you help them solve actually ships. ### **What You'll Be Doing** * Lead technical engagements throughout the sales cycle, from discovery calls where you map customer workflows to live demos where you show how Ansys software solves their specific structural, thermal, or reliability challenges * Work directly with semiconductor and electronics packaging engineers to understand their design problems, then configure, script, and deploy simulation solutions using Ansys tools that fit into their existing CAD and PLM environments * Build Python\-based automation scripts and custom workflows using Ansys APIs to help customers move from manual, one\-off analyses to repeatable, scalable simulation processes * Collaborate with Ansys product teams to translate what you are hearing from customers into feature requests, test pre\-release builds on real\-world problems, and document best practices that become part of the product roadmap * Deliver consulting services and training sessions, from introductory workshops to deep\-dive technical implementations, helping customers get value from day one * Support field marketing efforts by authoring technical content, presenting at industry conferences, and creating application examples that demonstrate differentiated value in electronics and semiconductor markets * Travel to customer sites, trade shows, and internal meetings up to 25% of the time, with flexibility to increase based on project needs ### **The Impact You Will Have** * Customers will close design cycles faster because the simulation workflows you built actually work in their environment, with their data, under their constraints * Sales teams will win competitive opportunities because you showed up with a solution that addressed the customer's specific failure mode, not a generic pitch * Product teams will build features that matter because you brought them real customer requirements, not guesses, and tested those features before they shipped * Engineers at semiconductor and electronics companies will trust simulation more because you helped them see accurate correlation between their models and physical test results * Synopsys will expand its footprint in electronics packaging and semiconductor reliability because you made the software accessible to teams who previously saw simulation as too complex or disconnected from their workflows * New users will ramp faster because the training materials, scripts, and examples you created give them a clear path from installation to productive work * The business will grow because the technical relationships you build turn into renewals, expansions, and references that open doors in new accounts ### **What You'll Need** * BS in Mechanical Engineering or related field with 5\+ years in an engineering software environment, or MS with 3\+ years, or PhD with industry exposure to structural, thermal, or reliability simulation * Deep subject matter expertise in structural mechanics applied to electronics or semiconductor domains, including packaging, PCB assemblies, or chip\-level reliability analysis * Hands\-on experience with Ansys software or other commercial CAE tools like COMSOL, Abaqus, or similar platforms used for finite element analysis * Strong Python scripting skills with demonstrated experience building automation workflows, integrating APIs, or developing custom applications on top of commercial engineering software * Ability to diagnose complex simulation problems, communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders, and write documentation or presentations in fluent English * Willingness to travel domestically up to 25% of the time for customer meetings, on\-site implementations, and industry events * Experience in customer\-facing roles such as applications engineering, technical support, or consulting services is a strong plus, especially if you have worked with senior engineering leaders or executives ### **Who You Are** * You can walk into a customer meeting, listen to a vague description of a product failure, and walk out with a clear plan for which analysis to run, what boundary conditions to test, and how to set up the model so they can reuse it * When a demo goes sideways, you do not panic. You troubleshoot in front of the customer, explain what you are doing, and turn the problem into a teaching moment that builds credibility * You have worked in environments where the answer is not in the user manual. You dig into APIs, test scripts, read source code if you have to, and figure out how to make the tool do what the customer actually needs * If a customer asks for a feature that does not exist yet, you do not just say no. You find a workaround, document it, and loop in the product team with enough detail that they can prioritize it properly * You are comfortable presenting technical content to a room full of PhD engineers and then simplifying the same concept for a program manager who needs to understand risk and timeline, not equations * You manage your own calendar, follow up without being reminded, and treat customer commitments like they matter, because they do ### **The Team You'll Be Part Of** You will be joining the Ansys Customer Excellence team within Synopsys, a group that works directly with customers to deploy simulation software, solve real engineering problems, and support the sales process with deep technical expertise. This is a multi\-disciplinary team that spans different physics domains, industries, and customer types. You will collaborate with sales, product development, and other applications engineers to deliver solutions that help customers engineer what is ahead. Your recruiter will share more about the team structure, reporting lines, and how this role fits into the broader Synopsys organization during the interview process. ### **Rewards and Benefits** We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Senior Building Controls Technician (25% Travel)
jobs.description: $110,000\-$130,000 The Building People delivers integrated solutions that connect technology, buildings, and people to optimize real estate performance, facility operations, and workforce outcomes. With over 450 contracts delivered across 187 project locations, we manage more than 1,700 facilities and support $38\.5B in federal and commercial assets. Leveraging AI\-driven automation, data analytics, and platform\-agnostic systems, we create high\-performing, future\-ready environments that reduce cost, improve efficiency, and enable mission success. Founded in 2012, we now have over 450 employees supporting 23 federal agencies—making us a trusted leader in delivering technology\-infused building solutions across the public sector. The Building People is committed to fostering a workplace where every employee can thrive. Using tools like the Predictive Index, we thoughtfully align individual strengths with team needs \-ensuring the right fit, the right role, and long\-term success. Our culture is rooted in integrity, innovation, and service. Through our growing philanthropy program, we support communities by focusing on gratitude, giving back, partnerships, and mentorship. **Our Market Offerings Include:** * Real Estate \& Workplace * Facilities Management * Facilities Operations \& Maintenance * Project Management \& Engineering * Workforce Transformation \& Organizational Design * Mission Support * Smart Buildings \& Energy Efficiency * Technology Solutions Join our rapidly growing team and help shape the future of real estate, facilities, and community impact. The **Senior Building Controls Technician** will provide services related to the expansion, upgrade or replacement of building automation hardware and software for smart building infrastructure. The position will work independently to meet project requirements with limited supervision. The programmer will be responsible for programming, configuring, and testing of Direct Digital Control (DDC) building automation and control systems. The senior control technician will be assigned to the Leesburg headquarters building but the primary work responsibility will involve working within buildings in Washington D.C. and its neighboring suburbs. Responsibilities/Duties: * Design and engineer control system hardware and software programming based on project plans, specifications, and other contract documents * Ability to program projects with various levels of complexity * Capable of performing network troubleshooting, database troubleshooting and repair programming * Collaborates with the engineering team on the system configuration, network and software requirements, graphics, programming, and sequences of operations * Develop and configure the sequence of operations, programming, graphics, database, network, and integrations into third party systems * Maintains accurate and thorough project documentation and redlines * Provides owner training as required by the project * Executes system commissioning and functional testing * Assist in installation of control hardware * Startup and commission new hardware installations * Provide project management assistance on projects as required, interfacing directly to customers * Supervise sub\-contractors and suppliers as needed * Help educate lower\-level technicians through on the job training as needed * This position will require a minimum of 25% travel * ***Salary offered will be commensurate with the candidate's experience, qualifications, and certifications.*** * ***Our positions may require a background screening and clearance directly from the Government.*** * ***Please note that telework arrangements are subject to change based on customer requirements.*** **ADDITIONAL INFORMATION** Competitive benefits for eligible employees include: * Medical \& Rx * Dental * Vision * Flexible Spending Accounts * 401(k) Retirement Plan * Life Insurance/AD\&D * Long Term Disability and Short\-Term Disability * Paid Time Off * Holiday Pay All positions require a background check after acceptance of our offer. The selected candidate will be eligible to begin employment before the background check has been finalized. However, continued employment will be contingent upon the results of your reference/background check from The Building People, LLC. Your position may require special credentialing, clearance, and access as a condition of employment. In the event the government or client does not sponsor or approve your clearance, it may result in termination of your employment. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at reasonableaccomodation@thebuildingpeople.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Requests for accommodation will be considered on a case\-by\-case basis. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this e\-mail address. For more information, view the EEO is the Law Poster and Pay Transparency Statement. **Required Skills** * Excellent verbal and written communication skills * Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite or related software * Programming skills * Strong analytical skills * Strong interactive and communication skills * Strong troubleshooting skills * Experience with electronics and basic electrical circuits * Thorough understanding of and ability to use appropriate tools * Excellent customer service and ability to work well with others * Knowledge of DDC Control Theory and Applications as related to HVAC equipment * Strong knowledge of common DDC communications protocols such as but not limited to BACnet, LON, Modbus, etc. **Required Experience/Education** * At least 3 years of experience with programming, startup and commissioning of control systems * Niagara N4 certification * Experience with multiple manufacturers of controls a plus * Technical knowledge with installation of controls equipment and ancillary devices **Physical Requirements** * Physically able to climb overhead or crawl under spaces to complete jobs. * Must be willing to work at heights. * Must be able to lift up to 35 pounds at times.

jobs.description: The Senior Manager, Software Engineer, Data Platform \& Segmentation is a senior individual contributor accountable for the technical vision, design, and evolution of data platforms and segmentation capabilities that power Customer and Commercial product teams operating under a modern Product Operating Model. This role functions as a hands\-on technical leader and multiplier, shaping how customer, commercial, and behavioral data is modeled, segmented, and activated across products, enabling better decisions, personalization, and measurable business outcomes. The role emphasizes deep technical expertise, product partnership, and architectural leadership, rather than people management. **Core Accountabilities** **Product Model \& Discovery Partnership** * Partner closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Tech Leads to co\-own outcomes, not just data assets. * Participate actively in product discovery to ensure segmentation strategies are technically feasible, scalable, and analytically sound. * Translate business and customer questions into durable data models and segmentation frameworks. **Machine Learning** * Strong experience in Machine Learning engineering, leveraging ML models to build Segmentation strategies * Experience operationalizing ML\-driven segmentation, including integrating segmentation outputs into other products * Collaborating with data scientists * managing standards for model life cycle, monitoring drift, retraining, etc. * Understanding of Azure ML (or any other cloud) workspaces and integrating them with Azure pipelines **Data Platform \& Segmentation Architecture** * Define and evolve the **segmentation architecture** across customer and commercial data domains. * Design scalable data models that support real\-time, near real time, and batch segmentation use cases. * Ensure segmentation logic is reusable, explainable, and consistent across channels and products. * Make explicit trade\-offs across latency, accuracy, cost, privacy, and maintainability. **Engineering Execution \& Data Quality** * Build and maintain high\-quality, production\-grade data pipelines and services. * Ensure strong standards for data quality, lineage, observability, and reliability. * Reduce fragmentation and duplication in segmentation logic across teams. * Leverage metrics to continuously improve data freshness, accuracy, and usability. **Individual Contributor Technical Leadership** * Act as a go\-to expert for data platform and segmentation design. * Lead complex technical initiatives end\-to\-end through hands\-on contribution. * Influence technical direction through design reviews, reference implementations, and documented standards. * Mentor senior engineers and Tech Leads through coaching and technical guidance (without direct management responsibility). **Microsoft Azure Data Platform \& Fabric Expertise** * Demonstrate **deep, hands\-on expertise** with Microsoft Azure data services and their application in large\-scale, product\-centric environments. * Design and evolve segmentation and data platform architectures leveraging **Azure Data Fabric concepts**, ensuring interoperability, governance, and reuse across domains. * Apply strong architectural judgment across core Azure data products, including data ingestion, storage, processing, analytics, and activation layers. * Optimize designs across **cost, performance, latency, and scalability**, using Azure\-native capabilities and patterns. * Ensure secure\-by\-design implementations aligned with Azure identity, access, encryption, and compliance controls. * Partner with enterprise architecture, cloud, and security teams to ensure Azure data platform decisions align with broader enterprise strategy while preserving team autonomy. * Stay current on Azure data platform evolution and proactively assess new capabilities for business value, not novelty. **Business Partnership \& Communication** * Serve as a trusted technical partner to Customer and Commercial stakeholders. * Communicate segmentation concepts, assumptions, and limitations in clear business language. * Proactively surface data constraints, privacy considerations, and trade\-offs to enable informed decisions. * Support external partner and vendor conversations as a technical authority when needed. **Governance, Privacy \& Compliance** * Ensure segmentation approaches comply with data privacy, consent, and regulatory requirements. * Collaborate with Security, Privacy, and Legal teams to embed governance into platform design—not bolt it on later. * Advocate for responsible and ethical use of customer and commercial data. **Success Measures** * Segmentation capabilities measurably improve customer engagement and commercial outcomes. * Reduced duplication and inconsistency in segmentation logic across products. * Improved data quality, freshness, and trustworthiness. * Faster time\-to\-insight and activation for product teams. * Platforms and models that scale with growth while controlling cost and risk. **Leadership Profile** * Outcome\-driven, not data for data’s sake * Deep technical expertise with strong product intuition * Influences through credibility and clarity, not authority * Comfortable operating in ambiguity and evolving problem spaces * Holds a high bar for data quality, ethics, and reliability **Required Experience \& Capabilities** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or equivalent experience. * 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in data platform, analytics engineering, or backend engineering roles. * Deep expertise in data modeling, segmentation strategies, and large\-scale data systems. * Strong experience with cloud\-native data platforms and modern data tooling. * Proven ability to partner closely with product and business stakeholders. * Demonstrated impact as a senior individual contributor on complex, cross\-team initiatives. jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Hybrid
jobs.description: **Job Details** --------------- Location: Hartford, CT Category: Information Technology Employment Type: Full time, Hybrid Job Ref: R2627051\-168 Senior Staff Software Engineer \- IE07HE We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. The Hartford is hiring a full\-time Senior Staff Software Engineer to design, build, and modernize Claims IT solutions with strong Guidewire, Java, and AWS depth. This role blends core platform engineering with select Forward Deployed Engineer responsibilities to accelerate delivery with business teams and drive measurable production outcomes. Hands\-on experience creating AI agents using Google ADK is a strong plus. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and enhance Guidewire ClaimCenter workflows, rules, and integrations for claims operations. * Build resilient Java APIs and backend services for high\-volume claims transaction processing. Architect and implement cloud\-native AWS services with focus on reliability, security, performance, and cost. * Own end\-to\-end engineering delivery: design, build, test automation, release, and production support. * Implement CI/CD, code quality gates, observability, and engineering standards across services. Collaborate with product owners, claims SMEs, architects, and operations to convert business goals into technical solutions. * Lead incident troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions. Mentor engineers through architecture reviews, coding standards, and delivery best practices. * Partner directly with business and operations stakeholders to understand field workflows and convert them into deployable capabilities. * Run discovery workshops to identify high\-value use cases, define MVP scope, and prioritize quick\-win automation opportunities. * Rapidly prototype solutions, validate with end users, and productionize successful patterns into durable platform services. * Embed with cross\-functional teams during critical releases to unblock dependencies and reduce time\-to\-value. * Build implementation playbooks and onboarding guides that improve adoption across claims teams. Establish outcome metrics (cycle time, accuracy, throughput, incident rate) and iterate based on production feedback. * Act as technical bridge across engineering, business, and support teams during rollouts and post\-launch stabilization. * Build practical agents with Google ADK for document understanding, claims decision support, and workflow orchestration. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. * 7\+ years of software engineering experience in enterprise environments. * Strong hands\-on Guidewire cloud experience, preferably ClaimCenter implementation and must have * Must have Guidewire claims center certification. * Strong hands\-on Java experience building APIs, integrations, and distributed services. * Strong AWS and/or GCP engineering experience delivering production cloud solutions. * Experience with event\-driven systems, asynchronous messaging, and secure REST integration patterns. * Proficiency in automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices. * Experience in observability, logging, and production operations support. * Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on Google ADK experience building enterprise\-grade agents. * Experience integrating LLM services into business processes with governance and monitoring. * Proven ability to lead delivery across cross\-functional teams. **Compensation** The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include short\-term or annual bonuses, long\-term incentives, and on\-the\-spot recognition. The annualized base pay range for this role is: $127,600 \- $191,400 Equal Opportunity Employer/Sex/Race/Color/Veterans/Disability/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity or Expression/Religion/Age

jobs.description: Technology Machine Learning Engineer Graduate (E\-Commerce Content Recommendation \- Generative \& Large Recommendation Model) \- 2027 Start (PhD) Location : Seattle Employment Type : Regular Job Code : A51372 Responsibilities Team Introduction Global E\-Commerce (TikTok Shop) is one of TikTok's fastest\-growing businesses and a core driver of the company's revenue growth. Our Global E\-Commerce Content Recommendation team owns the end\-to\-end recommendation stack for e\-commerce video and image\-text content on TikTok worldwide — retrieval, ranking, and multi\-queue blending; supply ecosystem and cold start; and the browsing\-to\-purchase experience for hundreds of millions of users. We believe recommendation is being rewritten in the compute era. ID\-based collaborative filtering and supervised learning built today's systems and still run most of the industry — but their returns are diminishing, and we are betting the next order of magnitude on rebuilding the stack on LLM foundations. Our ambition is to build the most advanced recommendation system in the world, and the next generation after that. We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth. Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume. **Responsibilities:** You will help build — and rewrite — an industrial recommendation system serving a billion\-scale user base across short\-video, livestream, and product scenarios, covering retrieval, pre\-ranking, ranking, and blending end to end. Every iteration ships to production and directly moves user experience and GMV. * Scale recommendation models like LLMs. Push ranking models from hundreds of millions to billions of parameters and chart the scaling laws of recommendation: behavior\-corpus pretraining; multi\-scenario, multi\-task, multi\-stage joint training; ultra\-long behavior\-sequence modeling (10K\+ events) with KV caching, sequence compression, user/generation (U\-G) disaggregated serving, speculative decoding, and dynamic batching — raising MFU while holding a strict millisecond latency budget. * Build one\-stage generative retrieval. Reframe retrieval as generation: tokenize the item space into semantic IDs (RQ\-VAE / SID) and train autoregressive models, grounded in MLLM semantics, to generate what a user wants next — collapsing the traditional "multi\-channel retrieval \+ ranking" funnel into a single generative stage. The open problems span the full stack: item tokenizers that balance semantic content against collaborative signal, and SIDs that stay stable while millions of new items arrive daily; post\-training the generator directly on live user feedback (preference optimization, GRPO\-style RL); and decoding under a millisecond budget — beam search, decoding constrained to the valid item space, and test\-time scaling that trades inference compute for better recommendations. The prize is a system freed from its path dependence on ID memorization, where cold\-start generalization comes from semantics rather than impression history. * Inject world knowledge. Use large models' real\-world knowledge to mine latent user interests and semantic representations beyond what pure ID co\-occurrence can express; use reasoning models to run explicit chain\-of\-thought inference over long\-horizon user intent, making the system materially better at discovery and novelty. * Push training and inference to the hardware limit. Custom CUDA / Triton fused kernels, memory and computation\-graph optimization, distributed training and inference acceleration, mixed precision and low\-bit quantization — engineered for what makes recommendation hard: sparse embeddings, variable\-length sequences, and many task heads. * Rewrite R\&D with agents. We are embedding coding agents deep into the algorithm\-development loop: automated feature mining and pipeline generation, experiment configuration and training orchestration, automated evaluation and online\-diagnosis attribution, bad\-case mining and patrol. You will be both a user and a builder of this system. * Do original work on open problems. Long\-term value modeling, repurchase and retention, transaction attribution, fatigue modeling, new\-user recommendation, incremental value modeling, interest exploration, LLM4Rec — problems where industry has no standard answers. We expect, and support, original research: internal papers, patents, and publication at top external venues. Qualifications **Minimum Qualifications:** * Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a PhD degree in Computer Science, AI, Mathematics, Statistics or a related discipline * Solid ML and engineering fundamentals: you understand the math behind the models, and you write clean, efficient, reproducible code with a strong command of algor zing models. jobs.title: Head of Distribution Partnerships
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Together AI is building the AI\-native cloud — the fastest inference infrastructure on the planet, paired with a model ecosystem, orchestration layer, and data center footprint that enterprises and frontier labs depend on. As we expand the surface area through which our models and inference reach end users, we're hiring a Head of Distribution Partnerships to source and build the 0\-to\-1 partnerships that drive token distribution from models served on Together. This is a builder role for someone with sharp technical instincts and a strong product\-partnerships background who can identify where Together's competitive edge in open\-source model serving complements another platform's distribution — and then go build that relationship from scratch. You'll work across technology partnerships, co\-sell motions, ISV integrations, and OEM arrangements with data platforms, cloud providers, and software ecosystems where our inference and OSS model serving capabilities create obvious joint value. You need technical fluency to scope integrations with engineering counterparts, product instincts to identify where Together's serving stack creates a compelling wedge, and the hustle to turn a cold outreach into a signed, launched partnership. You'll report into the VP of Strategic Partnerships and work closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and the broader Partnerships team. ### **Responsibilities** * **Source and Build 0\-to\-1 Partnerships:** Identify and prioritize distribution partners — data platforms, cloud marketplaces, ISVs, and software ecosystems — where Together's open\-source model serving and inference performance is a differentiated fit. Build these relationships from first contact through signed agreement and launch. * **Structure Technical \& Commercial Integrations:** Design partnership structures across technology integrations, co\-sell arrangements, ISV partnerships, and OEM deals. Scope technical integration requirements directly with partner engineering teams and negotiate the commercial terms alongside them. * **Own the Partner Lifecycle:** Manage the full arc of a partnership — pipeline generation, technical scoping, commercial negotiation, legal review, launch, and ongoing account growth — with less structure and more ambiguity than a mature partner program. * **Translate Product Fit into Partner Value:** Work closely with Product and Engineering to understand where Together's model serving and inference capabilities offer a genuine wedge into a partner's ecosystem, and translate that into a partnership pitch that resonates with partner stakeholders. * **Drive Joint Go\-to\-Market:** Partner with Marketing and Sales to build joint co\-sell motions, marketplace listings, and case studies that demonstrate real distribution impact from launched partnerships. ### **Requirements** * **Experience:** At least 5 years in product partnerships, business development, or technical alliance management, ideally at an infrastructure, developer tools, or platform company. * **0\-to\-1 Builder Mentality:** Track record of sourcing and closing partnerships from scratch — comfortable with ambiguity, cold outreach, and building process where none exists yet. * **Technical Acumen:** Enough technical depth to scope integrations directly with engineering counterparts — APIs, SDKs, model serving, or infrastructure integrations — without needing a technical partner in every conversation. * **Commercial Structuring:** Experience negotiating technology partnership agreements, co\-sell frameworks, ISV/OEM arrangements, or marketplace integrations. * **High EQ \& Self\-Starter:** Comfortable operating with significant autonomy, building trust with partner stakeholders quickly, and prioritizing across a broad and evolving partner landscape. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience partnering with or working inside data platforms, cloud marketplaces, or enterprise software ecosystems. * Background in AI infrastructure, model serving, or inference, or strong familiarity with the open\-source model ecosystem. * Experience with marketplace private offers, co\-sell motions, or consumption\-based commercial models. ### **About Together AI** Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose\-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high\-performance inference that scales reliably, fine\-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier\-level specialized models, and pre\-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400\+ trillion tokens a month. ### **Compensation** We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance and other competitive benefits. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is: $ 300 \- 350K OTE \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job\-related knowledge. ### **Equal Opportunity** Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more. Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy.

jobs.title: Retail Technical Operations (RTO) Engineer
jobs.description: Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a Retail Technical Operations (RTO) Engineer is responsible for the deployment, integration, technical enablement, validation, and operational support of Toshiba retail solutions. RTO serves as the technical bridge between Product Engineering, customer environments, deployment teams, project teams, and support organizations to ensure successful solution delivery and long\-term customer success. The RTO Engineer combines platform expertise, deployment experience, troubleshooting skills, customer engagement, and operational discipline to support both new implementations and existing production environments. The role focuses on delivering consistent, scalable, and high\-quality customer outcomes through engineering excellence, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. **Responsibilities** Deployment Readiness * Assess customer environments for implementation readiness. * Review infrastructure, architecture, networking, hardware, software, and dependencies. * Conduct network readiness assessments and architecture validation. * Support certificate, security, and environment planning. * Validate hardware and software configurations and releases. * Identify technical risks, gaps, and readiness issues before testing, pilot, or production deployment. * Participate in deployment planning and technical reviews. Solution Deployment * Provide technical guidance and engineering support during implementations. * Deploy and configure retail platforms and infrastructure components, including: * Controllers * Distributed Data and backup controllers * Terminal and Terminal Primary environments * ELERA platform solutions * TCxSky environments * SDK, JavaPOS, and Device Broker components * Configure and validate system environments. * Integrate retail peripherals and payment devices. * Support pilot deployments, production rollouts, and go\-live activities. * Troubleshoot deployment\-related issues and ensure successful implementation. Technical Troubleshooting and Support * Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across supported platforms. * Perform root cause analysis and performance investigations. * Troubleshoot infrastructure, network, deployment, and platform issues. * Analyze logs, technical evidence, and system behavior. * Reproduce issues and validate corrective actions. * Collaborate with Product Engineering on escalations and defect investigations. * Clearly document findings, conclusions, assumptions, and unresolved items. Customer and Stakeholder Engagement * Work directly with customers, project managers, deployment teams, support organizations, and Product Engineering. * Lead or participate in: * Technical discovery sessions * Readiness and architecture workshops * Deployment planning activities * User Acceptance Testing (UAT) * Pilot deployments * Go\-live support * Production rollouts * Troubleshooting sessions * Technical handoffs * Post\-deployment reviews and After Action Reports * Communicate technical risks, decisions, blockers, and validation results. * Maintain strong customer focus and professional communication throughout engagements. Knowledge Management and Continuous Improvement * Capture lessons learned from deployments, troubleshooting activities, and customer engagements. * Create and maintain deployment guides, troubleshooting playbooks, runbooks, standards, and technical documentation. * Contribute validated knowledge to the RTO Engineering Deployment Library. * Promote continuous improvement of deployment standards, operational processes, and troubleshooting practices. * Review and validate AI\-assisted outputs before operational use. * Ensure documentation accuracy, governance compliance, and knowledge reuse across the organization. Cross\-Functional Collaboration * Partner with Product Engineering, Customer Support, Project Management, deployment teams, and customer IT organizations. * Provide technical readiness assessments, deployment guidance, validation support, and escalation assistance. * Help coordinate technical activities across multiple stakeholders to achieve successful customer outcomes. **Required Qualifications** * Experience supporting enterprise software, infrastructure, or retail technology deployments. * Knowledge of deployment methodologies, implementation processes, and production support practices. * Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills. * Experience analyzing logs, system data, and technical evidence to resolve issues. * Understanding of networking, system administration, infrastructure, and application integration concepts. * Ability to validate technical environments and identify deployment risks. * Experience working directly with customers and cross\-functional technical teams. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to document technical findings, procedures, and operational knowledge clearly. * Ability to distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions and make evidence\-based recommendations. * Experience supporting production environments and operational recovery activities. * Demonstrated ability to work across organizational boundaries and coordinate multiple stakeholders. * Commitment to following established standards, validation processes, and change management practices. Preferred Qualifications * Understanding of containerized services, messaging, certificates, security configuration, and payment integrations. * Experience with large\-scale pilot deployments, go\-live support, and production rollouts. * Experience creating technical documentation, playbooks, runbooks, or engineering standards. * Experience leveraging AI\-assisted engineering tools while maintaining technical validation and governance requirements. * Familiarity with knowledge management practices, engineering onboarding, and continuous improvement initiatives. Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is a dynamic billion\-dollar global company based in Research Triangle Park, NC, providing retail store solutions to your favorite brands. jobs.description: Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a hands\-on Senior Engineer IV to lead the transaction\-processing core of our payment systems platform. Responsibilities include ownership of the terminal transport layer, store\-and\-forward (SAF) handling, decline and exception fallback logic, and BIN\-based routing to ensure reliable card\-present payments across our retail network. This is a hands\-on role, not focused on requirements documentation or committee work. We use a Vue 3/TypeScript POS checkout client that interacts with our transaction and device APIs. Docker and Kubernetes support our build, test, and deployment processes. platform. * Maintain PCI\-compliant handling of transaction data throughout the transport and SAF paths, and ensure all changes in this layer meet compliance and certification requirements for payment processing. * Mentor engineers working in the transaction layer and review their changes to transport, SAF, and routing code, exercising sound judgment to prevent changes that compromise correctness for convenience. * Direct AI coding agents working in the transaction and transport codebase by defining their scope, providing necessary protocol and root\-cause context, reviewing all accepted changes as you would a teammate's pull request, and ensuring a mandatory human review for any changes affecting PCI\-scoped or transaction\-integrity code. **Required Skills and Education** * high\-availability configurations for backend services, including application server, database, and hardware failover. * Proficiency with Spring Boot, socket\-level communication, Maven, CI/CD, and Git at team scale.
